**Company Description**
Concentrix is a Fortune 500 technology and services leader that helps global brands build intelligent operations that deliver results in real-world environments. The company designs, builds, and runs integrated human and AI solutions, leveraging insights from billions of interactions to support more than 2,000 complex organizations. With over 20 years of operational experience and proven AI capabilities, Concentrix acts as an Intelligent Transformation Partner for clients across major industries. Team members collaborate with leading brands on advanced data, AI, and digital initiatives that drive measurable, scalable performance.
  
**Role Description**
The SQL Server and Data Platform Solution Architect is a full-time, on-site role based in Gurugram. This role is responsible for designing and architecting end-to-end data platform solutions using SQL Server and related Microsoft data technologies, ensuring scalability, security, and performance. Day-to-day activities include assessing business and technical requirements, creating solution designs and data models, optimizing SQL queries and databases, and overseeing implementation and migration projects. The architect collaborates with stakeholders, developers, and infrastructure teams to define standards, guide best practices, and conduct technical reviews. The role also involves troubleshooting complex data issues, preparing technical documentation, and mentoring team members on data platform concepts and tools.
  
**Qualifications**
  

* Strong expertise in Microsoft SQL Server (database design, performance tuning, query optimization, high availability, backup and recovery).
* Experience in data platform architecture, including data modeling, ETL/ELT processes, and designing scalable, secure data solutions.
* Knowledge of Microsoft data ecosystem (e.g., Azure SQL Database, Azure Data Factory, SSIS, SSAS, SSRS) and integration with enterprise systems.
* Skills in requirements gathering, solution design, and creating technical documentation and diagrams for complex data environments.
* Experience leading implementation and migration projects, including on-premises to cloud transitions and modernization of legacy data platforms.
* Proficiency in troubleshooting database and data pipeline issues, root cause analysis, and implementing long-term remediation.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to collaborate across technical and business teams.
* Ability to mentor and guide development and operations teams on database best practices and data governance standards.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field; relevant certifications (e.g., Microsoft Azure Database, Data Engineer, or SQL Server certifications) are an advantage.
* Experience in large-scale enterprise environments and familiarity with security, compliance, and performance requirements for mission-critical systems.

6c05f9b2.title: Product Delivery Manager - ServiceNow - Moveworks
6c05f9b2.description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**EY-ServiceNow – Supervising Associate (Product Delivery Manager – Moveworks)**
**Role Overview:**
The ServiceNow Product Delivery Manager is responsible for the end-to-end management and delivery of one or more ServiceNow technology solutions within EY. The role ensures that solutions are aligned with the overall EY ServiceNow strategy, integrate effectively within the enterprise technology ecosystem, and consistently deliver high-quality business outcomes.
  
  
As the primary representative and advocate of ET ServiceNow, the Product Delivery Manager is accountable for the success of assigned products and services. This includes ownership of product planning, roadmap development, backlog prioritization, stakeholder engagement, and delivery oversight throughout the product lifecycle. The Product Delivery Manager is accountable for evaluating emerging ServiceNow capabilities, aligning them with business objectives, driving stakeholder awareness and adoption through demonstrations and consultations, and establishing a prioritized roadmap and implementation backlog to maximize platform value.
  
  
The Moveworks Product Delivery Manager is responsible for the successful implementation, adoption, and ongoing evolution of the Moveworks platform across the enterprise. The role is responsible for evaluating new Moveworks features and innovations, assessing their applicability to business needs, driving stakeholder awareness and adoption, and prioritizing implementation initiatives that maximize value realization. The Product Delivery Manager ensures that solutions are delivered in accordance with governance standards, within agreed timelines and budgets, and meet quality, security, and user experience expectation.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**
**Product Strategy & Lifecycle Management:**

* Ensure products align with the EY ServiceNow strategy and broader enterprise technology objectives.
* Evaluate new ServiceNow platform capabilities and features, assess business value, and drive adoption opportunities.
* Develop and maintain the product implementation backlog based on business priorities and platform capabilities.

**Stakeholder Management:**

* Serve as the primary point of contact and trusted advisor between ET ServiceNow and business stakeholders.
* Collaborate with business teams to understand requirements, challenges, and strategic objectives.
* Translate business needs into scalable ServiceNow solutions while promoting platform best practices and standardization.
* Work with multiple stakeholders/ vendors to clear business/ technical impediments/ blockers

**Product backlog and Planning:**

* Own and govern the product backlog, ensuring alignment with business priorities and strategic goals
* Work closely with Product Owners to define, prioritize, and refine features, enhancements, and technical requirements
* Balance business demands with platform capabilities, technical constraints, and long-term solution sustainability (strong functional understanding of ServiceNow is a must. Development experience expected).

**Delivery Management:**

* Successfully execute the project to agreed schedule, budget and scope
* Manage the demand process
* Monitor risks, dependencies, and delivery milestones, implementing mitigation plans as required.
* Coordinate with cross-functional teams, including architecture, development, testing, operations, and vendors.
* Coordinate UAT and production go-live

**Governance and Continuous improvement:**

* Establish and maintain governance processes for product performance, quality, and compliance.
* Track product KPIs, adoption metrics, and customer satisfaction measures.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives to optimize business processes and maximize platform value.

**Innovation and Platform enablement:**

* Stay current with ServiceNow roadmap developments and emerging platform capabilities.
* Demonstrate new features and innovations to business stakeholders and leadership teams.
* Identify opportunities to improve user experience, operational efficiency, and business outcomes through ServiceNow.

**Knowledge and Skills Requirements:**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field
* 3+ years of hands-on experience in ServiceNow development.
* Understanding of ITIL processes and HR Services
* Strong understanding of the Move works platform, including enterprise search, conversational AI, natural language understanding (NLU), employee support automation, and AI-driven workflow orchestration.
* Knowledge of Move works integration capabilities with ServiceNow, Microsoft Teams, Slack, HR systems, identity platforms, and enterprise applications
* Understanding of conversational experiences, virtual agents, knowledge management, and self-service adoption strategies.
* Advanced comprehension of agile SAFe project management methodology, tools and templates (includes project planning, schedule development, scope management and cost management)
* Strong problem-solving, analytical, and communication skills
* ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA) certification

**What are we looking for?**

* A team player and leader with strong technical acumen and leadership capabilities
* Proactive problem-solving mindset with a focus on operational excellence
* Ability to manage multiple stakeholders and priorities in a fast-paced environment
* Passion to learn and adapt to new technologies
* Strong functional/ technical understanding of ServiceNow applications (ITSM, ITOM, HRSD).

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

1e91c956.title: Solutions Manager
1e91c956.description:
**ABOUT CULTUREMONKEY**

CultureMonkey is an AI-powered employee engagement and experience platform helping organizations build exceptional workplaces through continuous listening, people analytics, and action planning. Trusted across 100+ countries and rated 4.7/5 on G2.

**ABOUT THE ROLE**

* We are looking for a Solutions Manager who can become the product brain, implementation partner, and trusted advisor for our customers.
* This role sits at the intersection of Product, Customer Success, People Science, and Customer Outcomes.
* Our Customer Success Managers own the relationship and commercial health of the account.
* You will own the actual survey experience. You will make sure every survey is set up correctly, launched smoothly, understood clearly, and used meaningfully after the results come in.
* This is not a support role. This is a consulting role.
* You will guide HR leaders, people teams, sub-admins, and internal champions through the full journey... from first setup to final insights to action planning.
* You should enjoy going deep into the product, asking sharp questions, solving messy implementation problems, and helping customers get real value from CultureMonkey.

**WHAT YOU'LL OWN**

* Own the full survey lifecycle for your accounts, from setup to launch to reporting.
* Understand the customer’s people goals and translate them into the right survey design, platform configuration, and launch plan.
* Run onboarding sessions, product trainings, and walkthroughs for HR teams, sub-admins, managers, and employee champions.
* Guide customers on survey best practices, participation strategy, question design, anonymity, reporting, and action planning.
* Handle technical setup like employee data uploads, CSV and Excel files, custom configurations, integrations, access rules, and reporting requirements.
* Work with the People Science team to deliver reports and insights that match the customer’s real context.
* Partner closely with CSMs to flag adoption risks, unblock customers, spot expansion opportunities, and keep the account journey smooth.
* Raise and track Jira tickets for bugs, backend tasks, feature requests, and product gaps.
* Become the internal voice of the customer for Product and Engineering.
* Run roadmap and product update conversations with customers so they always know what is possible and what is coming next.
* Most importantly, make sure the customer does not just “run a survey”...
* Make sure they actually understand what their people are saying.

**WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR**

* 3+ years of experience in Customer Success, Technical Account Management, Solutions Engineering, Implementation, Customer Service, or a similar customer-facing SaaS role.
* Someone who can learn a product deeply and explain it simply.
* Someone who is comfortable working with HRIS data, employee data files, CSVs, Excel, user attributes, reporting structures, and basic integration concepts.
* A clear communicator who can run a training session with an HR team and also explain technical details to an IT stakeholder.
* Strong project management habits. You follow up, track open items, document clearly, and keep multiple accounts moving without being chased.
* A consulting mindset. You ask good questions before giving answers. You can push back kindly when a customer’s approach may not help them.
* A strong eye for detail. Survey setup, data mapping, anonymity rules, access control, and reporting logic need precision.
* A collaborative nature. You will work closely with CSMs, People Science, Product, and Engineering.Comfort with flexible shifts that overlap with US time zones, because our customers are spread across geographies.

**THE KIND OF PERSON WE ARE HOPING TO MEET**

* Someone who can bring calm to complexity.
* Someone who can sit with an HR leader, understand their culture problem, and translate it into a clean survey journey.
* Someone who can tell a customer, “Here's a better way to do this,” with both confidence and kindness.
* Someone who wants to build, not just maintain.
* Someone who believes customer success is not only about renewals...
* It is about making customers feel, “these people really understand us.”

If that sounds like you, we would love to meet you.

8ad0c9f1.title: Salesforce Field Service Architect
8ad0c9f1.description:
**Description**
Our Field Service Professional Services team works across technology and business stakeholders to usher customers into the next phase of their business transformation journey and achieve innovative outcomes that craft the future.
  
  
Technical Architect successfully designs and manages the delivery of complex Salesforce solutions for our customers. These technologies include--but are not necessarily limited to Salesforce.com products and APIs, Apex/Visualforce, Lightning, mobile development technologies, and integration/ETL technologies.
  
  
As a core part of this role, you will realize solutions for our customers by focusing on consultancy, technical development & delivery for the customers and partners to solve critically meaningful business challenges using Salesforce’s Field Service Platform (SFS). Salesforce FS product provides FSM solutions for a wide variety of customer verticals and ecosystem(s) like Telecom, Utilities, Oil & Gas, Manufacturing, Finance etc.
  
  
You are both a big picture thinker and in-depth problem solver, your knowledge and skills are both broad and deep. You take pride in designing systems that stand up to high volumes and won't fail at critical points. You have a good mix of technical and enterprise skills when it comes to architecting a solution. The solutions you design are built for the long-term and will scale with the customer's growth plans seamlessly. You have proven experience integrating systems via API’s as well as a strong development background.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Collaborate with client stakeholders to define requirements, deliverables, and set and manage expectations
* Drive Enterprise AI Architecture by designing and integrating scalable predictive and generative AI solutions within custom Salesforce environments, optimizing performance, resource consumption, and platform governor limits
* Lead technical design sessions; architect and document technical solutions aligned with client business objectives; identify gaps between client's current and desired end states, using advanced LLMs like Claude to review architectural assumptions and simulate system edge cases
* Champion an AI-first delivery methodology, utilizing advanced AI tools, developer assistants (e.g., Cursor, Claude), and agentic evaluation frameworks to accelerate implementation across projects
* Translate business requirements into well-architected solutions that best leverage the Salesforce platform
* Provide oversight and governance of Salesforce projects
* Follow and help define coding standards. Lead code reviews during projects to ensure quality and appropriate design patterns are followed
* Manage the technical delivery of custom development, integrations, and data migration elements of a Salesforce implementation
* Maintain a target billable utilization aligned to the role
* Ability to understand a project and deep dive to debug issues
* From time-to-time, the TA may be expected to partake in other pre-sales activities such as discovery and technical deep-dive sessions, Proof-Of-Concept (POC) development with prospects
* Liaise with Salesforce product teams to support client implementations
* Travels to client sites for projects, estimated 50-75%

**Requirements**

* Degree or equivalent proven experience required. Experience will be evaluated based on the core proficiencies for the role (e.g. extracurricular leadership roles, military experience, volunteer roles, work experience, etc.)
* 9-14 years CRM experience with a minimum of 6 years on the Salesforce platform
* Expert level understanding of End-to-End Field Service Implementation
* Good understanding of the Salesforce product suite, including Sales, Service, Marketing, and Community Clouds
* Understanding of systems architecture and ability to design scalable performance-driven solutions
* Understanding of key design patterns and large data volume limitations and best practices
* Understanding of data sharing and visibility considerations and how these play into platform architecture
* Familiarity with platform authentication patterns (SAML, SSO, OAuth)
* Knowledge of data integration tools and experience integrating Salesforce with different business systems (ETL, CPQ, marketing automation, reporting, etc.)
* Strong understanding of environment management, release management, code versioning best practices, and deployment methodologies
* Experience with platform security capabilities (TLS, SSL)
* Expert level experience defining the system architecture landscape, identifying gaps between current and desired end-states, and delivering a comprehensive solution that will enable achievement of the desired business outcomes
* Strong background in design/development of large web-based systems, or complete software product lifecycle exposure
* Active Salesforce certifications or ability to achieve relevant certifications upon hire

314e923a.description:

Technical Architect successfully designs and manages the delivery of complex Salesforce solutions for our customers. These technologies include—but are not necessarily limited to Salesforce products and APIs, Apex/Visualforce, Lightning, mobile development technologies, and integration/ETL technologies.
  
  
You are both a big picture thinker and in-depth problem solver, your knowledge and skills are both broad and deep. You take pride in designing systems that stand up to high volumes and won't fail at critical points. You have a good mix of technical and enterprise skills when it comes to architecting a solution, including knowing how to leverage AI development tools like Claude and GitHub Copilot to optimize code quality and accelerate design cycles. The solutions you design are built for the long-term and will scale with the customer's growth plans seamlessly. You have proven experience integrating systems via API's as well as a strong development background.
  
  
**What You'll Actually Be Doing**

* Collaborate with client stakeholders to define requirements, deliverables, and set and manage expectations
* Translate business requirements into well-architected solutions that best leverage the Salesforce platform, including identifying opportunities to embed autonomous AI capabilities using Agentforce
* Drive Enterprise AI Architecture by designing and integrating scalable predictive and generative AI solutions within custom Salesforce environments, optimizing performance, resource consumption, and platform governor limits
* Lead technical design sessions; architect and document technical solutions aligned with client business objectives; identify gaps between client's current and desired end states, using advanced LLMs like Claude to review architectural assumptions and simulate system edge cases
* Provide oversight and governance of Salesforce projects, championing an AI-First Delivery & Engineering methodology by utilizing advanced AI tools, developer assistants (e.g., Cursor, Claude), and agentic evaluation frameworks to accelerate implementation
* Follow and help define coding standards. Lead code reviews during projects to ensure quality and appropriate design patterns are followed, utilizing AI coding assistants to help enforce standards and optimize code performance
* Manage the technical delivery of custom development, integrations, and data migration elements of a Salesforce implementation, championing the team's use of tools like GitHub Copilot to accelerate the generation of Apex classes, mock data, and REST integrations
* Focus on Performance Evaluation & ROI by collaborating with customers to develop evaluation frameworks to measure AI performance and business value for their specific use cases
* Maintain a target billable utilization aligned to the role
* Ability to understand a project and deep dive to debug issues, leveraging AI diagnostics to interpret system logs and isolate performance bottlenecks quickly
* From time-to-time, the TA may be expected to partake in other pre-sales activities such as discovery and technical deep-dive sessions, Proof-Of-Concept (POC) development with prospects using AI tools to build prototypes rapidly
* Liaise with Salesforce product teams to support client implementations
* Travels to client sites for projects, estimated 50-75%

* Knowledge of data integration tools and experience integrating Salesforce with different business systems (ETL, CPQ, marketing automation, reporting, etc.), utilizing AI platforms to parse third-party REST API documentation and map complex data schemas
* Strong understanding of environment management, release management, code versioning best practices, and deployment methodologies
* Experience with platform security capabilities (TLS, SSL)
* Practical fluency using AI coding assistants and modern development ecosystems (e.g., Copilot, Cursor, Claude) to accelerate delivery, document technical architecture, and maintain a high standard of code quality
* Expert level experience defining the system architecture landscape, identifying gaps between current and desired end-states, and delivering a comprehensive solution that will enable achievement of the desired business outcomes

6912e9bb.title: AI Engineer - Cloud & MLops
6912e9bb.description:
Agentic AI Cloud Engineering / MLOPS Engineer

Brief Description: This role will be responsible for developing agentic solutions from

prototype to production, combining LLMs, RAG, tool calling, orchestration frameworks,

cloud AI services, and modern software engineering practices.

• 4+ years of experience in AI engineering, software engineering, data engineering,

ML engineering, cloud engineering, or similar technical roles.

• Hands-on experience building GenAI applications, AI agents, RAG-based

solutions, enterprise search, copilots, or LLM-powered workflow

automation.

• Strong programming skills in Python, with experience building APIs, backend

services, automation scripts, and reusable AI components.

• Strong understanding of LLMs, including prompt engineering, context

engineering, model selection, temperature/top-p settings, context windows,

embeddings, token usage, latency, and cost trade-offs.

• Practical experience with RAG architecture, including vector databases,

embedding models, retrieval strategies, metadata filtering, document

processing, grounding, and citation-based answers.

• Hands-on experience with multi-agent orchestration patterns, including

supervisor-agent architectures, planner-executor workflows, routing agents,

tool-using agents, evaluator agents, and human-in-the-loop agent flows.

• Experience implementing tool-calling capabilities, allowing agents to interact

with databases, APIs, business applications, documents, and external services.

• Understanding of agent memory design, including session memory, long-term

memory, vector-based memory, user context, conversation history, and

governed memory retention.

• Experience implementing LLM and agent evaluation frameworks, including

accuracy testing, grounding validation, hallucination detection, retrieval quality

assessment, regression testing, adversarial testing, and user feedback

integration.

• Understanding of model governance and responsible AI, including approved

model usage, model selection criteria, evaluation evidence, security controls,

auditability, and lifecycle management.

• Experience implementing guardrails for AI agents, including policy-based

controls, restricted tool usage, approval gates, fallback flows, escalation paths,

human-in-the-loop checkpoints, and kill-switch mechanisms.

• Experience with observability and tracing for agentic systems, including

execution traces, tool-call monitoring, prompt/response metadata, token usage,

latency, error handling, fallback analysis, and production debugging of multistep workflows.

• Familiarity with agent development frameworks such as LangChain,

LangGraph, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, CrewAI, AutoGen, or similar.

• Experience with cloud-native AI and agentic platforms such as AWS Bedrock

Agents, AWS Agent Core, AWS SageMaker, Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Agent

Service, Azure AI Foundry, Semantic Kernel, or equivalent technologies.

• Understanding of enterprise data concepts, including structured data,

unstructured data, semantic layers, data catalogues, metadata, data

quality, and governed access.

• Experience with REST APIs, microservices, authentication, secrets

management, logging, and cloud-native application patterns.

• Strong understanding of security and responsible AI principles, including rolebased access, data privacy, prompt injection risks, hallucination control,

content filtering, auditability, and safe agent execution.

• Ability to work with business stakeholders to understand use cases and translate

them into practical AI agent capabilities.

• Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate with architects, data

engineers, platform engineers, product owners, and business SMEs.

Nice to have:

• Experience with agent observability platforms or tracing tools for LLM

applications, including LangSmith, Arize Phoenix, OpenTelemetry-based tracing,

MLflow tracing, Databricks MLflow, cloud-native monitoring, or equivalent

solutions.

• Experience designing human-in-the-loop AI systems, including approval

workflows, exception management, escalation logic, user feedback capture, and

controlled autonomy.

• Experience with model risk management, responsible AI, AI governance

frameworks, prompt governance, model catalogues, evaluation reports, and

audit-ready documentation.

• Experience designing tool registries, plugin architectures, MCP-based

integrations, OpenAPI-based tools, schema-driven API invocation, and

reusable agent capabilities.

• Experience with advanced multi-agent topologies, including supervisor agents,

planner-executor agents, critic/evaluator agents, router agents, task-specific

specialist agents, and autonomous workflow coordination.

Experience designing tool registries and schema-driven integrations, using OpenAPI,

JSON Schema, structured outputs, function-calling definitions, API contracts, and

validation layers

ea8e66ff.title: SERVICE DELIVERY LEAD L3
ea8e66ff.description:
Job Title: SERVICE DELIVERY LEAD L3

City: Bengaluru

State/Province: Karnataka

Posting Start Date: 10/4/26

Wipro Limited (NYSE: WIT, BSE: 507685, NSE: WIPRO) is a leading technology services and consulting company focused on building innovative solutions that address clients’ most complex digital transformation needs. Leveraging our holistic portfolio of capabilities in consulting, design, engineering, and operations, we help clients realize their boldest ambitions and build future-ready, sustainable businesses. With over 230,000 employees and business partners across 65 countries, we deliver on the promise of helping our customers, colleagues, and communities thrive in an ever-changing world. For additional information, visit us at www.wipro.com.

**Role Purpose**

The purpose of the role is to ensure excellent customer service delivery of all technology solutions and products to clients, through effective project management, service metrics tracking, budget management, issue resolution, optimal resource allocation, and maintenance of a skilled team of all delivery resources for the client.

**͏**
-----

**Do**

* **Oversee and manage service delivery by meeting all contractual/ SLA commitments**
  + Contract compliance & adherence
    - Ensure all SLA parameters are met in the account
    - Review and drive appropriate actions/ systemic changes on internal and external audit findings to ensure no major non-compliances are cited
    - Monitor and review all projects in the account on various delivery parameters to ensure quality delivery as per budget and timelines
    - Ensure that the service credits, performance incentives, penalty and penalty waivers are incorporated in the invoices
  + Delivery governance across the accounts/projects
    - Lead delivery teams to understand customer goals and key performance metrics and their thresholds for each project
    - Ensure that the project performance parameters stay green for all accounts
    - Monitor and review delivery dashboards/ MIS across accounts to track progress, forecast performance and identify potential red flags
    - Participate and share account performance across operational, quality and fulfillment parameters with internal/external stakeholders & senior leadership
    - Ensure regular invoicing as per the contract terms and condition and performance
  + Technical and/or Operational Issue Resolution
    - Manage and resolve complex project escalations, potential risks or early warning signs on project delivery to eliminate any revenue leakage
    - Acts as an advisor to service delivery managers to meet schedules or resolve technical or operational problems on a daily basis
    - Acts as point of escalation for issues not resolvable by the service lines.
    - Escalate issues with financial implication on the account to Account Head and other senior stakeholders
    - Acts as an advisor to service line managers to meet schedules or resolve technical or operational problems

**͏**
-----

* Resource Allocation & Retention
  + Ensure effective transition from the client with the well documented and clear process understanding along with the right manpower requirements with requisite skill and training to undertake delivery
  + Review and monitor resource planning and fulfillment in line with account requirements and costs of delivery
  + Responsible for establishing, leading and maintaining a skilled team of all delivery resources for an account on a daily basis
  + Plan training batches to backfill client deliveries during crucial periods
  + Ensure retention by offering relevant trainings and certifications of all allocated resources
* Ensure Process Excellence
  + Partner with the assigned black belt for the account on regular basis to get feedback on account performance
  + Prioritize and drive initiatives for continuous improvement to improve top line revenue and bottom line margins
  + Present the business case for such initiatives to the clients to get their buy-in if required
  + Drive and implement structured cadence around quality, both process and transactional.
  + Conduct periodic meetings with clients and delivery teams daily status updates, service level requirement reviews, continuous improvement, change control and other informal meetings to share focus points, progress and successes.

**͏**
-----

* **Contribute to revenue and profitable growth by ensuring the agreed revenue targets are met and by identifying opportunities in the form of new and/or adjacent work in the assigned account**
  + Ensure excellent service delivery of all products and solutions to achieve approved margin targets on assigned accounts and is targeted to improve account profitability.
  + Regularly monitors and reports on financial health of the account and remedies any financial misses or anomalies
  + Contribute to the revenue growth of the account by supporting the Account Head through new opportunity identification for deployment of new technology, growth solutions and services within the existing account/client
  + Recognizes business needs and determines if our portfolio offering may be an appropriate solution
  + Qualify and prioritize new opportunities in the funnel in the form of adjacent work in existing accounts
  + Serve as the primary relationship owner for an assigned group of top tier client accounts with responsibility for retention and growth
  + Prepare implementation plans and ensure efficient client on-boarding; present content strategy and annual delivery plan
  + Partner with the process excellence team to incorporate and drive key Wipro initiatives and priorities in the account strategy such as Digital, Automation etc.
  + Set direction for the team, track progress against targets through regular cadence calls and course correct as required
  + Partner with the WFM, Hiring & HR team to ensure optimal resource allocation and maintenance of a ready skilled team of resources to avoid leakages and revenue loss

**͏**
-----

* **Develop, manage and leverage relationships in account to build customer centricity**
  + Identify key stakeholders/ decision makers in client organization and develop and strengthen relationships with them
  + Interact and engage with the client leadership to communicate and update progress against account plan, project delivery etc.
  + Drive and attend Steering Committee meetings or Client Review meetings to regularly review project dashboards, discuss and resolve escalation points and course correct as required for high customer satisfaction and better quality of experience
  + Act as client advocate and work with internal departments to ensure that client needs are understood and satisfied
  + Liaise between the customer and internal teams
* **Drive Delivery Transformation through automation and innovation focus**
  + Create and drive automation charter and related initiatives within account client (wherever applicable)
  + Drive deployment of automation led solutions and service improvements to deliver value added services to the clients
  + Build focus on and drive deployment of next generation hyper automation initiatives in coordination with Holmes team to enhance productivity, quality and speed of delivery
  Lead, develop and drive new ways of working (EOT, Digital, Agile etc.) and its capabilities within the account to improve quality, delivery speed and productivity parameters

Mandatory Skills: Delivery Management .  
Experience: >10 YEARS .  
Reinvent your world. We are building a modern Wipro. We are an end-to-end digital transformation partner with the boldest ambitions. To realize them, we need people inspired by reinvention. Of yourself, your career, and your skills. We want to see the constant evolution of our business and our industry. It has always been in our DNA - as the world around us changes, so do we. Join a business powered by purpose and a place that empowers you to design your own reinvention.

1df283f1.title: Customer Success Manager- Marketing cloud
1df283f1.description:
**Description**
The Customer Success Manager (CSM) is a versatile expert responsible for ensuring high-value customers who purchase the Signature Success Plan achieve a significant return on their investment with our platform. This role functions as an extension of the customer's workforce and a trusted advisor, providing guidance and
  
  
advice to customer organizations. The CSM is responsible for identifying and addressing both technical and business concerns, aligning them strategically with customer priorities, projects, and problems. The CSM serving Marketing Cloud customers acts as the primary Marketing Cloud Subject Matter Expert (SME) for the technical and operational configuration and needs of the customer.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
Customer Accountability and Value Alignment
  
  

* Single Point of Accountability: Serve as the single point of customer accountability responsible for the delivery of all Signature deliverables, the overall customer experience, and renewal and expansion.
* Signature Lifecycle Oversight: Coordinate all deliverables the customer is entitled to, overseeing the experience throughout the Signature lifecycle.
* Value Delivery: Apply the correct processes to address customer needs and ensure value is delivered through the Signature offer.
* Stakeholder Alignment: Successfully align with and manage both Business and Technical Stakeholders, focusing on aligning Business Value and Technical Goals to the Signature offer.
* Prioritization: Prioritize the most urgent work activities, organize tasks to avoid missing key steps, and create basic plans to focus time, taking responsibility for assigned tasks.
* Internal Resource Utilization: Use internal resources to increase effectiveness and rely on managers or mentors for guidance on priority problems.

**Strategic Advisory and Stakeholder Management**

* Relationship Building: Develop and maintain strong relationships at key stakeholder levels, including cultivating executive-level relationships within customer IT and business leadership.
* Trusted Advisor: Act as a trusted advisor by gaining trust through mutual goals, understanding the customer's business model, and applying proven solutions to their problems.
* Innovation Partnership: Solidify partnership commitments and drive innovation aligned with customers' business challenges.
* Customer Engagement: Increase customer engagement with products and services and identify major political barriers to customer success.
* Collaborative Problem Solving: Partner with more experienced team members to solve complex problems and develop strategic success plans when needed.

**Technical Health, Adoption, and Risk Management**

* AI Literacy: Proficiency in using AI agents to automate routine tasks such as meeting summaries, QBR data collection, and initial health monitoring.
* Prompt Engineering Basics: Ability to use natural-language commands to guide AI agents in retrieving accurate customer data and generating first drafts of success plans.
* AI Engagement Monitoring: Using AI-driven sentiment and intent analysis to flag early customer concerns for human intervention.
* Collaborative Learning: Actively seeking out "Agentblazer" training and certifications to stay current on autonomous agent capabilities.
* Learning & Development: Apply product knowledge and expertise to address technical concerns, use this knowledge to ask effective diagnosis questions and align platform features with customer priorities and roadmaps.
* Proactive Reviews: Proactively monitor and conduct quarterly reviews, identify trends, and provide tailored release recommendations to ensure stability, performance, and feature enhancement.
* Incident Management: Act as the primary point of contact for major incidents, ensuring timely communications and resolution of issues.
* Cross-functional Relationships: Forge strong multidisciplinary relationships with Sales, Engineering, and Product Management to lead and coordinate customer relationships for success and revenue opportunities.
* Client Engagement Planning: Form a clear plan for client engagements, communicate clearly and proactively with collaborators, and keep the customer goal central to decision-making.

**Minimum Requirements**
Preferred/Mandatory Qualifications and Skills
  
  

* Experience (Mandatory): Experienced business professional with 9+ years of relevant industry expertise, including a mandatory minimum of 2+ years of direct, hands-on experience working with the Salesforce Marketing Cloud platform (Marketing Cloud Engagement, Marketing Cloud Account Engagement / Pardot, or Marketing Cloud Next) in a customer success, administrator, consultant, or marketing operations capacity. Candidates without demonstrated Salesforce Marketing Cloud experience will not be considered for this role.
* Consulting Skills: Strong consulting skills and demonstrated ability to drive business value, facilitate discussions, handle objections, and influence C-level conversations.
* Domain Expertise: Possess industry-relevant expertise and begin honing skills in a relevant functional area. Should understand the broad impact of the industry on the customer's business.
* Communication: Excellent communication skills to articulate technical issues to diverse audiences and the ability to translate technical concepts into business terms.
* Learning & Development: Actively seek out relevant learning activities, approach obstacles as growth opportunities, and seek experienced mentors to accelerate personal development.

**Cloud Specific Experience**
Salesforce product certifications are required for this role. Recommended Marketing Cloud certifications:
  
  

* Marketing Cloud Engagement Administrator — hands-on experience configuring Marketing Cloud products using industry and product best practices.
* Marketing Cloud Email Specialist — proven knowledge of email marketing best practices, message design, subscriber & data management, and inbox delivery.
* Marketing Cloud Account Engagement Specialist — skills in designing, building, and implementing marketing workflows through the Account Engagement (Pardot) platform.
* Marketing Cloud Engagement Consultant — ability to create multi-channel campaign solutions using the full suite of Marketing Cloud tools.

bc310561.title: Pre-Sales Consultant
bc310561.description:
**SURYA AT A GLANCE**
Surya creates software products and provides implementation services for financial risk management of banks and the financial services industry. We provide web-based, shared facility treasury management products for corporates. Founded in 1999, Surya’s client base is spread across four continents. We help more than 75+ banks, hedge funds, and corporations around the world make better business decisions by mitigating risk, enhancing profitability, and complying with regulatory requirements. We are headquartered in Bangalore, India. We also have offices in Dubai, UK, USA and France.
  
  

* Designation: Pre-Sales Consultant
* Relevant Experience: 2 - 4 Years

You will work closely with customers, Sales, Business Development, Engineering, and technology partners to understand business and technical requirements, develop end-to-end architectures, size AI infrastructure, build and validate PoCs, and guide customers from initial discovery through technical closure and production adoption.

The role requires a strong combination of AI technical depth, solution architecture, hands-on problem solving, and customer-facing pre-sales capability.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Engage directly with customers to understand their business challenges, AI use cases, data landscape, workloads, performance requirements, and existing infrastructure.
* Architect end-to-end Generative AI, LLM, RAG, and Agentic AI solutions aligned with customer requirements.
* Lead technical discovery sessions, architecture workshops, whiteboarding sessions, and solution-design discussions.
* Design RAG architectures covering data ingestion, chunking, embeddings, vector search, retrieval, reranking, context management, and enterprise data integration.
* Design Agentic AI architectures involving tool/function calling, orchestration, memory, planning, APIs, guardrails, human-in-the-loop, and enterprise system integration.
* Design and size scalable LLM inference platforms and GPU-accelerated infrastructure based on model, workload, concurrency, context length, latency, throughput, and availability requirements.
* Analyze end-to-end AI workloads and recommend approaches to improve latency, throughput, scalability, GPU utilization, reliability, and cost efficiency.
* Evaluate and recommend appropriate models, inference engines, AI frameworks, vector databases, and deployment architectures.
* Build or lead PoCs, technical demonstrations, benchmarks, and reference solutions to validate proposed architectures and customer use cases.
* Support Sales and Business Development teams throughout the technical sales cycle, including customer presentations, solution positioning, demonstrations, technical qualification, and objection handling.
* Translate customer requirements into solution architectures, infrastructure sizing, BOMs, technical proposals, RFP/RFI responses, and implementation scope/SOWs.
* Identify technical risks, dependencies, assumptions, security requirements, and integration challenges before solution commitment.

* Collaborate with Engineering and Delivery teams to ensure effective transition from pre-sales to implementation and production deployment.
* Collaborate with NVIDIA and other technology partners for architecture validation, GPU sizing, performance optimization, product feedback, and complex customer requirements.
* Provide technical leadership and guidance on best practices for production-grade Generative AI and Agentic AI deployments.
* Work with Enterprise, Government, Research, and Public Sector customers on strategic AI initiatives.
* Stay current with developments in LLMs, Agentic AI, RAG, inference engines, GPU technologies, and distributed AI systems.

**Must-Have Skills & Experience**

* 6–10 years of overall experience across Solution Architecture, Technical Pre-Sales, AI/ML, Cloud, Data Platforms, Infrastructure, or related technologies.
* Strong customer-facing experience in a Solution Architect, Pre-Sales Architect, AI Architect, or Technical Consultant role.
* Strong understanding of Generative AI, LLMs, RAG, and Agentic AI architectures.
* Hands-on experience designing or delivering LLM, RAG, or Agentic AI solutions in production or production-like environments.
* Ability to translate business requirements into end-to-end technical architectures and solution designs.
* Practical understanding of RAG components including embeddings, vector databases, semantic/hybrid search, retrieval, reranking, context management, and evaluation.
* Understanding of Agentic AI concepts including tool/function calling, orchestration, memory/state, planning, multi-step workflows, guardrails, and human-in-the-loop patterns.
* Strong understanding of LLM inference concepts including:

1. Latency and throughput
2. Concurrency and batching
3. GPU memory and utilization
4. KV cache
5. Quantization
6. Multi-GPU deployment
7. Scalability and cost optimization

* Experience with Python, Linux, Docker, and Kubernetes.
* Experience with AI/ML ecosystems such as PyTorch and Hugging Face.
* Experience or exposure to LLM serving technologies such as NVIDIA NIM, TensorRT-LLM, Triton Inference Server, vLLM, or equivalent.
* Working understanding of GPU infrastructure, model sizing, networking, storage, security, and observability requirements for AI workloads.
* Experience conducting customer discovery, architecture workshops, technical presentations, demonstrations, and PoCs.
* Experience supporting technical pre-sales activities including solution sizing, RFP/RFI responses, technical proposals, and technical closure.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to engage developers, architects, infrastructure teams, business stakeholders, and senior customer leadership.

**Preferred / Good-to-Have Skills**

* Experience with NVIDIA AI Enterprise, NIM, NeMo, TensorRT-LLM, Triton Inference Server, Dynamo, or other NVIDIA AI technologies.
* Experience designing or operating GPU clusters and distributed AI infrastructure.
* Understanding of advanced inference architectures including distributed/disaggregated serving, intelligent routing and scheduling, KV-cache optimization, heterogeneous inference, and model parallelism.
* Experience with LangGraph, LlamaIndex, LangChain, Semantic Kernel, or similar Agentic AI frameworks.
* Experience with model customization, LoRA/PEFT, fine-tuning, quantization, and model evaluation.
* Experience with Kubernetes GPU scheduling and production AI platform architecture.
* Experience designing AI solutions across on-premises, private cloud, and public cloud environments.
* Understanding of AI security, governance, observability, responsible AI, and guardrail frameworks.
* Experience with GPU/infrastructure sizing, BOM preparation, capacity planning, and performance benchmarking.
* Experience with high-performance networking and storage for AI workloads.
* Experience working with Government, Research, Public Sector, CSP, or large enterprise customers.

The ideal candidate combines strong customer engagement and pre-sales capability with sufficient hands-on technical depth to design, validate, defend, and optimize enterprise AI solutions.

caab1c24.title: Sales System Architect
caab1c24.description:
**Ready to join the future of innovation in IT at NXP?**
Do you love to collaborate with the business to translate their strategy into solid IT solutions?
  
  
Do you have the experience to be a sparring partner for both IT and Business colleagues?
  
  
Do you thrive in a role with a lot of room for your own ideas and innovation?
  
  
Do you want to make an impact on both our business and our customers?
  
  
Do you get excited by the prospect to be part of an international diverse company?
  
  
Then we are looking for you in the role of Sales IT System Architect.
  
  
The System Architect is the glue between Sales and IT. You will be responsible for understanding the needs of the Sales organization on a strategic and operational level and translating those into sound solutions. Tasks will include business requirement gathering, architecting, designing and -in some instances- implementing solutions. You will be working in an Agile and DevOps way, together in a supporting environment, with continuous focus on development and coaching.
  
  
**Your Responsibilities**

* Work together with the Sales team to understand and analyze their requirements, and propose (IT) solution directions, in line with the NXP enterprise architecture
* Team up with internal and external resources to implement solutions and provide architectural oversight
* Collaborate with other architects within the company to deliver end-to-end solutions that are transformational leveraging AI/ML
* Help define the architectural roadmap and strategy for the team to create future-proof solutions
* Create and maintain architectural documents for applications within the team’s portfolio
* Build PoCs when needed and apply code when required

**Your team**
NXP IT is well recognized as a modern IT organization with a DevOps way of working. We are a diversified team with high energy, an open collaboration environment and eagerness for continuous improvement.
  
  
Within Sales and Marketing IT we focus on internal and external applications to support the Customer journey. We collaborate with our business teams daily on strategic improvements and with vendor partners to deliver easy-to-use applications leveraging SaaS, cloud services and custom development where needed.
  
  
**To be successful in this role you have**

* BS or MS degree in Computer Science, Information Technology or equivalent years of relevant experience
* 5+ years’ experience in Information Technology (Consultancy, Project or Development) in the Sales and Marketing domain
* Deep core competence in applying IT strategically to fundamentally change an enterprise and enable a company to achieve its strategic, tactical and operational goals
* Knowledge and experience in the following areas:

+ Required: Salesforce Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, Agentforce, DataCloud, AI/ML
+ Preferred: Eloqua, Xactly, Gen AI
+ Functional areas like: Customer Relation Management, Product Support, Customer Support, Sales Incentive Planning, (Customer) Master Data management, Lead Management

* Experience using Agile methodologies and familiar with tools for Agile project management and software development
* You have an advantage if you also bring:

+ Knowledge of, or experience with development languages, tools, technologies and frameworks used to deliver state of the art, secure solutions for Sales and Marketing
+ Experience with Continuous Integration tools and processes
+ Knowledge of how to leverage Business Intelligence/Analytics

**Furthermore, you are**

* able to collaborate and partner with business and IT in defining, preparing and executing projects and change programs
* able to get your point across to your juniors, peers and management in IT as well as business
* an excellent communicator with good presentation skills and the ability to work with a geographically dispersed, multi-cultural team

More information about NXP in India...

You take pride in designing systems that stand up to high volumes and won't fail at critical points. You have a good mix of technical and enterprise skills when it comes to architecting a solution. The solutions you design are built for the long-term and will scale with the customer's growth plans seamlessly. You have proven experience integrating systems via API’s as well as a strong development background.

* Collaborate with client stakeholders to define requirements, deliverables, and set and manage expectations
* Drive Enterprise AI Architecture by designing and integrating scalable predictive and generative AI solutions within custom Salesforce environments, optimizing performance, resource consumption, and platform governor limits
* Lead technical design sessions; architect and document technical solutions aligned with client business objectives; identify gaps between client's current and desired end states, using advanced LLMs like Claude to review architectural assumptions and simulate system edge cases
* Champion an AI-first delivery methodology, utilizing advanced AI tools, developer assistants (e.g., Cursor, Claude), and agentic evaluation frameworks to accelerate implementation across projects
* Translate business requirements into well-architected solutions that best leverage the Salesforce platform
* Provide oversight and governance of Salesforce projects
* Follow and help define coding standards. Lead code reviews during projects to ensure quality and appropriate design patterns are followed
* Manage the technical delivery of custom development, integrations, and data migration elements of a Salesforce implementation
* Maintain a target billable utilization aligned to the role
* Ability to understand a project and deep dive to debug issues
* From time-to-time, the TA may be expected to partake in other pre-sales activities such as discovery and technical deep-dive sessions, Proof-Of-Concept (POC) development with prospects
* Liaise with Salesforce product teams to support client implementations
* Travels to client sites for projects, estimated 50-75%

**Requirements**

* Degree or equivalent proven experience required. Experience will be evaluated based on the core proficiencies for the role (e.g. extracurricular leadership roles, military experience, volunteer roles, work experience, etc.)
* 9-14 years CRM experience with a minimum of 6 years on the Salesforce platform
* Expert level understanding of End-to-End Field Service Implementation
* Good understanding of the Salesforce product suite, including Sales, Service, Marketing, and Community Clouds
* Understanding of systems architecture and ability to design scalable performance-driven solutions
* Understanding of key design patterns and large data volume limitations and best practices
* Understanding of data sharing and visibility considerations and how these play into platform architecture
* Familiarity with platform authentication patterns (SAML, SSO, OAuth)
* Knowledge of data integration tools and experience integrating Salesforce with different business systems (ETL, CPQ, marketing automation, reporting, etc.)
* Strong understanding of environment management, release management, code versioning best practices, and deployment methodologies
* Experience with platform security capabilities (TLS, SSL)
* Expert level experience defining the system architecture landscape, identifying gaps between current and desired end-states, and delivering a comprehensive solution that will enable achievement of the desired business outcomes
* Strong background in design/development of large web-based systems, or complete software product lifecycle exposure
* Active Salesforce certifications or ability to achieve relevant certifications upon hire

Unleash Your Potential
  
  
When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and
*be your best*
, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can
*do your best*
. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.
  
  
Accommodations
  
  
If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this Accommodations Request Form.
  
  
Please note that Salesforce uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to help our recruiters assess and evaluate candidates’ resumes and qualifications throughout the recruiting process. Humans will always make any candidate selection and hiring decisions. Please see our Candidate Privacy Statement for more information about how we use your personal data and your rights, including with regard to use of AI tools and opt out options.
  
  
Posting Statement
  
  
Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination. Know your rights: workplace discrimination is illegal. Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications – without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. 61f9dd96.title: Business Technology Solutions Manager- Salesforce Delivery
61f9dd96.description:
**ZS**
is a place where passion changes lives. As a management consulting and technology firm focused on improving life and how we live it, we transform ideas into impact by
**bringing together data, science, technology**
and
**human ingenuity**
to deliver better outcomes for all. Here you’ll work side-by-side with a powerful collective of thinkers and experts shaping life-changing solutions for patients, caregivers and consumers, worldwide. ZSers drive impact by bringing a
**client-first mentality**
to each and every engagement. We partner collaboratively with our clients to develop custom solutions and technology products that create value and deliver company results across critical areas of their business. Bring your curiosity for learning, bold ideas, courage and passion to drive life-changing impact to ZS.
  
  
We are seeking a seasoned Salesforce professional with a deep understanding of the Salesforce ecosystem, particularly in the field of Salesforce Health Cloud. This individual will play a crucial role in expanding our Salesforce practice, driving digital transformation across various industries, with a special focus on healthcare. Our firm looks to leverage your innovative thinking and leadership to develop cutting-edge business solutions that leverage AI and Analytics to deliver maximum value to our clients.
  
  
The candidate will be part of our Salesforce Expertise practice. As a Salesforce expert, the candidate will draw on their skills and experience to lead defining salesforce related business solutions/sales plays; work with team(s) to develop ZS capabilities (including: selling collateral and assets/accelerators/demos); and take the offerings to ZS’ client to convert to real opportunities, supporting the entire lifecycle of engagements. To do so, you will need to deeply understand customer requirements, understand the salesforce.com ecosystem and work closely with functional specialists to develop innovative, cutting-edge business solutions leveraging AI/Analytics to maximize the value to our clients. You will work closely with functional specialists to develop creative business solutions, solving some of the most exciting problems for our clients.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* End-to-End Delivery Management:

+ Deliver exceptional client service, ensuring projects stay within expected timeframes and budgets.
+ Review application and technical design documents, ensuring they follow Salesforce best practices and integrate effectively into the client's infrastructure.
+ Team and Capability Development:
+ Develop team skills and collaborate to create accelerators and assets that enhance our service offerings to clients.

* Offerings and Business Development:

+ Collaborate with ZS and industry experts to define integrated programs and offerings, taking them to market with the client service teams.
+ Lead large-scale business development and delivery engagements, especially in the Healthcare sector.

* Mentoring and Coaching:

+ Provide on-the-job feedback and coaching to team members and actively participate in the counseling and mentoring of junior consultants within the organization.

* Solution Architecture and Design:

+ Collaborate with healthcare organizations to understand their business needs and design customized Salesforce Health Cloud solutions.
+ Lead the architecture and design of scalable, secure, and high-performance Salesforce Health Cloud implementations.

* Technical Guidance and Quality Assurance:

+ Develop and maintain technical documentation, including solution designs, data models, and integration patterns.
+ Conduct code reviews and ensure best practices are followed for Salesforce Health Cloud implementations.

**What You’ll Bring**

* Bachelor's degree with major in Computers or Electronics.
* 10+ years’ of overall professional experience; with at least 5 years in a leadership role within a professional services firm.
* Proven experience as a Salesforce Health Cloud Architect, designing and implementing solutions for healthcare organizations.
* Strong understanding of the Salesforce platform, including platform configuration, Visual Force, Lightning, Workflows, Apex, and AppExchange.
* In-depth knowledge of healthcare data models and HIPAA regulations.
* Proficiency in shaping, providing consulting, building & implementing solutions using Salesforce cloud offerings.
* Good understanding of DevOps as they apply to Salesforce, including various methodologies and tools such as Salesforce DX.
* Active Salesforce Certifications Architect is strongly preferred.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Willingness to travel to meet client needs.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Salesforce certifications, such as Salesforce Certified Application Architect or Salesforce Certified System Architect.
* Proficiency in using MuleSoft and familiarity with other Salesforce cloud offerings like Sales, Service, Community, and Marketing Cloud.
* Working experience with Salesforce.com organization to leverage the ecosystem.
* The successful candidate will demonstrate a high level of motivation, excellent problem-solving skills, a strong work ethic, and executive-level presence and communication.

**How you’ll grow:**

* Cross-functional skills development & custom learning pathways
* Milestone training programs aligned to career progression opportunities
* Internal mobility paths that empower growth via s-curves, individual contribution and role expansions

**Perks & Benefits:**
At ZS, your growth matters. We offer a comprehensive total rewards package that supports your health and well‑being, financial future, time away, and professional development. With robust skills‑building programs, multiple career progression paths, internal mobility, and a deeply collaborative culture, you’ll have the opportunity to do meaningful work, expand your capabilities, and thrive as part of a global community. For details on total rewards in India, visit ZS India office locations | Where we work | ZS.
  
  
**Hybrid working model:**
We are committed to giving our employees a flexible and connected way of working. A flexible and connected ZS allows us to combine work from home and on-site presence at clients/ZS offices for the majority of our week. The magic of ZS culture and innovation thrives in both planned and spontaneous face-to-face connections.
  
  
**Travel:**
Travel is a requirement at ZS for client facing ZSers; business needs of your project and client are the priority. While some projects may be local, all client-facing ZSers should be prepared to travel as needed. Travel provides opportunities to strengthen client relationships, gain diverse experiences, and enhance professional growth by working in different environments and cultures.
  
  
**Considering applying?**
At ZS, we honor the visible and invisible elements of our identities, personal experiences, and belief systems—the ones that comprise us as individuals, shape who we are, and make us unique. We believe your personal interests, identities, and desire to learn are integral to your success here. We are committed to building a team that reflects a broad variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences. Learn more about our inclusion and belonging efforts and the networks ZS supports to assist our ZSers in cultivating community spaces and obtaining the resources they need to thrive.
  
  
If you’re eager to grow, contribute, and bring your unique self to our work, we encourage you to apply.
  
  
ZS is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to providing equal employment and advancement opportunities without regard to any class protected by applicable law.
  
  
To complete your application:
  
  
Candidates must possess or be able to obtain work authorization for their intended country of employment. An on-line application, including a full set of transcripts (official or unofficial), is required to be considered.
  
  
NO AGENCY CALLS, PLEASE.
  
  
Find Out More At:
  
  
www.zs.com

8196d823.description:

Engineering Services Group, Engineering Services Group > Program Management
  
  
**General Summary**
**IE IoT Software Program Manager – Linux & Industrial Solutions**
**Role Overview**
The IE IoT Software Program Manager is responsible for driving end‑to‑end execution of Qualcomm’s Linux platform initiatives with a strong emphasis on upstream alignment, open-source excellence, distribution enablement, lifecycle management, and the productization of industrial‑grade IoT solutions.
  
  
This role demands exceptional cross‑functional leadership, deep expertise in embedded Linux development ecosystems, and the ability to orchestrate execution across kernel, Yocto, Debian/Ubuntu, user‑space frameworks, CI pipelines, and industrial solution teams. A customer‑first approach, cost‑efficient decision making, and proven experience transforming prototypes into robust, production‑ready industrial solutions are essential.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Linux Platform & Upstream Leadership**

* Define and lead mainline alignment, upstreaming strategies, and branch lifecycle management across mainline, LTS, and stable trees.
* Oversee open‑source compliance, release coordination, and adherence to Qualcomm’s Linux‑first execution strategy.
* Ensure predictable upstream refresh cadences across kernel, Yocto, and Debian/Ubuntu ecosystems

**Distro Enablement & Ecosystem Integration**

* Drive end‑to‑end enablement across Yocto, Debian, and Ubuntu distributions, including graphics, multimedia, AI/ML, connectivity, robotics, and industrial frameworks.
* Champion developer‑first workflows, upstream‑friendly integration practices, and clear, high‑quality open‑source documentation.

**Productization & Industrial IoT Solution Readiness**

* Convert platform capabilities and prototypes into stable, repeatable, production‑grade industrial IoT solutions.
* Integrate key industrial protocols (OPC UA, Modbus, EtherCAT, Profinet, MQTT, CoAP, etc.) into platform roadmaps and solution blueprints.
* Drive cost‑optimized decision making across feature sets, cloud usage, and hardware/software selections.

**Customer Engagement & Solutions Engineering**

* Maintain strong customer focus—translate customer needs into actionable, prioritized engineering workflows.
* Lead solution prototyping, PoCs, and integration efforts by coordinating across functional teams.
* Deliver developer‑grade documentation, solution guides, and production‑ready reference implementations.

**Cross‑Functional Program Leadership**

* Manage large cross‑functional execution spanning kernel, multimedia, Android, connectivity, user space, and partner teams that includes the HW platform teams.
* Own schedules, milestone alignment, dependency mapping, risk management, and executive communications.
* Ensure Linux‑first, developer‑first discipline across the entire engineering pipeline.

**Quality, Testing & Automation Excellence**

* Drive strong pre‑merge validation, CI/CD health, and continuous testing coverage across mainline and LTS branches.
* Track quality regressions across features, drive closure with partner teams, and uphold production‑readiness KPIs.

**Required**
**Qualifications & Experience**

* 10–15+ years of leadership experience within embedded Linux/Kernel/Yocto/Open‑Source ecosystems.
* Deep understanding of:

+ Upstream Linux development workflows (maintainers, linux‑next, LTS/stable branches).
+ Kernel branching models, mainline alignment, Yocto/OE pipelines, and Debian/Ubuntu packaging and workflows.
+ Open‑source contribution processes (patch submission, review cycles, Gerrit/Git workflows).

* Demonstrated success managing complex, multi‑disciplinary engineering programs.
* Exceptional communication skills and strong stakeholder management with a risk‑driven decision mindset.

**Preferred**

* Experience with industrial IoT systems, industrial protocols, or Linux‑based industrial platforms.
* Background in prototyping, customer‑facing engineering, or productizing industrial IoT software stacks.
* Strong documentation and developer ecosystem orientation.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related field.
* 4+ years of Program Management or related work experience.

68dc8470.title: Senior Technical Program Manager
68dc8470.description:
Come work at a place where innovation and teamwork come together to support the most exciting missions in the world!
  
  

* As a Senior Technical Program Manager at Qualys, you will drive the execution of complex, cross-functional programs at the intersection of Threat Research, Product, and Platform Engineering. You will own end-to-end program delivery, translate deep technical work into measurable business outcomes, and ensure operational excellence in a high-velocity cybersecurity environment.

This role demands strong technical acumen, rigorous execution discipline, and the ability to influence across engineering, research, and executive leadership.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Program Planning & Execution**

* Define program scope, success criteria, and dependencies; create and execute detailed quarterly and multi-quarter program plans.
* Drive on-time delivery of complex technical initiatives across research, engineering, and platform teams.
* Own program governance, milestone tracking, and execution cadence, including sprint planning and reviews.
* Cross-Functional Leadership
* Act as the primary interface (“API”) between Threat Research, Product Management, Platform Engineering, and Executive stakeholders.
* Identify downstream dependencies early, negotiate timelines, and resolve conflicts to prevent execution bottlenecks.
* Hold engineering and research teams accountable to commitments while fostering strong collaboration and trust.
* Risk, Dependency & Incident Management
* Proactively identify technical, operational, and delivery risks; define mitigation strategies and contingency plans.
* Translate technical blockers and security risks into clear business impact statements for leadership and product stakeholders.
* Demonstrate resilience and decisiveness in high-pressure environments such as SOC, Threat Research, or Incident Response operations.
* Technical Ownership & Domain Expertise
* Own and manage the Threat Research execution queue, ensuring alignment with product and platform priorities.
* Apply a strong understanding of the cybersecurity threat landscape, including CVEs, CVSS scoring, exploit maturity (PoC vs. weaponized exploits), and vulnerability lifecycle.
* Ensure seamless handoff of research outputs into productization and engineering workflows.
* Metrics, Dashboards & Reporting
* Define and track KPIs to measure program health, delivery performance, risk posture, and operational efficiency.
* Design, script, and maintain automated dashboards using tools such as JIRA, Salesforce, Tableau, APIs, SQL, or Python.
* Deliver clear, data-driven insights to technical teams and executive leadership.
* Process Excellence & Tooling
* Configure, maintain, and optimize program management tools (JIRA, Salesforce, Confluence) to support scalable execution.
* Drive continuous improvement of workflows, operating models, and Agile practices to enhance efficiency and quality.
* Own the team’s information architecture in Confluence, enforcing a “documentation-first” culture—no operational process exists unless it is documented.
* Required Qualifications
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.
* 8+ years of experience in Technical Program Management or Project Management within technology-driven organizations.
* Strong expertise in SDLC, Agile methodologies, and program execution at scale.
* Hands-on experience with tools such as JIRA, Confluence, and reporting platforms.
* Exceptional communication, stakeholder management, and leadership skills.
* Proven ability to operate effectively in fast-paced, evolving, and high-stakes environments.
* Preferred Qualifications
* Experience working in the cybersecurity domain, including vulnerability management, threat research, SOC, or incident response.
* Familiarity with SQL and/or Python for data extraction, analysis, and reporting.
* Experience supporting or leading programs involving security research, platform engineering, or cloud-scale products.
