5e417996.title: Application DevOps & Modernisation Architect - VOIS
5e417996.description:
**Who We Are**
VOIS (Vodafone Intelligent Solutions) is a strategic arm of Vodafone Group Plc, creating value for customers by delivering intelligent solutions through Talent, Technology & Transformation.
  
  
As the largest shared services organisation in the global telco industry with 30,000 FTE, our portfolio of next-generation solutions and services are designed in partnership with customers across Vodafone Group, local markets, and partner markets to simplify and drive growth. With our strategic partner Accenture, we work alongside our Vodafone customers, other Telco and tech companies to drive transformation, meet the challenges of our industry and ensure we stay relevant and resilient. This partnership is a unique, industry-first model which brings together the best of in-house and 3rd party capability.
  
  
We work with customers across 28 countries from 10 VOIS locations: Albania, Egypt, Hungary, India, Romania, Spain, Turkey, UK, Germany, Ireland, and with a network of teams in Czech Republic, Italy, Greece, and Portugal.
  
  
#VOIS #BeUnrivalled #CreateTheFuture
  
  
**About This Role**
We are seeking an experienced Application DevOps & Modernisation Architect to lead large-scale application discovery, assessment, migration and modernisation initiatives. You will collaborate with business owners, application owners and technical specialists to understand objectives, functional and non-functional requirements, dependencies and constraints.
  
  
You will define practical modernisation strategies, evaluate solution options and translate application needs into secure, scalable and resilient platform designs. The role requires extensive expertise across application architecture, DevOps, cloud platforms, containerisation, infrastructure as code and continuous delivery.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Lead application discovery and assessment across architecture, integrations, dependencies, databases, infrastructure and operational requirements
* Facilitate discovery workshops, architecture reviews and technical discussions with business and technical stakeholders
* Capture business objectives, functional requirements, non-functional requirements, constraints and expected outcomes
* Define application migration and modernisation strategies using approaches such as Rehost, Replatform, Refactor, Retain, Retire and Repurchase
* Research and evaluate solution options, recommending effective development and implementation patterns with an open-source-first approach where appropriate
* Produce high-level designs, low-level designs, architecture diagrams, deployment models, dependency maps and technical recommendations
* Translate application requirements into platform requirements covering compute sizing, storage, connectivity, load balancing, DNS, databases, security, high availability, disaster recovery and observability
* Collaborate with platform, network, database, security and cloud architects to ensure infrastructure designs meet application requirements
* Support solution implementation, migration, technical troubleshooting and post-migration stabilisation
* Communicate architecture decisions, risks, trade-offs and recommended next steps clearly to business and technical audiences
* Work independently across multiple technical workstreams while maintaining effective stakeholder collaboration

**Who You Are**
Essential experience and capabilities
  
  

* At least eight years of relevant experience across application architecture, DevOps, cloud, migration and modernisation
* Strong experience in large-scale application discovery and assessment
* Demonstrated ability to take ambiguous requirements through discovery, option evaluation and recommendation
* Strong knowledge of Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, Terraform, CI/CD, Git and GitOps
* Extensive public cloud experience with AWS, Microsoft Azure and/or Google Cloud Platform
* Experience designing for networking, databases, identity and access management, security, secrets management, high availability, disaster recovery and observability
* Excellent communication, consulting, analytical and stakeholder-management skills
* Strong problem-solving capabilities and the ability to work independently across concurrent technical workstreams

Desirable experience
  
  

* Understanding of application development using Java, Spring Boot, .NET, Node.js or Python
* Experience with APIs, microservices and modern application integration patterns
* Hands-on knowledge of Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, Terraform and CI/CD tooling
* Experience with Amazon EKS, Azure AKS or Google GKE
* Experience with GitOps tools such as Argo CD
* Familiarity with evaluating open-source technologies for maturity, scalability, security, supportability and licensing
* Relevant AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud, Kubernetes or Terraform certifications

**Not a perfect fit?**
Concerned you may not meet every requirement? Vodafone is committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. If you are excited about this role but your experience does not align exactly with every aspect of the job description, you are encouraged to apply. You may be the right candidate for this or another opportunity, and the recruitment team will support you in exploring where your skills fit best.
  
  
**What's In It For You**

* The opportunity to shape application migration and modernisation strategies for complex, large-scale technology environments
* Exposure to AWS, Microsoft Azure and Google Cloud Platform, alongside Kubernetes, Terraform, GitOps and modern CI/CD practices
* Collaboration with specialists across application, platform, network, database, security and cloud architecture
* The opportunity to influence architecture decisions with broad organisational reach
* Experience solving complex technical challenges from initial discovery through migration and post-migration stabilisation
* A role that combines technical leadership, consulting, stakeholder engagement and independent judgement

**What Skills You Will Learn**

* Advanced application portfolio discovery and assessment techniques
* Practical decision-making across the Rehost, Replatform, Refactor, Retain, Retire and Repurchase modernisation approaches
* Multi-cloud architecture patterns across AWS, Microsoft Azure and Google Cloud Platform
* Container-platform design using Kubernetes services such as EKS, AKS and GKE
* GitOps-based delivery practices using tools such as Argo CD
* Cross-domain architecture planning covering networking, databases, security, resilience and observability
* Evaluation of open-source technologies based on scalability, maturity, security, licensing and operational support
* Communication of complex architecture decisions, risks and trade-offs to varied stakeholder groups

**VOIS Equal Opportunity Employer Commitment**
Vodafone recognises and celebrates the value of diversity in building a workforce that reflects the customers and communities it serves. No form of discrimination is tolerated. This includes, but is not limited to, discrimination based on race, colour, age, veteran status, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, pregnancy, maternity or parental status, ethnicity, disability, religion or belief, political affiliation, trade union membership, nationality, citizenship, indigenous status, medical condition, HIV status, neurodiversity, social origin, cultural background, marital or civil partnership status, or socio-economic background.
  
  
**Join Us**

* Datasphere, focusing on KPI and analytical models that support strategic business initiatives

* Fluent in business English

c6131ac7.title: Hiring For Senior Cloud Engineer
c6131ac7.description:
**Position Overview**

We are seeking a Senior Full Stack Engineer to lead the development of our cloud-based Network Management System (NMS) platform. This role involves building sophisticated web applications and mobile interfaces that enable enterprise customers to monitor, configure, and manage their network infrastructure including switches, routers, and WiFi access points at scale.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

* **NMS Platform Development**: Design and develop scalable web applications for network device management, monitoring, and configuration
* **Real-time Dashboard Creation**: Build responsive dashboards displaying network topology, device status, performance metrics, and alerting systems
* **Device Integration**: Develop APIs and interfaces for managing diverse network hardware (switches, routers, access points) from multiple vendors
* **Network Visualization**: Create interactive network topology maps and device relationship diagrams
* **Mobile Management Apps**: Build mobile applications for field technicians to configure and troubleshoot network devices remotely
* **Performance Monitoring**: Implement real-time network performance monitoring, SNMP integration, and telemetry data visualization
* **Configuration Management**: Develop tools for bulk device configuration, firmware updates, and policy deployment
* **Alert Systems**: Build intelligent alerting and notification systems for network events and anomalies
* **Multi-tenant Architecture**: Contribute to secure, scalable multi-tenant SaaS platform architecture
* **API Development**: Create RESTful APIs for third-party integrations and customer automation workflows

  

**Technical Requirements**

* **Frontend**: Advanced proficiency in React.js/Angular, TypeScript, D3.js for network visualizations, WebSocket for real-time updates
* **Backend**: Strong experience with Node.js, Python, or Java for building scalable network management services
* **Network Protocols**: Understanding of SNMP, SSH, Telnet, NETCONF, REST APIs for network device communication
* **Database Systems**: Experience with time-series databases (InfluxDB, TimescaleDB) for network metrics and traditional databases
* **Cloud Platforms**: AWS/Azure/GCP experience with focus on networking services, load balancers, and auto-scaling
* **Monitoring Tools**: Experience with network monitoring protocols, log aggregation, and observability platforms
* **Security**: Knowledge of network security principles, VPN configurations, and secure device access methods
* **DevOps**: CI/CD pipelines, containerization (Docker/Kubernetes), and infrastructure automation

  

**Domain-Specific Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Network Engineering, or related technical field
* 8-10 years of full-stack development experience with 3+ years in network management or infrastructure software
* Strong understanding of TCP/IP, OSI model, routing protocols, and enterprise networking concepts
* Experience with network device APIs (Cisco, Juniper, Aruba, Ubiquiti, etc.)
* Knowledge of WiFi standards (802.11), network switching concepts, and routing protocols
* Experience building SaaS platforms for enterprise customers
* Familiarity with network automation tools (Ansible, Puppet) and Infrastructure as Code

5ccdb9de.title: Technical Account Manager
5ccdb9de.description:
**About Refold**

Refold is building the next-generation AI platform that replaces enterprise integration and consultants. We’re pioneering autonomous AI agents that understand complex enterprise systems, generate production-ready code, and operate at a scale no consulting firm can match. Today, we’re starting with integrations—a $50B market. Tomorrow, we’re building towards a world where AI agents handle any complex cognitive work.

Traction: Serving 20+ enterprise customers with Fortune 500 deployments, processing 10M+ API calls/day. Refold was founded by Jugal Anchalia & Abhishek Kumar, who sold their previous startup to Netmeds; they have also been featured in Forbes 30 Under 30. They have experience at organisations such as Nomura, JioMart, InstaMojo, IIT Kharagpur, and IIT Roorkee. We are funded by marquee investors, including Eniac Ventures, Tidal Ventures, Karman Ventures, Ahead VC & Better Capital.

**We’re assembling a founding team of people who learn fast, raise the bar, and shape the company from day one.**

**The Role:**

The Technical Account Manager is the single point of contact who owns the customer journey from kickoff to go-live and beyond, as the steward of account health, adoption, and success. Sitting at the intersection of program management, customer success, and technical account management, you orchestrate complex, AI-native integration delivery so customers don’t just go live — they adopt, expand, and succeed.

You’re technical enough to lead the conversation and run technical account management. Your edge is exceptional communication and structured program management. You own onboarding, scoping, planning, adoption, and escalations; partner with the Architects and FDEs who build, and surface expansion signals to the Growth team. We’re looking for an outstanding communicator and program manager who thrives in ambiguity and holds the business and technical picture at once.

* **Team:**
  Small, high-impact delivery team working closely with Architects, Engineers, Product Support, and Founders.
* **You own:**
  Onboarding, scoping, project planning, implementation, adoption, success, escalations, and account health.
* **You’ll work with**
  : CIOs, CTOs, VPs of Engineering, and integration leaders at Fortune 500 and high-growth SaaS companies.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* **Own Enterprise Delivery**
  - Own the enterprise relationship from kick-off to go-live & beyond — managing expectations and maintaining executive alignment.
* **Think like a strategic advisor**
  . Challenge assumptions, pressure-test what was scoped, and recommend the approach that actually solves the customer’s core business problem — not just the one that was asked for.
* **Lead onboarding and scoping**
  . Run post-sales discovery and alignment workshops to refine requirements, success metrics, and a delivery plan that survives contact with the customer’s real systems.
* **Own planning and execution.**
  Plan and manage implementation phases, milestones, dependencies, risks, and stakeholder communication across multiple concurrent engagements.
* **Drive adoption and value realisation**
  . Make sure delivered integrations are actually adopted and track the outcomes that matter, against a clear account-health framework.
* **Drive expansion and product direction**
  -  Spot and surface expansion opportunities to the growth team, relay customer feedback and platform gaps to Product and Engineering.

**Required Skills & Abilities:**

* 5–8 years in technology consulting, solution delivery, program management, customer success, or technical account management.
* Exceptional communication and stakeholder management — this is the core of the role. You build trust and drive alignment with everyone from engineers to C-level executives.
* Strong, structured program and project management across multiple concurrent enterprise engagements — milestones, dependencies, risks, and crisp status communication.
* A success-and-adoption mindset — you measure yourself by whether the customer adopts, expands usage, and realises value, not just whether the project shipped.
* Enough technical fluency to lead integration discussions, run technical account management, and challenge assumptions — you don’t need to write code, and you have the Architects as your technical depth.
* A structured thinker who’s comfortable navigating ambiguity and complex enterprise environments.
* A track record of building long-term, trusted relationships through clarity, confidence, and results.

**Nice to Have:**

* Familiarity with AI / agentic concepts and how AI-native integration platforms deliver value.
* Solid understanding of enterprise integrations, workflows, or automation platforms.
* Experience with enterprise systems such as SAP, Oracle, Microsoft, Salesforce, or Workday.
* Familiarity with iPaaS or workflow automation platforms (Workato, Boomi, MuleSoft, Zapier, Merge).
* Background in management consulting, digital transformation, or business systems analysis.
* Startup or early-stage company experience.

**Why Join Refold AI?**

* Fast-growing seed-stage company (raised $6.5M from Eniac Ventures & Tidal Ventures)
* Founding team opportunity to shape engineering culture and technical direction from day one
* Cutting-edge AI + infrastructure tech solving complex, high-value enterprise problems
* Early traction with Fortune 500 clients and high-growth software companies
* Direct line of sight to leadership and future engineering management path
* Work with a small, exceptional team that ships fast and celebrates bold ideas

7ed7abc4.title: Technical Program Manager, Stores Application Security
7ed7abc4.description:
**Description**
Amazon Application Security is looking for a security-focused Technical Program Manager who wants to make a difference and support Amazon builders to ensure that protecting customer data is at the forefront of all development.
  
  
Our team approaches security challenges with empathy and curiosity to help Amazon builders identify areas of improvement and learn how to navigate the highly dynamic space of application security. Amazon Application Security focuses on enabling our builders to provide a secure and trustworthy experience to our customers without compromising the overall customer experience.
  
  
In this role you will work directly with security teams and Amazon builders providing direct front line support and security expertise to Amazon teams.
  
  
You’ll also find this role will routinely challenge your background in technical product ownership, process development, operational and management skills, project management, critical thinking, relationship-building, and problem-solving. You’ll also find yourself challenged in unique ways when operating at the massive scale of Amazon, unique to a select few corporations in the world. You must be self-directed and open to new challenges, adept at prioritization, innovation, and collaborating with others.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Plan, organize, and manage all phases of the project lifecycle ensuring successful delivery. This includes defining success criteria, developing and managing project governance plans, project schedules, team goals, communication strategies and project milestones.
* Collaborate with internal customers (senior business leaders, development teams, application security engineering teams and other partner security teams) to understand their needs, their business and how we can improve their security posture.
* Architect and manage internal scope of work documents with the customer clearly defining success criteria and timelines. Hold all stakeholders accountable to these documents through the project lifecycle, escalating as necessary.
* Build and manage relationships with key internal stakeholders and security teams and while advocating on behalf of our customers to deliver on their security goals.
* Guide the evolution and adoption of internal security support solutions, at times with complex priorities, prioritizing the work most beneficial to Amazon builders.
* Use knowledge of software system design to scope architecture, review associated threat models, educate customers on potential severity of security findings and guide developer and security engineering teams through remediation.
* Define and implement best practice methods, processes, tools and continuous improvement initiatives aimed at scaling and increasing the efficiency of Amazon’s security guidance and builder support processes.
* Own the creation and delivery of business proposals (growth, new areas of focus, etc) and metrics to security leadership.
* Proactively identify and manage program risk, identifying paths to overcome risks, and escalating when necessary
* Work effectively and make sound decisions in a dynamic environment with changing priorities.
* Influence, negotiate, resolve conflicts and achieve results through others who are not direct reports.
* Foster a positive work environment leveraging existing skills in active listening, encouraging diverse perspectives and adapting to a variety of personality types.

**About The Team**
Diverse Experiences
  
  
Amazon Security values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  
  
Why Amazon Security
  
  
At Amazon, security is central to maintaining customer trust and delivering delightful customer experiences. Our organization is responsible for creating and maintaining a high bar for security across all of Amazon’s products and services. We offer talented security professionals the chance to accelerate their careers with opportunities to build experience in a wide variety of areas including cloud, devices, retail, entertainment, healthcare, operations, and physical stores.
  
  
Work/Life Balance
  
  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.
  
  
Inclusive Team Culture
  
  
In Amazon Security, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Ongoing DEI events and learning experiences inspire us to continue learning and to embrace our uniqueness. Addressing the toughest security challenges requires that we seek out and celebrate a diversity of ideas, perspectives, and voices.
  
  
Mentorship and Career growth
  
  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, training, and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 3+ years of technical product or program management experience
* 3+ years of project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, quality, along with risk and critical path management experience
* Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules
* 5+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience working with security teams

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. **Title:**
Enterprise Architect

**Experience:**
15–25 Years

**Location:**
Bangalore/Pune/Chennai/Hyderabad

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a seasoned Enterprise Architect to drive technology strategy, architecture, solution design, and transformation initiatives across complex enterprise environments.

The role will partner closely with customers, business leaders, technology stakeholders, and engineering teams to understand business challenges and translate them into scalable, secure, resilient, and commercially viable technology solutions.

The ideal candidate will bring a strong consulting-led mindset, deep expertise in modern enterprise architecture, and the ability to operate at both strategic and hands-on technical levels. The role will also play a key part in shaping technology capabilities, supporting strategic sales pursuits, driving innovation, and mentoring senior and emerging technologists.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* **Enterprise Architecture & Solution Strategy:**
  Define end-to-end architecture strategies and technology solutions aligned to business objectives, enterprise standards, and long-term technology roadmaps.
* **Client Advisory & Consulting:**
  Engage with CXOs, business leaders, and technology stakeholders to understand business challenges, provide technology thought leadership, and shape pragmatic solution strategies.
* **AI & Agentic Transformation:**
  Architect and drive AI-first and Agentic AI solutions across business and engineering domains, with hands-on experience taking solutions from POC/prototype through production and enterprise scale.
  **(Mandatory production/go-live experience)**
* **Sales & Solutioning:**
  Actively participate in strategic sales pursuits, RFPs, and proposals by shaping solution architecture, defining technical approaches, estimating effort, identifying skill requirements, and articulating value to clients.
* **Architecture & Engineering Leadership:**
  Provide technical direction across engagements and establish the right architecture principles, engineering practices, delivery methodologies, and governance mechanisms to ensure successful outcomes.
* **Technical Problem Solving:**
  Act as a senior technical authority, quickly identifying and resolving complex architectural and engineering challenges across engagements.
* **Modernization & Transformation:**
  Lead legacy modernization, cloud transformation, cloud migration, platform modernization, and application transformation initiatives.
* **Technology Capability Building:**
  Identify emerging technologies and establish new technical capabilities, frameworks, accelerators, and reusable assets that strengthen the organization's technology portfolio.
* **Thought Leadership & Mentoring:**
  Develop technology points of view, contribute to architecture communities, and mentor architects and senior technologists to build a strong engineering and architecture talent pipeline.

**Must-Have Experience & Expertise:**

* 15–25 years of experience in Enterprise Architecture, Solution Architecture, Product Engineering, Technology Consulting, and large-scale solutioning.
* Proven ability to define and execute enterprise architecture strategies aligned with business vision, technology strategy, and organizational objectives.
* Strong expertise in modern enterprise architectures, including:
* Microservices & Cloud-Native Architecture
* Event-Driven Architecture
* API-led Architecture
* Domain-Driven Design
* Serverless Architecture
* Kubernetes & Docker
* DevOps & CI/CD
* Distributed Systems
* Scalability, Reliability, Availability & Performance Engineering
* Strong hands-on experience with at least one major cloud platform — AWS, Azure or Google Cloud — with a strong understanding of cloud architecture and enterprise adoption patterns.
* Must have proven hands-on experience architecting and productionizing Agentic AI solutions, with the ability to take AI/LLM-based solutions from POC to secure, scalable, enterprise-grade production environments.
* Experience designing and implementing Agentic AI architectures, including AI agents, LLM orchestration, RAG, tool/function calling, AI workflows, and enterprise system integration.
* Demonstrated experience in legacy transformation, application modernization, and cloud migration across complex enterprise landscapes.
* Hands-on experience with one or more API Management / API Gateway platforms, preferably two, such as MuleSoft, Apigee, WSO2, AWS API Gateway, Kong, or equivalent.
* Strong hands-on understanding of Java, Spring Boot, containers, SQL/NoSQL databases, caching, observability/APM, and cloud-native application development.
* Strong experience with structured and unstructured data platforms, including technologies such as MS SQL, Oracle, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, DynamoDB or equivalent.
* Proven experience architecting high-scale, high-performance products and platforms, including PaaS and SaaS architectures.
* Strong experience applying Domain-Driven Design to complex enterprise applications and distributed systems.
* Experience building new technology capabilities, platforms, frameworks, and reusable engineering assets.
* Strong track record of providing technical leadership for RFPs, proposals, solution presentations, and strategic sales engagements.
* Proven ability to lead consulting-led client conversations, influence senior stakeholders, and translate business requirements into compelling technology solutions.

**Good to Have:**

* Experience architecting mobile-first applications, including native and hybrid application ecosystems.
* Exposure to emerging technologies and the ability to evaluate their enterprise applicability, business value, and architectural implications

**Azure Platform Architect**
to lead the design, governance, scalability, roadmap, and optimization of large-scale Azure cloud platforms. The ideal candidate should possess strong expertise in

.

Azure Platform Architecture, Azure Landing Zones, FinOps, Azure Networking, Terraform, Infrastructure Provisioning, Azure Governance, Security Architecture, Cloud Operations, Automation, Platform Roadmap Development, and Enterprise-Scale Azure Management.

Our mission is to bring health in people’s hands by making self-care as simple as it should be. For half a billion consumers worldwide – and counting. At the core of this mission is our 100 loved brands, our 11,000-strong global team, our 13 best-in-class manufacturing sites and 4 specialized science and innovation development centers. Headquartered in France, Opella is the proud maker of many of the world’s most loved brands, including Allegra, Buscopan, Doliprane, Dulcolax, Enterogermina, Essentiale and Mucosolvan. As a globally certified B Corp company, we are active players in the journey towards healthier people and planet. Find out more about our mission at www.opella.com. About the job: We are seeking an experienced Program Manager to drive the execution of Opella’s Manufacturing & Supply Data and AI Transformation. This role focuses on translating strategy into action — coordinating cross-regional initiatives, accelerating delivery, and embedding AI-enabled capabilities across the global Manufacturing & Supply network. The ideal candidate is a strong operator who brings a passion for AI and technology advancement, thrives in complex environments, and excels at orchestrating large-scale transformation programs with speed and focus. Demonstrated experience deploying data, analytics, automation, or AI capabilities at scale. **Manager of Solution Consulting**
to join our Professional Services team. In this role, you’ll lead and mentor a team of Solution Consultants, ensuring consistent and successful service delivery across engagements. You'll partner closely with cross-functional teams, align consulting efforts with product capabilities, and champion best practices that elevate our customer experience. If you thrive in a fast-paced SaaS environment and are excited about shaping the future of solution consulting, we want to hear from you.
  
  
**Who you are:**

* Understanding of enterprise SaaS business and implementation models and process
* Passionate problem solver with the ability to balance both quantitative and qualitative elements to devise an overall solution
* Ability to understand a client’s business case for purchasing a software platform, consult on solution approach and oversee implementation and delivery of work product
* Critical thinking, analysis, troubleshooting, and problem-solving expertise
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with proven ability to initiate and manage relationships with customers and stakeholders at all levels
* Advanced proficiency with the entire Microsoft Office Suite, with an emphasis on Excel, Word and PowerPoint
* Knowledge of data systems and structures
* Experience with all aspects of the Seismic platform
* Proficiency with Salesforce.com, and a solid understanding of Salesforce Object structure a plus
* Bachelor’s Degree required, with a preference for technical, engineering and CS backgrounds
* Strong understanding of project management and risk mitigation principles.
* Proficiency in resource planning and team management
* Ability to leverage AI tools to improve efficiency and deliver high-quality outcomes while establishing an AI first mindset with the team
* Strong understanding of integrating software for bidirectional flow of information

**What you’ll be doing:**

* Ensure consistent, efficient, and excellent solution delivery by empowering Solution Consultants in your practice area with product and industry knowledge, skills, and measures.
* Develop, refine, and maintain a delivery framework, methodology content, and best practice tools and templates for your practice area.
* Drive the reliability of consulting efforts and delivery across regions for successful ongoing Services engagements.
* Serve as the primary contact with the Product team to drive alignment and provide bi-directional input and feedback on product and platform capabilities within your practice area.
* Lead a team of Solution Consultants, architects and engineers providing guidance to enhance their thought leadership capabilities across all Solution Consulting resources.

cf7069a7.description:
Are you ready to make an impact at DTCC?
  
  
Do you want to work on innovative projects, collaborate with a dynamic and supportive team, and receive investment in your professional development? At DTCC, we are at the forefront of innovation in the financial markets. We are committed to helping our employees grow and succeed. We believe that you have the skills and drive to make a real impact. We foster a thriving internal community and are committed to creating a workplace that looks like the world that we serve.
  
  
The Information Technology group delivers secure, reliable technology solutions that enable DTCC to be the trusted infrastructure of the global capital markets. The team delivers high-quality information through activities that include development of essential, building infrastructure capabilities to meet client needs and implementing data standards and governance.
  
  
**Pay And Benefits**

* Competitive compensation, including base pay and annual incentive
* Comprehensive health and life insurance and well-being benefits, based on location
* Pension / Retirement benefits
* Paid Time Off and Personal/Family Care, and other leaves of absence when needed to support your physical, financial, and emotional well-being.
* DTCC offers a flexible/hybrid model of 3 days onsite and 2 days remote (onsite Tuesdays, Wednesdays and a third day unique to each team or employee).

**The Impact You Will Have In This Role**
The successful candidate will play a strategic role in shaping DTCC's Data Strategy and guide the organization in implementing it. They will develop the foundational standards, architectures, guidance, and controls for enterprise data capabilities to implement and monitor their implementation across the enterprise. They will develop data and semantic models to ensure our data is fit for purpose in transactional, analytical systems and by AI models and Agents.
  
  
**Qualifications**

* Minimum of 10 years of related experience
* Bachelor's degree preferred or equivalent experience

**Talents Needed For Success**
Technical Skills
  
  

* The candidate must be familiar with Enterprise data architecture frameworks - Applies TOGAF, Zachman, or DAMA-DMBOK to design enterprise-wide data architectures. Produces architecture views (conceptual, logical, physical, operational) aligned to business capability models.
* Experience producing Reference architectures - Authors reusable reference architectures and blueprints for common patterns (e.g., regulatory reporting, real-time risk, MDM hub). Ensures consistency across solution teams.
* Architecture documentation & ADRs - Produces clear, maintainable architecture documentation including Architecture Decision Records (ADRs), sequence diagrams, component diagrams, and system context diagrams.
* Experience with data integration architecture - Designs scalable integration patterns including batch ETL/ELT, Change Data Capture (CDC), event streaming, and API-led connectivity. Understands idempotency requirements in financial reconciliation workflows.
* Experience with data mesh & domain-driven design - Applies domain-driven design (DDD) and data mesh principles — bounded contexts, domain ownership, data-as-a-product — to decompose monolithic data platforms without sacrificing enterprise consistency.
* Experience with cloud data warehouses - Hands-on experience with Snowflake, Databricks (Lakehouse), Google BigQuery, Azure Synapse, or AWS Redshift. Understands platform-specific optimization levers (clustering, partitioning, materialization).
* Experience with data lakehouse architecture - Designs medallion (bronze/silver/gold) architectures. Understands Delta Lake, Apache Iceberg, and Apache Hudi for ACID transactions, schema evolution, and time-travel on object storage.
* Familiar with the tools in the modern data stack
* Subject matter expertise with Financial data domains - Deep knowledge of core FS data domains: general ledger, trade & position, risk, payments, customer/KYC, and reference data (instruments, counterparties, currencies).
* Familiar with data governance principles - Champions data ownership, stewardship, and policy enforcement. Familiar with DAMA-DMBOK, enterprise glossary management, and cross-domain data standards governance.
* Experience with semantic layer & data product design - Designs reusable, business-aligned semantic layers (metrics layers, logical data products) that decouple business logic from physical storage. Ensures consistent KPI definitions across the enterprise.

**Leadership Skills**

* Technical vision & architecture direction - Sets the long-term data modeling and architecture strategy aligned to business and regulatory roadmaps. Establishes guardrails and patterns that scale across the organization.
* Executive & board-level communication - Translates complex data architecture and modeling concepts into clear business impact narratives for C-suite, risk committees, and regulators. No jargon, full accountability.
* Cross-functional collaboration - Works effectively with business analysts, software engineers, risk, finance, compliance, and product teams to align on data definitions, integration contracts, and model fitness for purpose.
* Technology vendor evaluation & negotiation - Evaluates vendor platforms against enterprise requirements using structured scoring. Leads proof-of-concept exercises and negotiates commercial terms for data platform and tooling contracts.
* Mentoring & technical coaching - Develops junior and mid-level team members through pair work, structured feedback, and stretch assignments. Builds team capability and independence rather than individual dependency on key staff.
* Familiar with agile / scrum delivery - Runs or participates effectively in agile ceremonies. Breaks down complex data modeling and architecture initiatives into sprint-sized deliverables with clear acceptance criteria and definition of done.
* Architecture governance & technology standards - Maintains the enterprise architecture standards register, technology radar, and approved patterns catalog. Manages exceptions process and ensures standards keep pace with platform evolution.

Actual salary is determined based on the role, location, individual experience, skills, and other considerations. We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

8e028587.title: AI Security Architect - Vice President
8e028587.description:
**Who we are looking for**

  

The AI Security Architect is a hands-on technical role responsible for designing, implementing, and reviewing security controls for AI, machine learning, and generative AI solutions across State Street’s technology environment. This role partners closely with engineering, product security, and platform teams to help ensure AI capabilities are delivered securely, responsibly, and in alignment with regulatory requirements. This position is ideal for a security professional with strong foundations in application, cloud, or product security who is building deeper expertise in AI security architecture and risk management.

  

**Why this role is important to us**

  

Global Cybersecurity (GCS) protects State Street and its clients from the impact of cyber-attacks against systems by understanding the risks these attacks present and mitigating them through a robust, continuously evolving, cybersecurity program and control environment.

  

Fusion & Security Operations (F&SO) is one of five functions that make up GCS. F&SO works to provide real-time knowledge of cyber threats of today collectively to better prepare State Street for threats of tomorrow.

  

**What you will be responsible for**

* Contribute to the design and implementation of secure architecture patterns for AI/ML and Generative AI systems, including data pipelines, model access, and AI-enabled applications.
* Support the development and documentation of AI security standards, reference architectures, and guardrails.
* Participate in architecture and design reviews for AI-related initiatives, providing security guidance under senior architect direction.
* Partner with engineering teams to ensure security requirements are considered early in solution design.
* Perform AI-focused threat modeling for AI services, models, and data flows.
* Identify security risks such as data leakage, prompt injection, insecure model access, OSS vulnerabilities, and misuse scenarios.
* Work with senior architects and security partners to recommend appropriate mitigations and compensating controls.
* Support integration of AI security controls into software development and DevSecOps workflows.
* Assist in defining security requirements and validation checks for AI pipelines and platforms.
* Help develop repeatable patterns and templates that enable teams to adopt AI securely with less friction.
* Assist with security reviews for emerging AI capabilities, including GenAI tools, internal AI services, and developer productivity use cases.
* Stay informed on AI security trends, tooling, and common risk patterns through research and internal knowledge sharing.
* Contribute ideas and observations on improving AI security practices across the organization.
* Ensure AI security designs align with internal policies and external standards (e.g., NIST, ISO, FFIEC concepts).
* Support audit, risk, and compliance efforts by helping document architecture decisions and controls.
  

**What we value**

These skills will help you succeed in this role

* Participate in post-incident reviews and action tracking for AI-related security events.
* Work closely with security engineering, product security, platform, and data teams to resolve AI security concerns.
* Communicate technical risks and recommendations clearly to engineering audiences.

c6cd14a1.title: Platform Engineer & Cloud Ops Engineer
c6cd14a1.description:
**This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Platform Engineer & Cloud Ops Engineer based in India.**
This role focuses on building, operating, and continuously improving secure, reliable cloud platforms across multi-cloud environments. You will bridge platform engineering, cloud operations, automation, and cybersecurity to support resilient infrastructure and data protection. The position offers opportunities to work extensively with GCP, AWS, Kubernetes, Terraform, CI/CD, observability, and service mesh technologies. At the senior level, you will influence platform architecture, technical standards, reliability, cost optimization, and disaster recovery. You will also mentor engineers and collaborate with distributed teams and technical stakeholders. The role is ideal for an experienced cloud professional who combines strong hands-on expertise with architectural thinking and operational ownership.
  
  
**Accountabilities**

* Lead the architecture, deployment, and evolution of complex multi-cloud environments across GCP and AWS, covering networking, compute, storage, IAM, load balancing, and multi-environment infrastructure design.
* Define scalable platform standards and reusable engineering patterns, including Terraform modules, Kubernetes cluster blueprints, golden paths, and consistent deployment practices across development, staging, and production environments.
* Provision, configure, maintain, and automate cloud infrastructure using Infrastructure as Code, with Terraform as the primary technology and CloudFormation or ARM where appropriate.
* Design, operate, and support production-grade Kubernetes platforms, preferably GKE, including upgrades, autoscaling, node pools, namespaces, RBAC policies, and application deployment standards using Helm and Kustomize.
* Support and manage service mesh capabilities such as Istio for traffic management, mutual TLS, observability, and security, while promoting safe and consistent application delivery.
* Build and maintain GitLab CI/CD pipelines for infrastructure and application delivery, automating operational processes and reducing manual effort.
* Monitor platform health and performance using Datadog metrics, logs, traces, alerts, and SLOs, while troubleshooting complex issues, supporting incident response, and contributing to post-incident reviews.
* Own platform reliability, scalability, capacity planning, and disaster recovery design, maintaining runbooks and dashboards and participating in or leading on-call operations.
* Drive cloud cost optimization and FinOps practices through right-sizing, governance, and ongoing evaluation of cloud consumption and infrastructure efficiency.
* Mentor junior and mid-level engineers, provide technical direction, review designs, and communicate architectural decisions clearly to technical and business stakeholders.
* Collaborate effectively with global, cross-functional, and distributed teams to deliver platform initiatives and continuously improve operational practices.

**Requirements**

* 3+ years of experience in cloud infrastructure, platform engineering, or DevOps for Platform Engineer-level roles, or 8+ years of experience with leadership or architect-level responsibilities for Senior Platform Engineer-level roles.
* Deep, hands-on expertise with GCP and/or AWS, including services such as Compute Engine, GKE, VPC, Storage, IAM, Load Balancing, EC2, EKS, and S3.
* Strong production Kubernetes experience, preferably with GKE architecture, cluster upgrades, autoscaling, node pools, RBAC, Helm, and Kustomize.
* Expert-level Terraform experience, including reusable modules, multi-environment Infrastructure as Code, remote state, and infrastructure consistency.
* Proven experience developing and supporting CI/CD automation at scale, particularly with GitLab pipelines.
* Strong knowledge of observability and monitoring practices, including metrics, logs, traces, alerting, and SLO management with platforms such as Datadog.
* Experience with Istio and service mesh concepts including traffic management, mTLS, observability, and security.
* Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills, with the ability to diagnose complex cloud, infrastructure, and platform issues.
* Clear communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across global and cross-functional teams and communicate technical decisions to different audiences.
* A proactive and ownership-oriented mindset, with the ability to balance hands-on engineering, strategic thinking, operational priorities, and continuous improvement.
* Experience with GitOps tools such as ArgoCD or Flux, progressive delivery techniques, FinOps, cloud cost optimization, Python, Go, Bash, Linux administration, Vault, Packer, service catalogs, or self-service platforms is advantageous.
* Experience working in regulated environments such as HIPAA, SOC 2, or ISO 27001 is a plus.
* Relevant certifications such as Google Professional Cloud Architect, AWS Solutions Architect Professional, or Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA) are valued.

**Benefits**

* Opportunity to work on complex multi-cloud infrastructure and modern platform engineering initiatives.
* Exposure to technologies including GCP, AWS, Kubernetes, Terraform, GitLab CI/CD, Datadog, and Istio.
* Opportunity to influence platform architecture, standards, reliability, automation, and cloud cost efficiency.
* Senior-level opportunity to provide technical leadership, mentor engineers, and shape platform engineering practices.
* Collaborative environment involving global and cross-functional teams.
* Opportunity to contribute to automation, self-service deployment paths, and the continuous improvement of cloud operations.
* Role with direct impact on platform reliability, security, scalability, operational efficiency, and disaster recovery.

**How Jobgether Works**

**AI-powered matching process**
to ensure your application is reviewed quickly, objectively, and fairly against the role's core requirements. Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team.
  
  
We appreciate your interest and wish you the best!
  
  
Why Apply Through Jobgether?
  
  
**Data Privacy Notice:**
By submitting your application, you acknowledge that Jobgether will process your personal data to evaluate your candidacy and share relevant information with the hiring employer. This processing is based on legitimate interest and pre-contractual measures under applicable data protection laws (including GDPR). You may exercise your rights (access, rectification, erasure, objection) at any time.

These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. 71408f7a.title: Solution Consultant
71408f7a.description:
**Role Overview**
-----------------

As a Presales Consultant at Keka HR, you will be the technical and domain expert during the sales cycle. You will engage with prospective customers, understand their HR / people‑ops challenges, map those to Keka’s product/features, conduct demos or proofs of concept, and enable the sales team to close deals. You’ll act as a bridge between Product, Sales, and Customers, ensuring the proposed solutions are feasible, scalable, and aligned with customer needs.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Conduct discovery sessions / workshops with prospects to understand their HR systems, process workflows, technology environment, business needs, and pain points.
* Map prospect requirements to Keka’s product modules / marketplace / integration capabilities / APIs & propose tailored solutions.
* Deliver product demonstrations, proof‑of‑concepts (POCs), and custom demos that illustrate how Keka can solve customer problems.
* Support the sales team in responding to RFIs, RFPs, and other technical proposal requests.
* Create technical proposals, statements of work (SoWs), and commercial documentation as needed.
* Clarify non‑functional requirements: infrastructure, security, compliance, data migration, integrations, etc.
* Liaise with Product and Engineering teams to gather inputs, clarify feature gaps, and feed back customer requirements.

The role is technical and commercial in equal measure. You will scope customer requirements, design the solution, price and propose it, and then stay involved through delivery. You will build and lead a small team of solution consultants and own the technical coverage across our practice areas.

This is a hands-on leadership role. You will personally scope the most significant engagements, not delegate them.

  

**What you will own**

* **Customer scoping.** Run discovery with customers, understand what they actually need, and translate it into a solution and an estimate.
* **Proposals.** Own technical proposals and solution documents end to end.
* **Solution design.** Design the environments and configurations that deliver each engagement.
* **Team leadership.** Build and lead a small team of solution consultants; own their technical development and certification coverage.
* **Technical coverage.** Ensure the team collectively covers every technology domain we sell into, with no domain resting on one person.
* **Delivery coordination.** Work with delivery and engineering teams so what is sold is what gets built.

  

**Essential requirements**

* 8–12 years in presales, solution consulting or solution architecture.
* Demonstrable record of scoping and winning technical engagements, not only delivering them.
* Strong hands-on capability across cloud, data and AI, and business application platforms.
* Experience designing training, lab or enablement environments at scale.
* Experience leading a small technical team.
* Excellent written and verbal communication with senior customer stakeholders.
* At least two current role-based technology certifications, with the remainder of the required coverage completed within 90 days of joining.

  

**Desirable**

* Experience in a technology partner or distributor ecosystem.
* Background in cloud labs, skilling or enablement platforms.
* Commercial modelling — pricing, margin and effort estimation.
* Consulting or professional services background.

  

**Who this role suits**

You will do well here if you enjoy the part of the sale where the customer stops talking about outcomes and starts asking how it will actually work. The people who succeed in this role build the environment themselves before promising it.

This role is probably not the right fit if you have worked purely in delivery without commercial exposure, or purely in sales without hands-on technical depth.

  

**What we offer**

* Ownership of a new function, with the freedom to define how it works.
* Direct reporting line to the Managing Director and involvement in commercial strategy.
* A small senior team where your work is visible to the people making decisions.
* Funded certification relevant to the role, with time allocated to prepare.
* Compensation benchmarked to the Coimbatore market for the experience band.

**Position**

**Pre-Sales Manager**

**Experience**

**5-12 Years**

**Grade**

**T3XX - Senior Manager / AVP**

**Location**

**Mumbai/ Chennai**

**About FuEL**

**FuEL**is **Intellect's Flagship program** designed to develop the next generation of transformation leaders for the global Fintech/Insuretech industry.

Created for high-potential professionals, the program equips participants to move beyond operational excellence and become trusted advisors who help financial institutions reimagine business models, accelerate digital & AI transformation and deliver exceptional customer experiences.

Your journey begins with an immersive four-week learning experience covering Digital Transformation, Product Immersion, Design Thinking and AI-led Banking Innovation. You'll gain deep exposure to Intellect's award-winning banking platforms across Consumer Banking, Corporate Banking, Transaction Banking, Capital Markets, Wealth and Insurance, while working alongside some of the industry's foremost banking, product and technology experts.

Explore more at: www.intellectdesign.com

**The Opportunity**

The best presales leaders don't just respond to RFPs—they shape how clients think about their business challenges before a competitive process even begins. This role is for that kind of leader.

As **Presales Manager**, you will own the solutioning agenda across complex, high-value deal pursuits—bringing together deep banking domain expertise, strategic thinking, consultative selling, and genuine individual and integrated product mastery to drive measurable customer value and win business that matters. You will be leading efforts to drive new sales, cross sell, and upsell at Intellect’s Key relationships engaging at the CXO level and solution with authority, and build the presales capability that turns market opportunities into signed engagements.

You will engage with business leaders across Retail Banking, Wholesale Banking, Transaction Banking, Payments, Lending, Treasury, and Wealth Management to understand strategic objectives, diagnose business challenges, and translate them into differentiated transformation opportunities.  
  
The role requires the ability to ask the right questions, challenge conventional thinking, bring external market perspectives, and guide customers from problem identification to solution vision.

You should be comfortable in working in a networked org design and in taking ownership of the outcome therefore to pool the best resources and solution that OneIntellect has to offer to its customers. This is a role for someone who is as comfortable in a boardroom solutioning session as they are shaping product strategy conversations with internal roadmap teams.

**Role Definition**

The Pre-Sales Manager primarily drives the early-stage sales cycle by actively shaping and qualifying pipeline opportunities through discovery and validation. They are responsible for translating customer requirements into compelling value propositions and demonstrating product value, while providing critical support in later pipeline stages to convert opportunities into successful deals.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Prospect Understanding**  
Engage with banking executives, business heads, product owners, and operations leaders to understand strategic priorities. Analyse banking business models, revenue drivers, operational challenges, and competitive pressures. Translate market trends into actionable transformation opportunities. Actively validate critical deal qualifiers—including Need/Problem, Decision Makers, Customer’s Timeline, Customer’s Budget runway, and Proposal intent to successfully graduate opportunities.

**2. Consultative Value Selling**Create Business Value to shape opportunities, influence decisions and improve win probability. Ability to articulate measurable business outcomes, ROI, and value propositions aligned to customer objectives. Help banks rethink customer journeys, operating models, and product strategies.

**3. Product Demonstrations and Client Workshops**  
Conduct high-quality product demonstrations, discovery workshops, proof-of-concept sessions, technical presentations, and solution walkthroughs for prospective clients aligned to their business needs. Ensure demo is aligned to use cases to prospect’s requirements and perform Demo Diagnostic

**4. RFP/RFI and Bid Support**Lead responses to RFPs, RFIs, questionnaires, and proposal documents. Ensure that responses are accurate, complete, compelling, and aligned with the customer’s stated requirements.

**5. Solutioning and Proposal Development**  
Design tailored high quality solution propositions using the company’s product capabilities, platform strengths, implementation approach, and domain expertise. Support the creation of scope documents, solution architecture inputs, effort estimates, implementation plans, timelines, assumptions, exclusions, and commercial inputs. Ensure that the proposed solution is practical, differentiated, and aligned to the customer’s needs.

**6. Coordination with Product, Engineering and Delivery Teams**  
Work closely with Product, Engineering, Architecture, Delivery, Implementation, and Support teams to validate solution feasibility, effort assumptions, customisation needs, integration approach, dependencies, and delivery risks.

**7. Sales Enablement**Equip the Sales team with product collateral, demo scripts, solution notes, competitive insights, objection-handling points, customer-specific messaging, and proof points to support effective selling.

**8. Market and Customer Feedback Loop**  
Capture feedback from prospects, clients, partners, competitive situations, demonstrations, and RFPs, and share structured insights with Product teams for roadmap, positioning, and solution improvement.

**9. Deal Conversion Support**Actively drive the early-stage sales cycle by shaping and graduating qualified opportunities. Act as a bridge between Sales, Product, and Delivery to ensure that the proposed solution is credible, client-specific, implementable, and capable of supporting successful deal closure.

**10. Knowledge Management**  
Maintain updated value proposition product decks, reusable proposal content, case studies, standard responses, FAQs, and solution artefacts to improve pre-sales productivity and consistency.

**11. Transition to Delivery**  
Support the handover from Sales to Delivery after deal closure by ensuring that the agreed scope, solution commitments, assumptions, risks, and client expectations are clearly documented and communicated.

**Experience & Qualifications**

 Extensive experience in the BFSI industry, with a strong track record in Presales, Solution Consulting, Product Consulting, or other customer-facing roles within banking, financial services, or fintech organizations.

 Deep domain expertise in one or more banking business areas, with the ability to understand customer needs, analyse business challenges, and design differentiated, practical, and commercially viable solution propositions.

 Proven experience leading complex sales pursuits, including customer discovery, executive workshops, product demonstrations and proof-of-concept engagements.

 Demonstrated ability to articulate product value, competitive differentiation, implementation strategy, and business outcomes, translating product capabilities into compelling customer-specific solutions.

 Strong commercial acumen with experience preparing solution proposals, scope documents, effort estimates, implementation plans, commercial inputs, and customer-facing collateral to support strategic business opportunities.

 Exceptional stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to engage and influence CXOs, business leaders, technical teams, partners, and cross-functional stakeholders across the sales lifecycle.

 Demonstrated ability to capture customer feedback, competitive intelligence, market trends, and emerging industry insights, leveraging them to strengthen product positioning, solution offerings, and continuous improvement.

 Proven success in enabling high-performing sales organizations through reusable solution assets, demo environments, knowledge repositories, and best practices, while ensuring a seamless transition from Sales to Delivery and consistently driving successful customer outcomes.

**Why This Role**

You will be operating at the forefront of banking transformation—where market strategy meets client needs, and where the quality of solutioning directly influences business success. You will have the opportunity, authority, and mandate to build a high-performing presales function that not only nurtures opportunities but also helps create them. If you're looking for a senior leadership role where your expertise, customer relationships, and strategic judgment can shape outcomes and drive meaningful business impact, this is the opportunity.

88c02198.title: ERP Integration Architect
88c02198.description:
**Position:** ERP Integration Architect

**Experience:** 8 + years

**Duration:** 6 Months + Extendible  
**Shift Timings:** 10 AM to 7 PM IST

**Location:** Hyderabad (Work From Office)

**Role Summary**

The ERP Integration Architect will own the technical discovery, architecture, data mapping, validation, and delivery of integrations between external ERP systems and our platform. The role requires deep, hands-on knowledge of Epicor, Infor, and SAP S/4HANA, as well as SAP-based internal enterprise systems such as SAP Torque and EMSAP.

The ideal candidate combines strong ERP platform expertise with modern integration fundamentals. This person must be comfortable working directly with customer and partner technical teams, ERP vendors, architects, and developers to analyze ERP data models, evaluate integration options (OData, BAPIs, IDocs, REST, ION BODs), map source payloads to a common data model, and drive an integration from initial discovery through production readiness.

This is not a DevOps or infrastructure operations role. The primary responsibility is ERP integration architecture and engineering: understanding how each ERP platform exposes its data, selecting the right integration pattern for each system, validating data semantics, documenting contracts, and ensuring that data moves correctly and securely between external ERP systems and our platform.

**What You Will Do**

* **Architect ERP integrations:** Analyze and design integrations from ERP systems, including Epicor (Eclipse and Kinetic/ERP 10), Infor, and SAP S/4HANA, into our platform for purchase orders, sales orders, order lines, vendors, customers, products, inventory, shipment status, and related business entities.
* **Integrate with SAP landscapes:** Connect our platform to SAP S/4HANA and SAP-based internal systems such as SAP Torque and EMSAP for order status, acknowledgements, line-level commitments, shipment information, tracking, estimated ship and delivery dates, and exception data.
* **Select the right SAP integration pattern:** Evaluate and implement SAP integration options including OData V2/V4 services, BAPIs, RFCs, IDocs, CDS views, and SAP BTP / Integration Suite (CPI), based on each client’s system landscape, authorization model, and IT constraints.
* **Work with Infor integration technologies:** Integrate via Infor ION, the ION API Gateway, and BODs (Business Object Documents), and map Infor data structures into the platform’s common data model.
* **Lead API and system discovery:** Work with customer and partner IT teams to obtain API documentation, sandbox environments, credentials, authentication details, sample payloads, custom module documentation (including non-standard SAP modules), rate limits, and production onboarding requirements.
* **Perform source-to-target data mapping:** Analyze ERP payloads and data models and map them into standardized target entities such as orders, order line items, shipments, shipment milestones, organizations, locations, products, exceptions, and alerts.
* **Define and maintain a common data model:** Translate ERP-specific schemas (items, customers, suppliers, purchase orders, sales orders, inventory, pricing) into a common structure, normalizing statuses, dates, units, and identifiers across Epicor, Infor, and SAP sources.
* **Implement and troubleshoot authentication:** Work with API keys, Basic Authentication, OAuth 2.0, SAML, bearer tokens, JWTs, client credentials, certificates, SAP user/authorization objects, and IP allowlisting where required.
* **Validate data correctness:** Compare raw payloads, transformed records, and expected business outcomes. Identify missing fields, ambiguous semantics, invalid status mappings, incorrect dates, duplicate events, and relationship mismatches across ERP sources.
* **Coordinate write-back integrations:** Help define and test controlled updates back into client ERP systems, including endpoint safety, permissions, optimistic concurrency, idempotency, audit evidence, and rollback or retry behavior.
* **Support event-driven data pipelines:** Define how raw ERP payloads are published to messaging systems such as Kafka, transformed into standardized events, validated, persisted, replayed, and routed to downstream workflows.
* **Document integration contracts:** Produce onboarding checklists, endpoint catalogs, authentication notes, request/response examples, mapping documents, sequence diagrams, test results, known limitations, and production handover material.
* **Collaborate across teams:** Work closely with solution architects, backend engineers, data engineers, QA, product teams, customer IT teams, ERP administrators, SAP Basis/security teams, and external API providers to move integrations forward and resolve blockers.
* **Own integration issues through resolution:** Investigate failures across source connectivity, authentication, request formation, schema changes, payload mapping, data quality, and downstream processing, and communicate findings clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

**Mandatory Skills**

* **8+ years of ERP integration, enterprise application integration, or middleware experience:** Strong preference for candidates who have delivered integrations across supply-chain, distribution, or manufacturing environments.
* **Hands-on experience with at least two of: Epicor, Infor, SAP S/4HANA:** Working knowledge of each platform’s data model, core transactional objects (purchase orders, sales orders, vendors, products, shipments), and native integration surfaces.
* **Strong SAP integration knowledge:** Deep understanding of OData (V2/V4), BAPIs, RFCs, and IDocs, plus practical awareness of authorization objects, custom Z-modules, and SAP BTP / CPI. Ability to analyze SAP-based internal systems such as SAP Torque and EMSAP, including non-standard modules and custom data structures.
* **Epicor integration experience:** Hands-on knowledge of Epicor APIs (Eclipse and/or Kinetic REST, BAQs, Business Objects), core ERP concepts, session/authentication handling, and controlled write-back operations.
* **Infor integration experience:** Working knowledge of Infor ION, ION API Gateway, and BOD-based data exchange.
* **Strong REST API fundamentals:** HTTP/HTTPS, methods, headers, status codes, query parameters, JSON/XML payloads, pagination, retries, rate limits, timeouts, idempotency, and API versioning.
* **Strong authentication and authorization knowledge:** Hands-on experience with API keys, OAuth 2.0, SAML, bearer tokens, JWTs, client credentials, certificates, and secure credential handling.
* **Data mapping and transformation skills:** Ability to analyze nested JSON/XML payloads and ERP table structures, identify source keys and business meaning, define mappings, normalize statuses and dates, and validate transformed output against target contracts.
* **Supply-chain domain knowledge:** Solid understanding of procurement, order-to-cash, purchase orders, acknowledgements, shipments, tracking, backorders, inventory, MRP/MPS, and vendor relationships.
* **Integration troubleshooting mindset:** Ability to isolate whether a failure originates in credentials, authentication, authorization, network access, request format, source data, ERP configuration, schema mismatch, transformation logic, or downstream processing.
* **Strong communication skills:** Ability to lead technical discussions with external partners and ERP vendors, ask precise questions, explain blockers, document evidence, and translate between business and technical stakeholders.
* **Strong documentation discipline:** Ability to produce clear API notes, mapping specifications, test scenarios, sequence diagrams, issue reports, onboarding checklists, and handover documentation.
* **Ownership and follow-through:** Ability to manage integration dependencies, coordinate with multiple parties, track open questions, and drive an integration from discovery to production readiness.

**Good to Have**

* **SAP BTP / Integration Suite (CPI) delivery experience:** Building and operating iFlows, mappings, and adapters for S/4HANA landscapes.
* **Middleware/iPaaS experience:** MuleSoft, Boomi, Azure Integration Services, or custom integration frameworks (Python/Node.js-based).
* **Kafka and event-driven integration knowledge:** Topics, partitions, keys, consumer groups, retries, dead-letter queues, schema evolution, idempotency, replay, and event-driven data flows.
* **EDI and B2B integration exposure:** Familiarity with EDI documents such as 810, 850, 855, and 856; AS2, SFTP, flat-file exchange, or trading-partner onboarding.
* **OpenAPI and schema tooling:** Experience reading and validating OpenAPI/Swagger specifications, JSON Schema, Avro, or Protobuf definitions.
* **Database fundamentals:** Working knowledge of SQL and PostgreSQL for validating source records, transformed data, audit data, and integration state.
* **Data standards and semantic modeling:** Familiarity with ontologies, controlled vocabularies, industry product-classification standards (such as ETIM or UNSPSC), graph databases, or knowledge graphs.
* **ERPNext/Frappe or other open-source ERP exposure:** Understanding of open-source ERP data models and customization patterns.
* **Cloud and platform experience:** GCP/AWS/Azure, containerization (Docker/Kubernetes), and CI/CD practices.
* **Certifications:** SAP (Integration Suite, S/4HANA), Epicor, or Infor certifications.

**Ideal Candidate Profile**

* A hands-on ERP integration architect who is equally comfortable reading SAP function-module documentation, testing an OData endpoint, analyzing an Epicor or Infor payload, and speaking with a client’s ERP or Basis team.
* **Can understand both sides of an integration:** what the source ERP system provides and what the target platform requires.
* Communicates clearly, asks the right technical questions, and converts incomplete information — including undocumented internal SAP systems — into structured integration requirements.
* Treats raw payload evidence, mapping correctness, authentication security, idempotency, traceability, and documentation as core engineering concerns.
* Works effectively in a fast-moving environment where client ERP systems differ significantly and integrations require practical investigation rather than assumptions.
* Can collaborate closely with architects and developers while independently owning partner communication, ERP analysis, mapping inputs, and integration acceptance.

Pay: From ₹521,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person

deb9394c.title: Solutions Engineer
deb9394c.description:
**Who we are**

Born in 2014, Yoti is a digital identity and biometric technology company that makes it safer for people to prove who they are. The Yoti app was designed with privacy at its core, giving people a secure way to prove their identity and share third-party credentials with organisations and other people.

Today, we have over twenty million app downloads around the world. We’ve expanded our offering to a suite of business solutions that span identity verification, age verification and estimation, e-signing, AI anti-spoofing technologies and we continue to think of innovative new offerings.

From day one, we’ve been working to fix an outdated identity system. This is not a journey we make on our own but with policy advisors, think tanks, researchers, academics, humanitarian bodies, our users and everyday people. We are committed to solving identity problems through grassroots research and social purpose initiatives. Our dedication to our mission and our team is why Yoti was proudly named one of the Sunday Times Best Places to Work 2026 in the UK.

**Purpose of the Role:**
Serve as the main technical contact for Level 2 client support and lead improvements in Yoti’s support processes. Own and maintain public developer documentation to ensure seamless integrations for clients and partners.

**Role Dimensions:**
Member of the Solutions team within Client Services, working closely with Product, Customer Support, BI (Business Intelligence), and Operations.

**Principal Responsibilities:**

* Lead and manage Level 2 client support channels, resolving technical integration queries and complex support cases for Yoti’s products and services.
* Analyse support trends to identify and implement process improvements, reducing repetitive queries and driving efficiency.
* Proactively build and maintain expertise in Yoti’s APIs, and web and mobile SDKs.
* Own and update Yoti’s public-facing developer documentation—improving guides, API references, and resources for clarity and accuracy.
* Serve as an advocate for integration best practices, advising clients and external developers on onboarding, troubleshooting, and implementation.
* Mentor colleagues in support and non-technical teams, empowering them to address routine technical queries more independently.
* Collaborate with Product and Engineering teams to triage escalations, validate integration requirements, and share insights for product improvements.
* Participate in technical discussions; present complex ideas clearly and support client onboarding and go-live.
* Create and maintain internal technical documentation and handover materials to support internal teams and processes.

**Knowledge, Skills, Qualifications and Experience:**

* Minimum 4 years of experience in solutions engineering, technical support, integrations, or similar roles within SaaS, API, or tech environments.
* Strong knowledge of web technologies (JavaScript, REST APIs, OAuth 2.0, webhooks) and backend concepts; containerization (Docker) is a bonus.
* Proficient in languages such as JavaScript (Node.js), Python, Java, or C#, with hands-on SDK and REST API experience. Mobile development (Android/iOS) is a plus.
* Demonstrated ability to diagnose and resolve technical issues for external clients, particularly in Level 2 support and escalations.
* Experience writing and maintaining high-quality technical documentation and architecture diagrams.
* Excellent oral and written communication skills; able to convey technical topics to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Analytical thinker with strong problem-solving skills; proactive and detail-focused.
* Collaborative and effective team player, able to work cross-functionally and support a culture of shared learning.
