**Introduction**
A career in IBM Consulting is built on long-term client relationships and close collaboration worldwide. You’ll work with leading companies across industries, helping them shape their hybrid cloud and AI journeys. With support from our strategic partners, robust IBM technology, and Red Hat, you’ll have the tools to drive meaningful change and accelerate client impact. At IBM Consulting, curiosity fuels success. You’ll be encouraged to challenge the norm, explore new ideas, and create innovative solutions that deliver real results. Our culture of growth and empathy focuses on your long-term career development while valuing your unique skills and experiences.
  
  
**Your Role And Responsibilities**
As a Package Consultant specializing in Oracle Finance Cloud, you will streamline clients' financial operations by implementing Oracle Finance Cloud solutions. You will design and configure Oracle finance applications to improve data accuracy, reporting, and operational efficiency across the organization.
  
  
**Your Primary Responsibilities Will Include**

* Design Oracle Finance Solutions: Design and configure Oracle finance applications to meet client requirements, ensuring alignment with industry best practices and regulatory standards.
* Implement Cloud Architecture: Develop and implement Oracle Finance Cloud architecture that aligns with clients' business goals, focusing on data accuracy, reporting, and operational efficiency.
* Configure Oracle Modules: Configure Oracle Finance Cloud modules, including General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Fixed Assets, Cash Management, Expenses, Collections, Tax, and Oracle Cloud Reporting.
* Ensure Compliance: Ensure Oracle Finance Cloud solutions comply with regulatory standards and industry best practices, maintaining data accuracy and operational efficiency.
* Deliver Client Solutions: Deliver tailored Oracle Finance Cloud solutions that meet client needs, driving improved financial operations and business outcomes.

**Preferred Education**
Master's Degree
  
  
**Required Technical And Professional Expertise**

* Oracle Finance Cloud Implementation: Experience with designing and configuring Oracle finance applications to improve data accuracy, reporting, and operational efficiency across organizations.
* Industry Best Practices: Experience in applying industry best practices to ensure Oracle Finance Cloud architecture aligns with business goals and regulatory standards.
* Oracle Module Configuration: Experience with configuring Oracle Finance Cloud modules, including General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Fixed Assets, Cash Management, Expenses, Collections, Tax, and Oracle Cloud Reporting.
* Regulatory Compliance: Experience in ensuring Oracle Finance Cloud solutions comply with regulatory standards and industry best practices, maintaining data accuracy and operational efficiency.
* Financial Operations Improvement: Experience in delivering tailored Oracle Finance Cloud solutions that drive improved financial operations and business outcomes.

**Preferred Technical And Professional Experience**

* Oracle Finance Cloud Architecture: Experience with designing and implementing Oracle Finance Cloud architecture that aligns with clients' business goals and regulatory standards, focusing on data accuracy, reporting, and operational efficiency.
* Industry-Specific Best Practices: Experience in applying industry-specific best practices to ensure Oracle Finance Cloud solutions meet client needs and comply with regulatory standards.
* Advanced Oracle Module Configuration: Experience with advanced configuration of Oracle Finance Cloud modules, including General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Fixed Assets, Cash Management, Expenses, Collections, Tax, and Oracle Cloud Reporting.

036c7d7f.title: Application Architect-AWS Cloud Migration
036c7d7f.description:
**Introduction**
A career in IBM Consulting is built on long-term client relationships and close collaboration worldwide. You’ll work with leading companies across industries, helping them shape their hybrid cloud and AI journeys. With support from our strategic partners, robust IBM technology, and Red Hat, you’ll have the tools to drive meaningful change and accelerate client impact. At IBM Consulting, curiosity fuels success. You’ll be encouraged to challenge the norm, explore new ideas, and create innovative solutions that deliver real results. Our culture of growth and empathy focuses on your long-term career development while valuing your unique skills and experiences.
  
  
**Your Role And Responsibilities**
As an Application Architect specializing in AWS Cloud Migration, you will lead the design and delivery of cloud migration solutions for multi-cloud environments, including AWS, Azure, and ICP. You will guide the development of migration strategies, tools, and network requirements for hybrid cloud platforms.
  
  
**Your Primary Responsibilities Will Include**

* Lead Migration Architecture Design: Develop and implement migration architecture solutions for multi-cloud environments, ensuring seamless integration with AWS and other cloud platforms.
* Design Migration Strategy: Collaborate with the team to create effective migration strategies, selecting the right tools and methods for rehosting, refactoring, rearchitecting, replatforming, and containerization.
* Adopt Migration Methodology: Lead the adoption of migration methodologies, tailoring approaches to client environments and industries, and providing expert guidance on method adoption workshops.
* Provide Technical Expertise: Offer significant contributions to Migration Project Managers on technical elements, including WBS, estimation, migration risk, dependencies, and Minimum Viable Product (MVP).
* Map Client Requirements: Utilize deep knowledge of AWS platform and service catalog to map client platform and application deployment requirements into AWS-specific services and configurations.

**Preferred Education**
Master's Degree
  
  
**Required Technical And Professional Expertise**

* Cloud Migration Solution Design: Experience with designing and delivering cloud migration solutions for multi-cloud environments, including AWS, Azure, and ICP, with a focus on hybrid cloud platforms.
* Migration Strategy Development: Experience in developing effective migration strategies, including selecting the right tools and methods for rehosting, refactoring, rearchitecting, replatforming, and containerization.
* Migration Methodology Adoption: Experience leading the adoption of migration methodologies, tailoring approaches to client environments and industries, and providing expert guidance on method adoption workshops.
* Technical Expertise in Migration: Experience providing significant contributions to Migration Project Managers on technical elements, including WBS, estimation, migration risk, dependencies, and Minimum Viable Product (MVP).
* AWS Platform Knowledge: Deep knowledge of AWS platform and service catalog, with the ability to map client platform and application deployment requirements into AWS-specific services and configurations.

**Preferred Technical And Professional Experience**

* Deep Knowledge of Azure: Experience with Azure platform and service catalog, with the ability to map client platform and application deployment requirements into Azure-specific services and configurations.
* Familiarity with ICP: Exposure to ICP platform and service catalog, with understanding of how to integrate ICP with other cloud platforms.
* Containerization Expertise: Experience with containerization methods and tools, including selecting the right approach for rehosting, refactoring, rearchitecting, replatforming, and containerization.

611afc83.title: Sr. Cloud Applications Consultant
611afc83.description:
**Opentext - The Information Company**
OpenText is a global leader in information management, where innovation, creativity, and collaboration are the key components of our corporate culture. As a member of our team, you will have the opportunity to partner with the most highly regarded companies in the world, tackle complex issues, and contribute to projects that shape the future of digital transformation.
  
  
**AI-First. Future-Driven. Human-Centered.**
At OpenText, AI is at the heart of everything we do—powering innovation, transforming work, and empowering digital knowledge workers. We're hiring talent that AI can't replace to help us shape the future of information management. Join us.
  
  
**Your Impact**
Reporting to the TSS (Technical Success Services) Practice Manager, the Sr. Cloud Applications Consultant is part of the technical managed services team, responsible for end-to-end technical delivery, including administration and management of the OpenText Documentum product suite for global customers.
  
  
We are seeking a technically resourceful professional with the ability to deliver exceptional customer experience in a challenging and rewarding environment.
  
  
You will join a growing team providing world-class operational support, including hands-on troubleshooting and administration for enterprise customers, while collaborating with cross-functional teams to ensure service level commitments and customer satisfaction are consistently achieved.
  
  
**What The Role Offers**

* Relevant experience: 5–8 years
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related technical field (required).
* Strong hands-on experience in administering and managing the OpenText Documentum platform
* Leveraging AI and automation to accelerate troubleshooting, improve operational efficiency, and drive innovative solutions for complex Documentum support challenges
* Experience with core Documentum components: D2, Content Server, xPlore, CTS, D2-REST, DFS, DFC, BOF, DQL, and Documentum Administrator

**What You Need To Succeed**

* Representing OpenText professionally in all interactions with customers, partners, and internal stakeholders
* Demonstrating strong customer focus, empathy, and clear written and verbal communication
* Responding to and solving customer technical requests, showing an understanding of the customer's managed hosted environment and applications within the OpenText Cloud, enabling resolution of complex technical issues.
* Operating, administering, and maintaining production Documentum applications in accordance with defined policies and procedures
* Monitoring applications, infrastructure, and services; troubleshooting alerts to ensure service level agreement (SLA) compliance
* Managing incidents, problems, changes, and releases within an ITIL-aligned service delivery model
* Collaborating with Product Support, Cloud Operations, Network, and cross-functional teams to resolve complex technical issues
* Maintaining accurate operational documentation, status reporting, and stakeholder communication
* Providing knowledge sharing, guidance, and mentoring to team members and customers as required
* Escalating risks, issues, and deviations in a timely manner and supporting continuous operational improvement

**Preferred Skills**

* Documentum Life Sciences modules – Q&M and R&D
* InfoArchive and/or Core for Capital Projects
* Experience managing Documentum in cloud environments (AWS, Azure, or GCP), including containerized deployments
* Familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes, and Helm
* Experience supporting incident, problem, change, and release management within an ITIL-based service delivery model
* Understanding of object-oriented programming, web services, LDAP, and RDBMS concepts
* Working knowledge of Unix and Windows operating systems
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and collaboration skills in fast-paced, globally distributed environments
* Preferred certifications:
* Documentum certification
* ITIL (Foundation or higher)
* Any Cloud certification (AWS, Azure, or GCP)

**One Last Thing**
OpenText is more than just a corporation, it's a global community where trust is foundational, the bar is raised, and outcomes are owned. Join us on our mission to drive positive change through privacy, technology, and collaboration. At OpenText, we don't just have a culture; we have character. Choose us because you want to be part of a company that embraces innovation and empowers its employees to make a difference.
  
  
OpenText's efforts to build an inclusive work environment go beyond simply complying with applicable laws. Our Employment Equity and Diversity Policy provides direction on maintaining a working environment that is inclusive of everyone, regardless of culture, national origin, race, color, gender, gender identification, sexual orientation, family status, age, veteran status, disability, religion, or other basis protected by applicable laws.
  
  
If you need assistance and/or a reasonable accommodation due to a disability during the application or recruiting process, please contact us at hr@opentext.com. Our proactive approach fosters collaboration, innovation, and personal growth, enriching OpenText's vibrant workplace.

3c834944.title: Azure Technical Account Manager
3c834944.description:
**Title: Azure Technical Account Manager**

**Sector: IT & Services Consulting**

**Location: Permanent Work From Home (Anywhere in India)**

**Duration: 1-Year Contract - Renewable**

**Working Hours: Monday to Friday, Eastern Standard Time Zone**

**The impact you will have:**

As an Azure Technical Account Manager, you'll play a critical role helping our customers realize their stated business outcomes by adopting and optimizing Microsoft Azure. As a new role within an established organization, your motivation to build best practices and drive outcomes will be critical to your success. You'll be an integral part of the overall account team, joining some of the best-in-class people in the business as we accelerate our cloud organization, close a gap that no current role owns, and pave the way for TAM practice expansion into Microsoft.

**What you’ll do:**

* Leveraging your ability to build relationships across all levels of an organization, from IT administrators to C-Suite executives, develop and maintain knowledge of business objectives of the accounts within your assigned account base/ territory/ segment
* In collaboration with others in the Account ecosystem, build and execute carefully curated technical success plans and optimization roadmaps that drive customer strategic outcomes, success for the client, and our partnership with Microsoft
* Apply your deep, hands-on knowledge of Microsoft cloud technologies — including Azure, Microsoft 365, Defender, Entra and Purview — to support successful and effective cloud adoption within your accounts
* Become an expert resource at mapping technical solutions to customer business goals, proposing solutions inclusive of workshops, assessments, cloud native services, and professional and/or managed services that accelerate that outcome
* Own technical escalations as the primary in-house point of contact for critical issues, reducing reliance on costly Microsoft support tickets and improving time-to-resolution
* Guide customers on Microsoft security and compliance tools, including Defender and Purview, to help them navigate regulatory standards and close compliance gaps
* Build internal fluency on emerging Microsoft capabilities such as Microsoft 365 Copilot Cowork — including Copilot Credits cost modeling, plugin and connector governance, and Sentinel Agent Identity review — so customers have a trusted advisor for what's next, not just what's here today
* Explain and support GDAP (Granular Delegated Admin Privileges) and client CSC processes both pre- and post-sale, building the deep partner ecosystem knowledge needed to reduce escalations tied to technical clarity
* Collaborate closely with client's Customer Success Managers, Microsoft Sales Specialists, and Microsoft sales and pre-sales teams, working together to create customer-centric opportunities for growth
* Maintain depth of knowledge of market and industry trends and events, surfacing areas of opportunity or risk to those within your assigned account base
* Provide guidance, advice, and thought leadership to your peers within the Customer Success Organization, supporting the maturation of the overall practices within it

**What you’ll bring to the table:**

* A passion for the Cloud and desire to deepen your focus on the Microsoft ecosystem, with current business and technical certifications validating your skills on Azure and Microsoft 365 (e.g., Azure Solutions Architect, Microsoft 365 Enterprise Administrator)
* A love of learning, problem-solving, and curiosity; never shying away from the unknown — including fast-moving areas like Microsoft's agentic AI roadmap
* A customer-centric, collaborative approach — working alongside customers and internal teams to drive collective success
* A track record of success within pre-sales, IT and/or customer success organizations providing technical expertise and advisory services on Azure, AWS or GCP
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with experience operating in matrixed environments and translating customer pain points into actionable insights
* A bachelor's degree in computer science, Engineering, or a related technical field and/or 5+ years of practical, progressive experience

9bac961c.title: Cloud Solution Delivery Advisor
9bac961c.description:
**India T&M Special Bonus:**
**Req ID:**
390492
  
  
NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now.
  
  
We are currently seeking a Cloud Solution Delivery Advisor to join our team in Pune, Mahārāshtra (IN-MH), India (IN).
  
  
**NTT DATA Job Description**
**Senior Azure Platform Engineer**
**Practice**
Platform Engineering, Cloud Platform team (Azure squad)
  
  
**Location**
India, offshore delivery centre
  
  
**Start date**
November 2026
  
  
**Positions**
x3
  
  
**Seniority**
Grade 9-10
  
  
**Reports to**
Engineering Lead
  
  
**Role Purpose**
You will be a member of a new Azure squad, building an enterprise Azure platform as reusable, versioned products: landing zones, Terraform modules, policy baselines, standard images and CI/CD pipelines, all consumed through a self-service developer portal. As a senior engineer you will own significant components end to end and help set the squad's standards from day one.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Platform engineering: Design and build Azure landing zone components — subscription vending, networking, identity integration, policy baselines and guardrails — as reusable Terraform modules.
* Component ownership: Own significant platform products end-to-end: design, build, test, documentation and release management.
* CI/CD pipelines: Build and maintain GitHub Actions pipelines for infrastructure delivery, with security scanning, policy checks, testing and cost controls embedded as quality gates.
* Azure Local and hybrid: Contribute to the engineering of Azure Local capability and hybrid automation, extending the platform model into the client's private cloud estate.
* Standard images: Build and maintain pipelines for hardened compute standard images (build, test, publication).
* Self-service products: Package platform capabilities for consumption as self-service golden paths through the Port.io developer portal catalogue.
* Engineering standards: Help establish squad conventions — code review discipline, module structure, testing standards and documentation — and uphold them through peer review.
* Mentoring: Support and coach the squad's mid-level engineers; contribute to design discussions with the Engineering Lead and Platform Architect.

**Essential**

* 10+ years: in infrastructure, cloud or DevOps engineering, of which 8+ years hands-on Azure engineering.
* Azure platform depth: Strong experience with enterprise Azure — management groups, subscription design, Azure Policy, networking (hub-spoke or vWAN), Entra ID and security baselines.
* Terraform: Advanced, production Terraform experience: writing reusable modules, managing state, versioning and testing infrastructure code.
* Secure platform engineering: Building secure-by-default infrastructure as a standard part of module design: identity and least-privilege design, guardrails and policy enforcement, and secrets management.
* Testing infrastructure code: Validating infrastructure code properly, through module testing, plan review discipline and pre-merge automated checks.
* Engineering discipline: Strong Git workflow, code review and documentation habits; experience working in sprint-based agile teams.
* Collaboration: Comfortable working in a distributed team with UK-based technical leadership and client stakeholders; clear written and spoken English.

**Nice to Have**

* CI/CD platform: GitHub Actions preferred. Azure DevOps or GitLab CI transfer directly.
* Hybrid: Azure Local, Azure Stack HCI or Azure Arc.
* Security tooling: Policy-as-code (OPA, Sentinel), IaC scanning (Checkov, Wiz, tfsec), and Terratest or similar module testing frameworks.
* Scripting in Python, PowerShell or Bash for automation tooling.
* Experience in financial services or similarly regulated environments.
* Microsoft certifications (AZ-104 Azure Administrator, AZ-305 Azure Solutions Architect, AZ-400 DevOps Engineer).

**Technologies & Tools**
The squad's toolchain:
  
  

* Core: Azure, Azure Local (Azure Stack HCI), Azure Arc, Terraform, GitHub and GitHub Actions.
* Policy and security: Azure Policy, Wiz and Checkov for IaC scanning, and OPA for policy-as-code.
* Pipeline quality: tflint, terraform-docs, Infracost and Terratest.
* Consumption: The Port.io internal developer portal, which is how teams consume platform products.
* Standard images: Image pipelines for hardened compute images.

**About NTT DATA**
NTT DATA is a $30 billion business and technology services leader, serving 75% of the Fortune Global 100. We are committed to accelerating client success and positively impacting society through responsible innovation. We are one of the world's leading AI and digital infrastructure providers, with unmatched capabilities in enterprise-scale AI, cloud, security, connectivity, data centers and application services. our consulting and Industry solutions help organizations and society move confidently and sustainably into the digital future. As a Global Top Employer, we have experts in more than 50 countries. We also offer clients access to a robust ecosystem of innovation centers as well as established and start-up partners. NTT DATA is a part of NTT Group, which invests over $3 billion each year in R&D.
  
  
Whenever possible, we hire locally to NTT DATA offices or client sites. This ensures we can provide timely and effective support tailored to each client’s needs. While many positions offer remote or hybrid work options, these arrangements are subject to change based on client requirements. For employees near an NTT DATA office or client site, in-office attendance may be required for meetings or events, depending on business needs. At NTT DATA, we are committed to staying flexible and meeting the evolving needs of both our clients and employees. NTT DATA recruiters will never ask for payment or banking information and will only use @nttdata.com, @nttdatafed.com and @talent.nttdataservices.com email addresses. If you are requested to provide payment or disclose banking information, please submit a contact us form, https://us.nttdata.com/en/contact-us.

147e6ac7.title: Consultant Cloud Operations
147e6ac7.description:
About us

Join us at Orange Business!  
We are a network and digital integrator that understands the entire value chain of the digital world, freeing our customers to focus on the strategic initiatives that shape their business.  
Every day, you will collaborate with a team dedicated to providing consistent, sustainable global solutions, no matter where our customers operate. With over 30,000 employees across Asia, the Americas, Africa, and Europe, we offer a dynamic environment to develop and perfect your skills in a field filled with exciting challenges and opportunities.

About the role

Drive operational excellence and innovation in cloud services by collaborating with international customers and teams to deliver customized cloud solutions within a virtual environment.  
Your role will include ensuring service continuity, resolving technical challenges, and contributing to service improvements that enhance client satisfaction and operational performance.  
- Engage with international customers to accurately understand their cloud operational requirements and deliver tailored solutions that meet their needs.  
- Collaborate with cross-functional internal teams to ensure seamless integration and reliable delivery of cloud services across multiple platforms.  
- Identify, analyze, and resolve technical issues promptly to maintain service availability and operational continuity.  
- Operate effectively in a distributed virtual environment, coordinating with stakeholders across various time zones to support service excellence.  
- Manage unexpected operational challenges with strategic and composed approaches to ensure timely resolution and minimal impact on customers.  
- Participate actively in continuous improvement initiatives aimed at enhancing operational efficiency, service quality, and innovation in cloud operations.

About you

You are a knowledgeable professional with over 7 years of experience in cloud operations and virtualization technologies, holding a graduate degree in science, engineering (BE/B Tech), or M.Sc. IT. Your expertise includes advanced proficiency in vCloud Director, VMware ESXi and vSphere, NSX-T, and hands-on experience with Dell and Cisco chassis, complemented by solid knowledge of public cloud platforms like Azure. Your strong communication and customer management skills enable you to effectively partner with stakeholders to deliver efficient cloud solutions.  
  
**Your professional skills:**   
- Over 7 years of proven experience managing cloud operations and virtualization technologies, combined with a graduate degree in science, engineering, or IT.  
- Advanced expertise in managing and configuring vCloud Director environments effectively to support cloud infrastructure needs.  
- Strong proficiency in VMware ESXi and vSphere, including managing vCenter and ESXi for optimized virtualization performance.  
- In-depth experience with NSX-T for advanced network virtualization and security configuration.  
- Hands-on familiarity with hardware infrastructure, including Dell M1000 Chassis and M630, Cisco UCS, and HPE Chassis platforms.  
- Well-versed in public cloud environments, especially Microsoft Azure, to design and maintain scalable cloud solutions.  
- Able to apply Linux system administration skills and automation tools to streamline cloud operations and maintenance.  
- Communicates clearly and professionally with customers and team members to ensure successful engagement and resolution.  
- Manages customer interactions effectively to provide satisfactory service experiences and maintain strong professional relationships.  
- Adapts to changing environments and addresses operational issues with flexible problem-solving strategies.  
- Collaborates constructively within teams, sharing expertise and contributing to collective success.  
  
**Your soft skills:**   
- Communicates clearly and professionally, ensuring effective exchange of information with colleagues and customers.  
- Manages customer interactions with professionalism, ensuring their needs are acknowledged and addressed appropriately.  
- Adapts approaches as necessary to respond efficiently to evolving operational environments and challenges.  
- Works collaboratively within teams, contributing knowledge and supporting collective goals.  
- Demonstrates dependability and commitment to delivering consistent, high-quality outcomes in cloud operations.

  

Join Orange as a Consultant in cloud operations where your technical expertise will directly influence innovative cloud solutions on a global scale. You will work within a collaborative virtual environment to solve complex challenges, driving tailored cloud service delivery for diverse international clients. This role offers a dynamic opportunity to expand your skills and impact by contributing knowledge and enhancing operational processes while fostering a culture of adaptability and professional growth.

What we offer

**- Global Opportunities:** Work in multi-national teams with opportunity to collaborate with colleagues and customers from all over the world.  
**- Flexible Work Environment:** Flexible working hours and possibility to combine work from office and home (hybrid ways of working).  
**- Professional Development:** training programs and upskilling/re-skilling opportunities.  
**- Career Growth:** Internal growth and mobility opportunities within Orange.  
**- Caring and Daring Culture:** Health and well-being programs and benefits, diversity inclusion initiatives, CSR and employee connect events.  
**- Reward Programs:** Employee Referral Program, Change Maker Awards.

Only your skills matter

9a024ccd.title: Cloud Architect
9a024ccd.description:
**About the Opportunity**

We are seeking an experienced Azure Architect with strong expertise in Azure Cloud, Infrastructure Automation, Cloud Migration, Terraform, Ansible, PowerShell, and DevOps practices. The candidate will be responsible for designing, implementing, and governing enterprise-scale Azure environments, leading cloud transformation programs, and driving infrastructure automation initiatives to improve operational efficiency, scalability, and security.

  

**What youll be doing**

  

**1.** **Azure Cloud Architecture**

* Design scalable, secure, and highly available Azure solutions aligned with business requirements.
* Define Azure Landing Zones, governance frameworks, and cloud operating models.
* Architect hybrid and multi-subscription Azure environments.
* Design backup, disaster recovery, business continuity, and resiliency solutions.
* Establish cloud security, compliance, and cost optimization strategies.

2. **Cloud Migration & Modernization**

* Lead end-to-end cloud migration initiatives from on-premises and legacy platforms to Microsoft Azure.
* Assess current-state infrastructure and develop migration roadmaps.
* Plan and execute server, application, database, and workload migrations.
* Design migration strategies including Rehost, Refactor, Re-platform, and Modernization approaches.
* Manage migration risks, dependencies, cutover planning, and post-migration optimization.
* Utilize Azure Migrate and related tools for discovery, assessment, and migration execution.

3927f3d4.title: Cloud Engineer- L3
3927f3d4.description:
**Job Description Cloud Engineer**

**Position Details & Role Overview**

**Position Title** :Cloud Engineer (Level 3 / Senior)

**Department** : Cloud Engineering & Technology

**Experience** : 10+years

**Employment Type** : Full-Time

***Location : Hyderabad WFO (Preferred candidates must from Hyderabad)***

  

The Cloud Engineer designs, builds, secures and supports the company's cloud and hybrid infrastructure, with Microsoft Azure as the primary platform. The role is the final technical escalation point for cloud infrastructure incidents and owns them through to a permanent fix.

Security is part of the job, not a separate function: the engineer builds identity, network and workload controls into every deployment, monitors for threats, and supports audits. Strong hands-on skills in cloud networking, automation (Infrastructure as Code) and troubleshooting are essential.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

The work falls into eight areas: running cloud infrastructure, networking, identity, security monitoring, automation, recovery, incident ownership, and compliance.

  

**1. Cloud Infrastructure & Operations**

* Design, deploy and maintain cloud infrastructure on Microsoft Azure (VMs, storage, compute); AWS or GCP exposure is a plus.
* Act as Level 3 escalation for complex cloud incidents passed on by L1/L2, using logs and metrics to find root causes.
* Manage the lifecycle of cloud servers (Windows and Linux): provisioning, configuration, patching, upgrades and decommissioning.
* Support hybrid on-premises/cloud environments, including migrations and modernization projects.
* Monitor resource health, capacity and performance, and act before issues cause business impact.

  

**2. Cloud Networking & Hybrid Connectivity**

* Configure and maintain VNet/VPC, subnets, NSGs/security groups, route tables, firewalls, load balancers and DNS.
* Build and troubleshoot Site-to-Site VPN connectivity between on-premises sites and the cloud.
* Validate routing, firewall rules and network paths when diagnosing connectivity issues, working with network teams as needed.

  

**3. Identity, Access & Data Protection**

* Manage IAM, RBAC, MFA and Conditional Access, applying least-privilege access across cloud resources.
* Implement encryption, key management, and secrets management.
* Apply server and workload hardening baselines.

  

**4. Security Monitoring, Vulnerability & Incident Response**

* Set up security monitoring, logging and alerting; watch for threats and suspicious activity (for example in Microsoft Defender for Cloud and Entra ID).
* Run vulnerability assessments and drive patching and remediation to closure.
* Investigate and respond to cloud security incidents, and support security teams with evidence and analysis.
* Secure cloud workloads, containers, APIs and databases where they are in scope.

  

**5. Automation, IaC & DevSecOps**

* Build and manage infrastructure with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Bicep/ARM or CloudFormation).
* Automate operations and security tasks with PowerShell, Python or Bash.
* Work with development teams to integrate security checks into CI/CD pipelines.

  

**6. Backup, Recovery & Disaster Recovery**

* Monitor and validate cloud backups (Azure Backup, plus Veeam or Backblaze where in use) and fix failed or incomplete jobs.
* Perform file, VM and server restores when needed.
* Take part in disaster recovery planning, testing and validation.

  

**7. Incident, Problem & Change Management**

* Own escalated incidents through to resolution, with timely technical updates and bridge-call participation for major incidents.
* Run root-cause analysis, find permanent fixes instead of workarounds, and support Problem Management.
* Implement approved changes under change-management procedures, then validate and monitor.
* Mentor L1/L2 engineers and share knowledge.

  

**8. Compliance, Documentation & Continuous Improvement**

* Support security audits, compliance requirements and risk assessments, including evidence collection.
* Maintain cloud security standards, SOPs, KB articles, build documents, recovery procedures and architecture/network diagrams.
* Work with cloud providers, vendors and internal teams, and recommend improvements, including emerging cloud and security technologies.

  

**Required Technical Skills**

Candidates need hands-on production experience in Azure, cloud networking, identity and access management, and automation.

  

**Skills**

**Cloud platforms**

Microsoft Azure (VMs, Storage, VNet, subnets, NSGs, route tables, Azure VPN, load balancers); working knowledge of AWS or GCP is an advantage

**Operating systems**

Windows Server and Linux administration, troubleshooting and patching

**Networking**

TCP/IP, DNS, VPN, routing, firewalls, load balancing, SSL/TLS and certificate management

**Identity & security**

IAM, RBAC, MFA, Conditional Access, Microsoft Entra ID, encryption, key and secrets management, server hardening

**Monitoring & response**

Security monitoring and logging tools, Microsoft Defender, vulnerability management, incident response

**Automation & IaC**

Terraform, Bicep/ARM or CloudFormation; scripting in PowerShell, Python or Bash

**DevSecOps**

CI/CD tools and pipeline security integration

**Backup & DR**

Azure Backup and Site Recovery; backup monitoring, VM/server restoration, disaster recovery testing

**Hybrid infrastructure**

On premises to cloud connectivity, migration and coexistence

**Preferred Skills & Certifications**

These are not mandatory, but they strengthen a candidacy.

  

**Preferred skills**

* Docker, Kubernetes and container security.
* Experience in an ITIL-based environment covering Incident, Problem, Change and Major Incident Management.
* Experience supporting 24x7 production environments, with monitoring and ticketing platforms.
* Familiarity with on-premises virtualization (VMware, Hyper-V or Proxmox) in hybrid setups.
* Strong documentation skills and the ability to explain issues to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Microsoft 365 and Exchange Online administration, including SharePoint and Power BI Pro licensing.
* Email DNS records (SPF, DKIM, DMARC) and mail-flow troubleshooting.
* Day-to-day Active Directory, Group Policy (GPO) and DHCP administration in hybrid environments.
* File server and application server administration.

  

**Preferred certifications**

* Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator Associate
* Microsoft Certified: Azure Security Engineer Associate
* AWS Certified Security Specialty or Google Professional Cloud Security Engineer
* Certified Cloud Security Professional (CCSP)
* CompTIA Security+
* ITIL Foundation
* Veeam certifications
* VMware certifications
* Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP)

**Qualifications & Experience**

The role needs 58 years of hands-on cloud or infrastructure experience, including time as a senior or escalation-level engineer.

* Bachelor's degree (or equivalent) in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cyber Security or a related field.
* 58 years in cloud engineering, systems administration or infrastructure operations, with production Windows/Linux and cloud environments.
* Demonstrated experience at Level 3 / senior escalation level, owning complex incidents to resolution.
* Strong troubleshooting, root-cause analysis and problem-solving skills.
* Relevant cloud and security certifications are an added advantage.

  

**Performance Expectations & Working Model**

The engineer is measured on keeping cloud environments secure, available and compliant, and on how quickly and permanently incidents are resolved.

  

**Performance measures**

* Cloud environment availability and uptime
* SLA compliance and Mean Time to Resolve (MTTR)
* Critical incident resolution and reduction in recurring incidents
* Timely detection of, and response to, security incidents
* Patch compliance and vulnerability remediation
* Backup success rate and disaster recovery test success
* Change success rate
* Compliance with organizational and industry security standards
* Documentation and KB compliance
* Stakeholder satisfaction

  

**Working model**

* Work from office in Hyderabad.
* Take part in on-call, weekend or after-hours support for critical infrastructure when required.
* Join major incident bridges and planned maintenance windows.
* Collaborate with network, security, application, development and cloud provider teams.

a4d94873.description:
**Job Information**
-------------------

* Date Opened 10/05/2026

**Job Description**
-------------------

About Flatworld Solutions

Flatworld Solutions is a leading IT and business services company delivering end-to-end technology solutions

across software development, data management, AI/ML, and digital transformation. Our AI Solutioning team is the

engine behind intelligent products and platform-driven engagements — translating enterprise challenges into

scalable, AI-powered outcomes for clients worldwide.

Role Summary

We are looking for a Lead – AI Solutions to own the end-to-end AI solution lifecycle: from early-stage enterprise

discovery and opportunity shaping, through solution architecture and product roadmapping, to client delivery,

enablement, and post-engagement knowledge transfer. This is a cross-functional leadership role that sits at the

intersection of AI product thinking, client consulting, and delivery orchestration.

The ideal candidate has built or managed AI/ML platforms (conversational AI, NLP, analytics), run enterprise

discovery with large clients, and translated ambiguous requirements into shipped product capability — not

bespoke services. You are a 0-to-1 thinker who can also operate at scale.

Key Responsibilities

A. Enterprise Discovery & AI Solution Design

* Lead discovery workshops with enterprise clients to understand business processes, pain points, and

automation opportunities across diverse industry verticals.

* Design AI solution architectures mapping client needs to platform capabilities — conversational AI, NLP

pipelines, analytics dashboards, process automation, and intelligent workflows.

* Create As-Is / To-Be process maps, solution blueprints, and conceptual prototypes that articulate the AI

value proposition clearly to both technical and business stakeholders.

* Evaluate client technology landscapes (tools, data maturity, integration points) and recommend fit-for purpose AI approaches.

B. Product Roadmapping & Requirements Engineering

* Own the AI solution roadmap for assigned engagements — define scope, prioritize features, and sequence

releases aligned with client outcomes and internal platform capabilities.

* Translate enterprise requirements into productized features rather than one-off customizations; build

reusable, scalable solution components.

* Author and maintain solution documentation:
* Solution Design Documents (SDD) and Technical Architecture Specifications
* Business Requirements Documents (BRD) and Functional Requirements Documents (FRD)
* Scope documents, effort estimations, and Statements of Work (SOW)
* Wireframes, UI/UX flows, and interactive prototypes
* Facilitate sprint planning, backlog prioritization, and acceptance criteria definition in Agile delivery

environments.

C. Client Delivery & Cross-Functional Orchestration

* Act as the primary solution owner across the engagement lifecycle — ensuring continuity from pre-sales

through delivery to handover.

* Lead cross-functional squads (data engineering, ML, design, QA) to ship AI solutions on time and at quality.
* Manage client communication cadence: status updates, risk escalations, demo reviews, and steering

committee presentations.

* Drive productization of repeating client patterns into reusable platform modules, reducing delivery effort

for subsequent engagements.

D. Client Enablement & Knowledge Transfer

* Conduct solution demonstrations, UAT walkthroughs, and executive showcases to client stakeholders.
* Design and deliver client training programmes: user guides, walkthrough videos, and FAQ documentation.
* Prepare comprehensive handover packages:
* System architecture and integration documentation
* Operational runbooks and support transition guides
* Closure reports, lessons learned, and recommendations for Phase 2 / expansion opportunities
* Identify upsell and cross-sell opportunities during engagements; support pre-sales with client-informed

solution proposals.

E. AI Practice Building & Thought Leadership

* Contribute to building Flatworld’s reusable AI solution accelerators, reference architectures, and proposal

templates.

* Mentor junior business analysts and solution consultants on discovery techniques, documentation

standards, and client communication.

* Stay current with AI/ML trends (LLMs, Generative AI, Agentic AI, RAG architectures) and evaluate

applicability to client engagements.

* Represent the AI Solutioning team in pre-sales pursuits, RFP responses, and industry events.

### **Requirements**

Required Skills & Competencies

* Proven experience managing or owning an AI/ML product or platform — conversational AI, NLP, analytics,

or intelligent automation.

* Strong enterprise discovery and consulting skills: ability to run workshops, extract requirements from

ambiguous briefs, and translate them into structured solution designs.  

* Hands-on experience with solution documentation — BRD, FRD, SOW, wireframes, and architecture

specifications.

* Deep understanding of AI/ML concepts: NLP, knowledge graphs, intent models, sentiment analytics, and

process automation pipelines.

* Experience converting enterprise requirements into productized capabilities (not just bespoke project

delivery).

* Cross-functional team leadership: track record of leading squads of 10+ across engineering, data, design,

and operations.

* Proficiency in roadmapping and prioritization frameworks; experience with Agile (Scrum/Kanban) delivery.
* Excellent client-facing communication — comfortable presenting to C-suite and technical audiences alike.
* Strong commercial awareness: pricing models, effort estimation, unit economics, and SOW negotiation.

  
Qualifications  
  
  

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related

field.

* 12 – 15 years of progressive experience spanning product management, AI/ML solutioning, and enterprise

delivery.

* Prior experience at an AI product company, analytics firm, or IT services organization with an AI practice is

strongly preferred.

* Certifications in AI/ML, Product Management (e.g., AIPMM, Pragmatic Institute), or Agile (CSM, SAFe) are

a plus.

Nice to Have

* Hands-on familiarity with LLM-based solutions, Generative AI platforms, or Agentic AI frameworks.
* Experience building analytics dashboards and data visualization layers for enterprise clients.
* Background in process automation (RPA tools like KAPOW/Kofax, UiPath, or Automation Anywhere).
* Startup or founding experience demonstrating 0-to-1 platform building capability.
* Exposure to phygital, content-tech, or media-tech product domains.

### **Benefits**

What We Offer

* Leadership role in a growing AI Solutioning practice with direct client and platform ownership.
* Opportunity to shape Flatworld’s AI product and solution strategy from the ground up.
* Work with enterprise clients across diverse verticals — no two engagements are the same.
* Collaborative culture with access to engineering, data science, and design talent.
* Competitive compensation, learning budgets, and fast-track leadership pathways.

42037fca.title: Marketing Channel Delivery Manager, EM MISP Cluster Markets
42037fca.description:
**Role Purpose:**

* The Global Operations Services Center (GOSC) is seeking a highly motivated Marketing Channel Delivery Manager to lead marketing channel and samples services for Pfizers International Markets in Malaysia, Indonesia, Singapore and the Philippines. In this role, you will partner directly with local brand and marketing teams, BOPs, Digital and Commercial Excellence Innovation teams to develop digital and samples strategies that meet the needs of HCPs and patients, in adherence with global standards, compliance, legal and business requirements, on time and to budget.
* You will serve as a trusted advisor to your markets and work closely with the GOSC Delivery team to ensure the successful implementation of these services. Beyond your assigned markets, you will contribute to broader GOSC initiatives, driving innovation, continuous improvement and best practices.

  

In particular, the Marketing Channel Delivery Manager will focus on:

* **Samples Management**  for a high-volume, multi-market samples operation: annual sample plans, monitoring plans and work instructions, warehouse and logistics provider oversight, audit readiness and deviation management, ensuring compliance and efficiency.
* **Campaign Management**  capabilities through the planning and oversight of outbound (email) marketing programs, from brief to performance review.
* **HCP Portal**  (PfizerPro) to engage customers with promotional messaging and access to Pfizer products and services. Advise marketing teams on portal strategy to enhance the customer experience, including portal governance and above-brand oversight.
* **Social 2-way Communications**  rollout, oversight and scale, ensuring process execution, compliance and efficiency.
* **ePermission**  governance to support the customer acquisition strategy (collection, management, data quality and reporting).
* **Omnichannel reporting**  management and oversight to measure omnichannel performance and guarantee KPI consistency across global standard dashboards.

  

**Main Role responsibilities** :

* Develop strong relationships with local brand, marketing and customer-facing teams, gaining a deep understanding of each markets priorities, customers and channel needs.
* Build and maintain a clear plan per market, agreed with local business leaders, defining where Marketing Channel Delivery services add most value and how success will be measured.
* Translate global standards, platform changes and new capabilities into clear, actionable plans for your markets, driving adoption, compliance and consistent ways of working.
* Partner with the GOSC Delivery team to ensure timely, accurate and effective execution of channel and samples services: define requirements and quality expectations, monitor service levels and manage escalations to resolution.
* Collaborate effectively across Marketing, Medical, Legal, Compliance, Digital, Centers of Excellence and other partner functions, ensuring approvals and compliance standards are met on time and to budget.
* Serve as a trusted advisor to omnichannel teams, recommending how to structure campaigns, portals and customer journeys that maximise value across touch points.
* Lead training and capability building for marketing and customer-facing colleagues on channel and samples platforms, processes and best practices.
* Use data, dashboards and KPIs to evaluate channel and samples performance, generate insights and oversee channel adoption
* Maintain audit readiness through accurate documentation and ensure adherence to all relevant policies, procedures and Legal and Compliance standards.
* Lead continuous improvement initiatives across GOSC, identifying opportunities for automation, simplification and AI-enabled ways of working, and driving best practices across international markets.

  

**Qualifications**

* **BA required; MBA or equivalent Masters-level education preferred.**
* **5 -12 years of experience in Digital or Omnichannel marketing, Marketing operations or Commercial operations, ideally in the pharmaceutical, biotechnology or healthcare sector.**
* **Experience in medical samples management and its compliance requirements (sample plans, monitoring, audit readiness) is a strong advantage.**
* Proven stakeholder management and influencing skills across multiple markets and functions, with the ability to build credibility and drive decisions without direct authority.
* Experience partnering with delivery teams or service providers to define requirements, manage quality and resolve escalations.
* Strong analytical skills, with the ability to work with metrics and KPIs and translate insights into action.
* Passion for digital innovation and AI, with a track record of simplifying or improving processes.
* High degree of ownership and agility, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and independently drive programs to completion.
* Fluent English required; additional regional languages are an advantage. Ability to work across Asia-Pacific time zones.

Work Location Assignment: Hybrid

To learn more about acceptable and prohibited uses of AI during the recruitment process, please review our candidate AI-use guidelines available on   Pfizer Careers  .

3a1d1ba5.title: Product Program Manager RAD and Change Management
3a1d1ba5.description:
**Job Description Summary**
===========================

Lead Product Program Management for RAD subsystem products X-Ray Tubes and X-Ray Generators for mobile and fixed radiography systems. Drive Engineering design changes and Product Life Cycle Management for X-Ray Tubes and X-Ray Generators at GEBEL.
  
Own installed-base product performance and drive improvements in quality, reliability, regulatory compliance, lifecycle, cost and delivery, while leveraging installed-base data to establish reliability targets and Design for Reliability for new product introductions.  
  
GE HealthCare is a leading global medical technology and digital solutions innovator. Our purpose is to create a world where healthcare has no limits. Unlock your ambition, turn ideas into world-changing realities, and join an organization where every voice makes a difference, and every difference builds a healthier world

**Job Description**
===================

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own field and factory performance of RAD Tubes and Generators, with focus on quality, reliability, compliance, cost and delivery.
* Monitor field performance and Early Life Failure (ELF) trends using FoA, IPFR90 and IPFR180 metrics and represent product performance in global reviews.
* Analyze field and reliability data using statistical methods, including Weibull analysis and B10/B50 life estimation, to identify risks and improvement opportunities.
* Lead customer complaint and field failure investigations, including field-return autopsy, failure analysis, RCA, corrective actions and product fixes.
* Partner with System Engineering, Field Engineering and Service teams for technical troubleshooting, product training and resolution of field issues.
* Support NPIs with reliability target setting, leveraging installed-base performance, failure trends and reliability insights.
* Support Risk Management activities, including DFMEA/PFMEA, design reviews, Verification & Validation and risk assessments.
* Maintain Technical Files, Risk Management and Design Control documentation, ensuring QMS compliance and audit readiness.
* Lead product lifecycle initiatives covering obsolescence, product improvements, regulatory compliance and Variable Cost Productivity (VCP).
* Chair Engineering Change Control Board (ECCB) reviews and drive timely, technically rigorous and QMS-compliant engineering changes for X-Ray Tubes and Generators.
* Serve as Engineering BPOC for Supplier Change Requests (SCRs), including initial impact assessment, cross-functional coordination and assignment of change owners.
* Represent Engineering during QMS, regulatory, certification and customer audits, and support Quality Management Reviews.
* Partner with Manufacturing, Quality, Regulatory, Service, Supplier Quality and Sourcing to improve product quality, manufacturing yield, reliability and cost.
* Apply statistical methodologies to drive structured problem solving, RCA and continuous improvement.

2db7859a.title: Senior Technical Program Manager
2db7859a.description:
**About The Team**
Zillow's People Technology organization builds and operates the platforms that power how Zillow employees work: Workday, ServiceNow, and the agentic AI layer connecting these systems to the surfaces employees use every day - Slack, Google Workspace, Zoom, and AI tools. The India engineering team owns this platform stack end to end: production access, change ownership, on-call rotation, and direct relationships with the business teams we support.
  
  
Zillow Group is a strategic, mission-driven organization focused on delivering exceptional experiences and measurable outcomes. Our work spans cross-functional partnership, scalable programs and operational excellence in support of Zillow’s mission. We bring deep experience working across diverse teams in a dynamic, high-growth environment, balancing strategic thinking with hands-on execution to drive meaningful business impact. We are seeking an experienced professional to support our workforce expansion in India.
  
  
**Zillow Group is a strategic, mission-driven organization focused on delivering exceptional experiences and measurable outcomes.**
Our work spans cross-functional partnership, scalable programs and operational excellence in support of Zillow’s mission. We bring deep experience working across diverse teams in a dynamic, high-growth environment, balancing strategic thinking with hands-on execution to drive meaningful business impact. We are seeking an experienced professional to support our workforce expansion in India.
  
  
**About The Role**
As Sr. Technical Program Manager, you are the connective tissue of the PeopleTech delivery model. You own the sprint cadence, the handoff quality gate between Product and Engineering, and the cross-team coordination that keeps India-based engineering and US-based product and business partners in sync. You are a single, senior individual contributor - not a team of TPMs - which means you need to be decisive, organized, and confident operating across time zones without a lot of structural backup.
  
  
You will work directly with the Product Managers (US-based) and the India Engineering team, and will be a key voice in how the model matures over time. This is a high-visibility role in a new operating model that is still being built; you will help define how it works, not just execute inside it.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Own sprint execution end to end: create and close sprints in Jira, run grooming and planning, lead standup, track capacity and velocity, and ensure all stories are estimated and complete before each sprint closes.
* Serve as the handoff quality gate between Product and Engineering: review stories for build readiness before sprint commitment, flag ambiguity or missing technical context, and resolve open requirements questions in partnership with PM and Engineering before work begins.
* Own the US-India coordination bridge: run a daily touchpoint with the PM to carry blocker and handoff status, facilitate the overlap-window ceremonies (grooming, sprint planning, sprint demo) where PM and Engineering both need to be present, and maintain async-first practices that keep live meeting load low.
* Manage cross-team dependencies and risks: identify sequencing issues and resource constraints early, route blockers to the right owner (Engineering or PM), and escalate to leadership when something threatens delivery.
* Coordinate Unit Test logistics: manage test resources, defect tracking, and the communication between Engineering and the PM during unit testing cycles.
* Document the team's operational model: post-launch on-call and support structure, escalation paths, and the handoff from project delivery into business-as-usual operations.
* Drive continuous improvement: use retrospective findings to sharpen handoff processes, story quality, and sprint predictability over time; build and share repeatable practices that improve how the team works.
* Apply AI tools to program work: status synthesis, risk and dependency tracking, meeting notes and follow-ups, draft communications - and help the broader team build that fluency.

This role has been categorized as an Office position. “Office” employees regularly work at the Zillow India office for approximately 80 to 100 percent of their time each month. Employees must live within a reasonable commuting distance of the office. Zillow has not defined a reasonable distance, and expects employees will use judgment in determining this for themselves and understand the implications re: time commitment and cost of daily commute.
  
  
Who you are
  
  

* 5-8 years of technical program or project/scrum team management experience delivering complex, cross-functional programs in enterprise SaaS or platform environments.
* Demonstrated ownership of programs spanning multiple teams end to end, including programs where you defined scope and goals yourself in ambiguous conditions.
* Strong technical fluency: you can understand and explain how Workday, ServiceNow, or comparable enterprise platforms fit together, reason about integration dependencies, and assess whether a user story is ready to build - without needing to write the code yourself.
