47982277.title: AI Presales Solutions Architect
47982277.description:
**Job Description**

**AI Presales Solutions Architect — Agentic AI, India & APAC**

*Company: Intellect Design Arena | Platform: Purple Fabric (Agentic AI) |Region: India & APAC*

**About the Role**

Purple Fabric is Intellect's agentic AI platform, and this role exists to make it the default choice for enterprise buyers across India and APAC. That means owning the regional GTM motion end to end — but it also means being in the room when a CTO or lead architect starts asking how the agent orchestration actually works, how the platform handles evaluation and guardrails, or how it integrates into their existing stack. This role does not work as a pure narrative-and-relationships play. The person needs enough hands-on fluency in agentic AI and LLM-based systems to hold that conversation directly, then walk straight into the CXO's office and reframe the same substance as a transformation story.

**This is the core differentiator for this hire**
: equal credibility with a business sponsor and a technical evaluator, in the same deal, often the same week.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Market Penetration & Strategic Evangelism**

* **Establish Platform Preference:**
  Align GTM motions with local market priorities through leadership discussions and cross-functional collaboration.
* **Executive & Technical Engagement:**
  Lead conversations with priority prospects across both the CXO layer and the technical evaluation team — shaping the transformation agenda with sponsors while fielding architecture, security, and integration questions from their engineering and platform teams without needing an SME to translate.
* **Brand Visibility:**
  Drive thought leadership and regional presence through masterclasses, roundtables, and industry events — speaking with authority on agentic AI, not just platform positioning.
* **Cross-Functional Alignment:**
  Partner with Sales, Product, and Delivery to ensure consistent messaging, solution articulation, and unified GTM alignment across all client and partner interactions.

**Partner-Led GTM Acceleration & Ecosystem Enablement**

* **Scale Partner Initiatives:**
  Drive partner-led GTM initiatives to expand regional adoption and platform positioning.
* **Playbook Development:**
  Build structured partner GTM playbooks covering positioning, use cases, deployment models, and industry narratives — grounded in real agentic AI implementation patterns, not generic templates.
* **Partner Enablement:**
  Lead enablement programs, including technical onboarding, deployment orientation post-VDA sign-off, and bootcamps focused on opportunity identification and value mapping.
* **Success Frameworks:**
  Establish partner success metrics to improve adoption consistency, integrating domain and technical SMEs into engagements for contextual depth.

**Client Adoption & Strategic Engagement Excellence**

* **Engagement Frameworks:**
  Drive structured engagement frameworks to accelerate enterprise adoption and long-term platform positioning.
* **Strategic Roadmaps:**
  Lead maturity-aligned engagement sessions and build account-level roadmaps tied to client transformation priorities.
* **Adoption Journeys:**
  Own the client journey from discovery through PoC scoping and technical validation, ensuring both executive alignment and engineering sign-off before deals progress.

**Sales Excellence, Strategic Assets & Team Enablement**

* **Empower the Field:**
  Equip regional teams with winning narratives and the technical grounding to defend them under questioning.
* **Asset Management:**
  Maintain and evolve the Purple Fabric Sales Kit — pitch decks, demos, architecture diagrams, case studies, and industry narratives.
* **Sales Readiness:**
  Run enablement sessions that build both pitching confidence and technical objection handling — architecture, data privacy, model behavior, integration effort.
* **Feedback Loops:**
  Implement post-engagement client feedback mechanisms to continuously refine assets and messaging.

**Adoption Acceleration & Strategic Continuity Governance**

* **Value Discovery:**
  Lead structured bootcamps and demonstration sessions to identify relevant agentic AI use cases, providing roadmap clarity beyond the first meeting.
* **Execution Guidance:**
  Deliver prioritized use-case recommendations and phased execution guidance, integrating SMEs for contextual depth.
* **Strategic Oversight:**
  Maintain visibility of engagement progression across priority accounts, driving the transition from exploratory discussion to PoC or implementation.

**GTM Capability & Team Leadership**

* **Build the Function:**
  Build, scale, and lead a regional GTM function that is technically credible, not just relationship-driven.
* **Operational Rhythm:**
  Define role charters, engagement models, and operating rhythm for the regional GTM team.
* **Mentorship & Readiness:**
  Coach team members to handle executive-facing and technical-facing conversations with equal confidence; build structured onboarding for new hires.
* **Culture & Discipline:**
  Set narrative and technical communication standards, and foster cross-functional collaboration.

**Must-Have**

* **10+ years**
  in Go-To-Market, presales, or solution consulting for AI/ML-based products or platforms — this is a hard requirement. Generic enterprise software or B2B SaaS presales without an AI/data platform component will not meet the bar.
* **Technical depth in AI systems:**
  working knowledge of how LLM-based and agentic systems are actually built and evaluated — agent orchestration, RAG, prompt/context engineering, model evaluation and guardrails, and how these integrate into enterprise architectures (APIs, data pipelines, security/compliance layers).
* **Dual-mode fluency:**
  demonstrated ability to run a CXO transformation conversation and a technical deep-dive with an engineering or architecture team in the same sales cycle, without relying on a technical SME to carry the room.
* **Executive presence:**
  proven track record engaging C-level executives and guiding enterprise digital transformation conversations.

**Strongly Preferred**

* **Agentic AI presales experience specifically**
  — having sold, positioned, or architected agentic (multi-agent, autonomous workflow) AI platforms, not just traditional ML or analytics tools.
* Direct exposure to enterprise buyers evaluating agentic AI in regulated industries (BFSI, insurance, wealth management) across India or APAC.

**Also Important**

* **Regional Expertise:**
  Deep understanding of the enterprise technology landscape across India and the broader APAC region.
* **Partner Ecosystems:**
  Experience building and scaling partner-led GTM motions and enablement programs.
* **Leadership:**
  Demonstrated ability to build, mentor, and scale high-performing, cross-functional teams in a fast-paced environment.

**This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Solutions Architect based in India.**
This is a strategic, commercially focused role at the intersection of IT solutions, procurement, supplier management, and complex bid delivery. You will help shape competitive solutions that support major sales opportunities while improving commercial outcomes and supplier value. Working across sales, operations, customers, partners, and internal solution teams, you will coordinate stakeholders from opportunity through successful deployment. The role requires both strategic thinking and hands-on execution, particularly in high-pressure, complex sales environments. You will influence commercial decisions, negotiate with suppliers, and design value-added approaches that improve margins and delivery outcomes. Fully remote and aligned with UK office hours, the role offers the opportunity to work across international markets and complex, multi-partner IT environments.
  
  
**Accountabilities**

* Develop commercially competitive solutions and negotiated supplier costs that support successful bids, improve margins, and strengthen overall commercial performance.
* Act as a key interface between Sales, Operations, customers, prospects, partners, and internal solution teams throughout the solution lifecycle.
* Lead and coordinate complex and major bids, managing the formal bid communication process and bringing together virtual bid teams to maximize opportunities for success.
* Provide timely responses and effective follow-up to multiple stakeholders, managing competing priorities in a fast-paced sales environment.
* Develop creative, value-added solutions that address customer requirements while achieving strong commercial and operational outcomes.

* Manage supplier relationships and negotiations to achieve competitive pricing, stronger service performance, improved working practices, and sustainable value.
* Support solution activities across bid management, customer account management, operational management, service management, supplier management, transition, and project delivery.
* Coordinate transition solutions involving IT outsourcing, desktop and hardware deployment, service transition, global audits, logistics, procurement, and stock management.
* Manage multiple solutions and projects simultaneously, including international engagements delivered across several countries and through multiple partners.
* Drive continuous improvement by aligning internal and supplier capabilities, identifying operational synergies, and developing effective ways of working.
* Influence stakeholders and suppliers without relying on formal authority, resolving conflicts and building mutually beneficial outcomes.
* Monitor external market developments, technology trends, and changes in the IT services landscape to inform solution design and supplier strategies.
* Delegate responsibilities effectively and maintain clear ownership across virtual and matrix-managed teams.
* Ensure solutions are aligned with customer expectations, operational capabilities, commercial objectives, and the technologies underpinning the service portfolio.

**Requirements**

* Relevant bachelor's degree or equivalent professional qualification; MCIPS qualification is advantageous.
* Demonstrated experience in influencing, negotiation, and delivering solutions within matrix-managed environments.
* Proven experience in the IT field services industry, particularly hardware remedial services and related service delivery environments.
* Experience across several relevant disciplines, including bid management, customer account management, operational management, service management, supplier management, transition management, and project management.
* Previous experience working within complex, multicultural, international, and matrix-managed organizations.
* Strong supplier-management and relationship-building skills, with the ability to use strategic supplier relationships to improve cost control, service quality, operational practices, and performance.
* Strong results orientation, with a sense of urgency and the resilience to overcome obstacles and deliver against challenging objectives.
* Strategic and visionary thinking, with the ability to develop supplier-selection and management strategies and translate them into clear, actionable business objectives.
* Strong execution skills and a track record of driving continuous improvement across supplier and internal relationships.
* Excellent influencing and negotiation capabilities, including the ability to gain stakeholder support, manage conflict, and create mutually beneficial outcomes.
* Strong understanding of IT outsourcing, desktop and hardware deployment, service transition, logistics, procurement, stock management, and global audit activities.
* Experience managing multiple solutions or projects concurrently across different countries, customers, and delivery partners.
* Broad understanding of IT technologies, market trends, product developments, and the technology underpinning managed IT services.
* Strong analytical ability and a consultative approach to solution development and stakeholder engagement.
* Proven ability to build and manage relationships with customers, suppliers, partners, and internal stakeholders.
* Highly effective written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to adapt communication style to different audiences and organizational levels.
* Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite.
* Ability to delegate tasks, responsibilities, and decision-making authority effectively.
* Demonstrated ability to influence business processes without relying on hierarchical authority.
* Strong stakeholder-management skills and the ability to operate effectively in a complex matrix environment.
* Personable, collaborative, proactive, commercially aware, and comfortable operating under pressure.
* Willingness and ability to work UK office hours while based remotely in India.

**Benefits**

* Fully remote position based in India.
* Full-time employment with a working schedule aligned to UK office hours.
* Opportunity to work on complex, international IT solutions and major commercial bids.
* Exposure to global customers, suppliers, partners, and multi-country service delivery environments.
* Opportunity to influence commercial strategy, supplier performance, solution design, and business outcomes.
* High level of stakeholder interaction across sales, operations, procurement, service management, and delivery teams.
* Opportunity to develop expertise across IT outsourcing, field services, procurement, transition management, and solution architecture.
* Collaborative, multicultural, and matrix-based working environment.
* Opportunity to contribute to continuous improvement and innovative approaches to managed IT services.
* Inclusive workplace committed to diversity, equal opportunity, and creating an environment where different perspectives and backgrounds are valued.

Pakt is an AI-native hiring platform that helps organizations accelerate recruitment through AI-powered sourcing, candidate screening, interviews, assessments, and hiring automation. This role involves collaborating with sales, product, engineering, and customer success teams to understand business objectives, translate them into solution architectures, and lead technical discussions with prospective and existing customers. The Senior Solutions Architect will conduct discovery sessions, analyze current systems and business processes, define integration patterns, and produce technical artifacts such as solution designs, data flow diagrams, and implementation plans. Day-to-day responsibilities include advising clients on best practices, guiding implementation and integration activities, troubleshooting complex issues, and ensuring performance, scalability, security, and reliability of deployed solutions. The role also contributes to product feedback, creates reusable solution templates, supports pre-sales efforts, and mentors junior team members on architecture standards and client-facing delivery.

* Hands-on background in Software Development, with proficiency in modern programming languages, APIs, and microservices, and the ability to review and guide implementation.

ea143a70.title: Solution Consultant - Direct Sale
ea143a70.description:
**Role Overview**

As a Solution Architect/ Consultant for Direct Sales, you will be the ultimate technical bridge between SIONIQ's advanced capabilities and major jewelry enterprise clients. You will not just pitch softwareyou will map complex business workflows (metal weight controls, wastage tracking, stone attributes, and layout-based approvals) into elegant architectural solutions using SIONIQ JOS.

The defining requirement of this role is your ability to conduct highly technical, end-to-end, deep-dive demonstrations that command the respect of traditional promoters, CFOs, operations heads, and IT directors across the retail, wholesale, and manufacturing jewelry segments.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Deep-Dive Technical Demonstrations: Deliver meticulous, master-level product demonstrations tailored to jewelry industry stakeholders, simulating real-life scenarios like gold-to-diamond swapping, karigar wastage calculations, RFID inventory tracking, and multi-branch accounting.
* Solution Architecture Design: Map out the client’s existing technical environment and design the future-state blueprint using SIONIQ JOS, outlining data migrations, custom workflows, and API integrations with accounting or e-commerce platforms.
* Direct Sales Collaboration: Partner closely with Account Executives on strategic enterprise deals, steering the technical qualification process and validating compliance, security, and infrastructure requirements.
* Discovery & Workflow Assessment: Conduct on-site technical discoveries at client manufacturing units, wholesale vaults, and retail showrooms to uncover hidden operational inefficiencies or product leaks.
* Proof of Concept (PoC) Ownership: Build and lead tailored PoCs for premier prospects, proving the concrete business value, speed, and real-time inventory control capabilities of the platform.
* RFIs & Technical Documentation: Own the technical responses for Requests for Proposals/Information (RFPs/RFIs) and author comprehensive architectural solution blueprints for handoff to the implementation team.

**Required Skills & Experience**

Domain Expertise (Non-Negotiable)

* Jewelry Value Chain Mastery: Comprehensive understanding of jewelry operational mechanics, including pure metal vs. alloy calculations, making charges, stone sieve sizes, hallmark compliance, and live bullion rate feeds.
* Segment Familiarity: Deep appreciation for the distinct operational differences separating Manufacturers (line planning, raw materials), Wholesalers (B2B credit, approval memos), and Retailers (barcoding, loyalty, multi-store exchange policies).

Technical & Sales Acumen

* Solution Architecture: Minimum of 3–6 years of experience as a Sales Engineer, Solution Architect, or Lead Implementation Consultant for Enterprise ERP/POS software.
* Demonstration Mastery: Exceptional capability to showcase complex enterprise logic under pressure, addressing edge-case workflow adjustments effortlessly on screen.
* Tech Stack Fluency: Comfortable explaining SaaS vs. cloud vs. on-premise deployments, relational databases (SQL Server/PostgreSQL), and modern Web/Mobile API structures.
* C-Suite Communication: Polished verbal and written communication style capable of shifting fluidly from a granular technical talk with an IT Director to a high-level ROI conversation with a jewelry brand founder.

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience deploying or selling regional or global jewelry ERP systems (e.g., customized SAP modules, legacy jewelry software).
* Direct experience handling hardware integrations common to the jewelry industry, such as RFID tags, security scanners, or smart precision scales.

2263c01d.title: Technology Solution Engineer
2263c01d.description:
**Role Overview**

The Technology Solution Engineer works with business and technology stakeholders to shape technical solutions, then builds them. This is a deliberately broad, hands-on role that combines consultative solution design with real delivery across the enterprise technology platforms.

  

At this level, the Technology Solution Engineer owns solutions end to end. The role runs requirement workshops directly with business stakeholders, authors the design, makes independent technical decisions, and leads the build through to operational handover. Work spans the full platform estate rather than a single technology, and includes reviewing the work of others and mentoring less experienced engineers.

The platforms in scope include cloud infrastructure on Microsoft Azure and Amazon Web Services, integration, automation, APIs, containers, and web hosting. Platforms are run both as internal products and as managed services, so the role carries accountability for how solutions run as well as how they are built.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Solution Consulting and Design**

* Engage business functions and technology stakeholders to understand objectives, constraints, and the problem behind the request.

* Facilitate requirement and design workshops, and translate outcomes into clear technical solution designs.

* Produce options analyses with honest trade-offs across cost, risk, delivery time, supportability, and strategic fit.

* Author solution designs, architecture decision records, interface definitions, and non-functional requirements.

**Cross-Platform Solution Delivery**

* Design and build solutions spanning cloud infrastructure, integration, APIs, automation, containers, and web hosting.

* Provision and configure platform services using Terraform, Ansible, and the approved Infrastructure as Code toolchain.

* Develop supporting automation and tooling in Python, PowerShell, Bash, or another appropriate language.

* Lead technical delivery of solutions involving multiple platforms and multiple contributing teams.

**Service Transition and Operational Ownership**

* Ensure solutions meet operational readiness criteria before production release, including monitoring, alerting, runbooks, backup, and recovery.

* Instrument solutions for observability using Datadog, Dynatrace, Prometheus, Grafana, Splunk, Cribl, or Observe.

* Own investigation and resolution of complex issues, root-cause analysis, and preventive corrective actions.

**Security, Compliance, and Risk**

* Design and build to enterprise security standards, applying identity and access patterns based on Entra ID, Okta, OAuth2, and least privilege.

* Manage secrets and certificates through HashiCorp Vault, CyberArk, and cloud-native key services.

* Identify and articulate technical risk, technical debt, and exceptions, with practical remediation proposals.

**Technical Craft and Engineering Practices**

* Write clean, tested, peer-reviewed code and configuration, managed in version control with trunk-based practices.

* Review the work of other engineers and raise the standard of design and implementation across the team.

* Use AI-assisted engineering tools such as GitHub Copilot and Claude Code to accelerate design, development, testing, and documentation, applying appropriate review and technical judgement.

**Collaboration and Ways of Working**

* Work within an agile team with a shared backlog, defined customers, and service-level objectives.

* Act as a credible technical partner to business stakeholders, explaining trade-offs in plain language.

* Coordinate across platform, cloud, integration, web, security, architecture, and operations teams.

* Mentor less experienced engineers through pairing, review, and structured feedback.

**Qualifications**

**Required**

* Demonstrated capability in solution engineering, platform engineering, or technical delivery

* Strong hands-on experience with at least one major public cloud, with practical exposure to a second.

* Proven ability to own a solution end to end, from requirements through design, build, and operational handover.

* Practical Infrastructure as Code experience with Terraform, and configuration management with Ansible.

* Proficiency in at least one scripting or programming language such as Python, PowerShell, Bash, JavaScript, or Java.

* Working knowledge across several of: containers and Kubernetes, integration and APIs, web hosting, networking, and identity.

* Demonstrated ability to run workshops and engage business stakeholders directly.

* Clear written and verbal communication in English, including presenting designs to technical and non-technical audiences.

**Preferred**

* Experience mentoring engineers or leading small technical workstreams.

* Experience with OpenShift, Backstage or another developer portal, and GitOps tooling.

* Experience with integration or API platforms such as MuleSoft, Kafka, Solace, or Kong.

* Experience with web and application server technologies such as IIS, Tomcat, Apache, or Nginx.

* Experience delivering within a validated, GxP, or otherwise regulated environment, including awareness of data-protection obligations such as GDPR.

* Certifications such as AWS or Azure professional or expert level, Certified Kubernetes Administrator, HashiCorp Terraform Associate, ITIL, or an agile qualification.

* A bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, information technology, or a related discipline.

**Core Competencies**

* Consultative mindset with genuine interest in the business problem

* Strong technical judgement and architectural awareness

* Breadth across technologies combined with useful depth in several

* Clear communication and stakeholder credibility

* Bias toward reuse, standardisation, and simplification

* Ownership and accountability from design through to operation

* Willingness to mentor and raise the standard around them

**Measures of Success**

* Solutions delivered to agreed scope, quality, cost, and timeline

* Increased reuse of approved patterns and platform capabilities, and reduced bespoke build

* Reduced defects, rework, and post-implementation incidents

* Improved availability and supportability of delivered solutions

* Stakeholder satisfaction and repeat demand from business functions

* Reduced security findings and audit exceptions in delivered solutions

* Demonstrable growth in the engineers mentored

c5c8470a.title: Solutions Architect
c5c8470a.description:
**About ZEISS VisioGen**

ZEISS VisioGen is building the future of AI-powered healthcare by developing human-verified clinical communication solutions for ophthalmology practices. We combine cutting-edge Generative AI with clinical expertise to build scalable, production-ready applications that enhance patient engagement and improve healthcare delivery.

**Role Overview**

**Role Summary**

We are looking for a
**Solution Architect**
to support the design, implementation, integration, and scaling of
**ZEISS VisioGen**
, a human-verified AI patient engagement platform built for premium ophthalmology practices.

The role will act as a bridge between business teams, product teams, engineering, IT, customer success, and external clinic partners. The Solution Architect will be responsible for understanding clinic workflows, defining technical solution designs, supporting integrations, ensuring secure and scalable implementation, and helping convert business requirements into practical technology solutions.

This role requires a strong understanding of SaaS platforms, healthcare workflows, AI-enabled products, API integrations, data security, and enterprise IT governance.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Solution Design & Architecture**

* Design scalable, secure, and clinic-ready solution architectures for VisioGen implementations.
* Convert business and customer requirements into clear technical solution designs.
* Define end-to-end workflows covering chatbot interface, AI response generation, human review, clinic escalation, reporting, and system integration.
* Ensure the platform architecture supports reliability, performance, security, and future scalability.

**2. Customer & Clinic Implementation Support**

* Work with US ophthalmology clinics to understand their website, patient inquiry flow, appointment booking process, CRM usage, and operational workflow.
* Identify how VisioGen can be embedded into each clinic’s digital ecosystem.
* Support technical discovery calls with customers, partners, and vendors.
* Prepare implementation documents, integration notes, workflow maps, and technical requirement documents.

**3. Integration & API Management**

* Evaluate and design integrations with clinic websites, CRMs, scheduling tools, marketing platforms, analytics tools, and communication systems.
* Work with APIs, webhooks, data exchange formats, and middleware platforms such as Zapier, HubSpot, or similar systems.
* Coordinate with internal and external development teams to ensure integrations are delivered correctly.
* Troubleshoot integration gaps and recommend practical workarounds where needed.

**4. Security, Compliance & Governance**

* Ensure all solution designs follow healthcare data privacy, security, and compliance expectations, including HIPAA-aligned workflows where applicable.
* Work closely with ZEISS IT, CIT, InfoSec, and compliance teams for tool approvals and architecture reviews.
* Support risk assessment, data flow documentation, access control planning, and vendor evaluation.
* Ensure AI workflows are designed with appropriate human-in-the-loop review and governance.

**5. Product & Platform Enablement**

* Partner with product managers to define technical feasibility for new product features.
* Provide architecture inputs for dashboards, analytics, reporting, AI workflows, and clinic-specific customization.
* Identify reusable implementation models that can reduce deployment time across multiple clinics.
* Support creation of internal playbooks, SOPs, technical FAQs, and implementation templates.

**6. Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Collaborate with sales, customer success, clinical operations, engineering, product, IT, and external clinic stakeholders.
* Support pre-sales conversations by explaining technical capabilities in simple business language.
* Help sales teams respond to technical questions from clinics, marketing partners, and service providers.
* Act as the technical owner during implementation and post-go-live stabilization.

**Required Skills & Experience**

**Technical Skills**

* Strong experience in solution architecture, SaaS implementation, or enterprise platform design.
* Good understanding of APIs, webhooks, system integrations, middleware, and cloud-based platforms.
* Experience with CRM, scheduling, chatbot, marketing automation, or patient engagement platforms is preferred.
* Understanding of AI-enabled workflows, GenAI platforms, and human-in-the-loop review models.
* Ability to create technical diagrams, workflow maps, data flow documents, and integration architecture notes.
* Basic understanding of cloud infrastructure, authentication, access control, monitoring, and data security.

**Healthcare / Domain Skills**

* Experience in healthcare technology, digital health, ophthalmology, patient engagement, or clinical workflow platforms is preferred.
* Understanding of HIPAA, healthcare data privacy, and patient communication workflows will be an advantage.
* Ability to understand clinic operations, patient inquiry journeys, appointment booking workflows, and escalation models.

**Business & Communication Skills**

* Ability to translate business requirements into technical solutions.
* Ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
* Strong documentation, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.
* Comfortable working with global teams, especially US-based customers and internal ZEISS stakeholders.
* Strong problem-solving mindset with the ability to balance speed, compliance, and scalability.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Digital Health, or related field.
* 10-20 years of experience in solution architecture, technical consulting, SaaS implementation, or healthcare IT.
* Prior experience working with startups, venture-backed products, or fast-moving digital product teams is a plus.
* Experience with tools such as HubSpot, Zoho, Salesforce, Zapier, Microsoft Teams, Outlook, Google Analytics, or similar platforms is an advantage.
* Experience preparing architecture documents for IT, security, compliance, or enterprise approval processes.

**Key Success Metrics**

* Faster and smoother VisioGen clinic implementations.
* Reduced dependency on ad hoc technical decision-making.
* Clear integration and architecture documentation for each customer.
* Improved collaboration between business, product, IT, and engineering teams.
* Scalable implementation framework for onboarding multiple ophthalmology clinics.
* Secure, compliant, and reliable solution designs.

**Ideal Candidate Profile**

The ideal candidate is someone who can think like an architect, communicate like a consultant, and execute like a product implementation owner. They should be comfortable working in a startup-like environment within a large enterprise ecosystem. They should be able to simplify complex technical topics, work with multiple stakeholders, and design solutions that are practical, secure, scalable, and customer-ready.

8730ad80.title: Technical Account Manager
8730ad80.description:
**This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Technical Account Manager based in India.**
This is a senior customer-facing role focused on building trusted technical partnerships with premium support accounts. You will act as a strategic advisor, connecting customer business needs with product capabilities and technical solutions. The role combines account management, technical support, project coordination, escalation management, and customer success. You will work across internal and external stakeholders to resolve complex issues and maintain strong customer relationships. You will also help customers maximize the value of their technology investments while driving product adoption and software upgrades. The position offers broad exposure to enterprise software, insurance technology, and cross-functional delivery. Occasional work outside standard hours may be required for critical incidents and high-priority customer needs.
  
  
Accountabilities
  
  

* Act as a trusted technical advisor for assigned premium support accounts, developing strong relationships with customer stakeholders and maintaining conversational-level expertise across the relevant product portfolio.
* Map customer business processes to product capabilities, identify gaps, and coordinate appropriate solutions within agreed timelines.
* Own customer incidents, escalations, support tickets, and business pain points through resolution, ensuring clear communication and regular updates throughout the process.
* Partner with internal technical and support teams to develop action plans, prioritize backlogs, resolve issues, and manage sensitive customer situations.
* Ensure root-cause analyses are completed and communicated to customers following critical incidents.
* Establish regular communication cadences, including weekly support updates, monthly operational reviews, and quarterly stakeholder alignment meetings.
* Proactively communicate product updates, supportability considerations, strategic product plans, and other information relevant to customer success.
* Develop and manage project plans for software upgrades, including requirements, stakeholder coordination, deployment planning, communications, and successful release execution.
* Help customers maximize the business value of their purchased products and services while encouraging effective product adoption and minimizing unnecessary customization.
* Maintain and expand knowledge of current and upcoming products, integrations, support processes, and relevant technical capabilities.
* Participate in health checks, release management, change requests, bureau adoption initiatives, monitoring activities, and other account-level programs.
* Manage multiple projects and priorities while maintaining strong customer engagement and delivery quality.
* Support Sev1 escalations and other critical customer issues outside standard working hours when required.

**Requirements**

* 10+ years of experience in customer engagement, technical support, technical account management, or a related customer-facing technology role.
* 3–5 years of experience working with insurance technology or within the property and casualty insurance domain is preferred.
* Bachelor's degree or global equivalent in a relevant discipline.
* Excellent interpersonal, written, verbal, and presentation skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Strong consulting, leadership, problem-solving, and decision-making capabilities, particularly when managing complex issues involving multiple functions and stakeholders.
* Proven project management skills, including the ability to coordinate multiple initiatives simultaneously and maintain delivery against timelines.
* Experience collaborating cross-functionally with customers, technical teams, business stakeholders, and leadership.
* Experience with software implementation projects involving requirements gathering, functional specifications, quality assurance, user acceptance testing, or training.
* Understanding of software development lifecycle methodologies and foundational software concepts such as HTML, XML, relational databases, and reporting tools.
* Experience applying change management principles within software implementation or transformation initiatives.
* Working knowledge of the business and technical environments in which enterprise software operates, with a solid understanding of relevant P&C insurance processes.
* Familiarity with architecture frameworks and software design patterns.
* ITIL Foundation certification is preferred.
* TOGAF and/or Agile Product Owner certification is a plus.
* Ability to operate effectively as a technical advisor and leader across varied business environments.

**Benefits**

* Fully remote working opportunity from India.
* Senior, customer-facing position with significant ownership of strategic accounts.
* Opportunity to work closely with enterprise customers and senior stakeholders.
* Exposure to insurance technology, enterprise software, product integrations, implementation, and technical support.
* Opportunity to influence customer outcomes, product adoption, and long-term account health.
* Cross-functional collaboration with technical, support, product, and business teams.
* Opportunities to strengthen consulting, leadership, project management, and technical advisory skills.
* Exposure to software upgrades, release management, health checks, change initiatives, and complex customer escalations.
* Full-time employment with opportunities to contribute to high-impact customer initiatives.
* Occasional flexibility to support critical Sev1 incidents and priority customer needs outside standard working hours.

82b946a4.title: Delivery Manager
82b946a4.description:
Please note that we will only be able to accept candidates who have the appropriate rights and documentation for employment in India.

**Who We Are.**

Axi is a leading global provider of margin and deliverable Foreign Exchange, Contracts for Difference (CFDs), and Financial Spread betting. Our business has evolved into a world-class, multifaceted brokerage with offices in six regions. With heavy investment in the latest trading technology, Axi seeks to offer the most comprehensive end-to-end trading experience available, servicing traders of all levels from beginners to institutional-level clients.

**Let's talk about the cool stuff you will do at Axi!**

We are looking for an experienced
**Delivery Manager**
to drive the successful delivery of strategic technology initiatives across our global engineering teams. You will be responsible for owning the delivery lifecycle from planning through execution, ensuring projects are delivered on time, at the highest quality, and with predictable outcomes. This is an exciting opportunity to work in a fast-growing fintech organization where you'll lead transformation initiatives, partner with cross-functional stakeholders across global regions, and leverage modern technologies and AI-driven tools to continuously improve delivery excellence.

**Your EDGE Assignment / You Will**

**Delivery Cadence**

* Define, document, and continuously improve the team's delivery cadence — sprint/iteration length, ceremony schedule (planning, refinement, review, retro), and reporting rhythm.
* Ensure the cadence is followed: ceremonies happen on schedule, with the right people, producing real decisions.
* Adapt cadence to the needs of different workstreams (e.g., a fast-moving feature team vs. a compliance-heavy workstream) without fragmenting the organisation into inconsistent processes.

**Stage Gate Ownership**

* Own the criteria for moving work between stages (e.g., Discovery → Ready for Build → In Progress → Review → Release) and enforce them consistently.
* Act as the checkpoint before work advances: confirm acceptance criteria are met, dependencies are cleared, risk/compliance sign-offs are in hand, and Definition of Done is completed.
* Act when something is not ready and explain exactly what is missing and what is needed to pass the gate.
* Track and report exceptions/waivers when a gate is bypassed and ensure it is a deliberate decision.

**Delivery Planning**

* Build delivery plans grounded in real data: backlog sizing (story points/estimates), team velocity history, known dependencies, and risk.
* Convert scope and velocity into realistic timelines and communicate them as ranges with clear assumptions and confidence levels.
* Re-forecast the plan on a regular cadence (e.g., every sprint) as scope, velocity, or risk changes, and proactively flag slippage.
* Maintain visibility tools (burnup/burndown, roadmap views, RAID logs) that let stakeholders self-serve status.

**Cross-Team Coordination & Reporting**

* Be the primary point of contact for delivery status to leadership and stakeholders — translating team-level detail into a clear picture of progress, risk, and trade-offs.
* Identify and actively manage cross-team dependencies, blockers, and resourcing conflicts before they hit the critical path.
* Facilitate trade-off conversations (scope vs. time vs. quality) with data.

**Process Ownership & Continuous Improvement**

* Own the delivery process documentation (workflow stages, gate criteria, estimation method, ceremony structure) and keep it current, e.g. in Confluence.
* Run retrospectives that produce real process changes.
* Balance rigor with pragmatism — add process where it removes risk or ambiguity and remove process if not needed.

**Are you the one?**

* 8+ years in a Delivery Manager, Scrum Master, Program Manager, or Technical Project Manager role, ideally spanning multiple teams or workstreams.
* Demonstrated experience running Agile/Scrum (or Kanban/hybrid) delivery cadences end-to-end — not just attending ceremonies but designing and improving them.
* Hands-on experience with story-point estimation, velocity tracking, and forecasting delivery timelines from that data.
* Proven ability to hold a line on process/quality gates under deadline pressure, with the communication skill to do so without becoming a bottleneck or being seen as purely a blocker.
* Strong stakeholder management — comfortable presenting status, risk, and trade-offs to senior leadership.
* Fluency with delivery tooling (Jira, Confluence, or equivalent) and building reporting views (burnup/burndown, roadmaps, dashboards) that reduce manual status-chasing.
* Hands-on exposure to tools such as Postman and Datadog, with an interest in leveraging AI to improve delivery and operational efficiency.
* Proven experience delivering technology transformation initiatives, including system migrations, process transitions, or Global Capability Centre (GCC) setup and transition projects.
* Excellent written and verbal communication; able to turn ambiguous, fast-moving work into a clear plan and a clear narrative.

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience in [industry — e.g., fintech, trading platforms, regulated environments], particularly where compliance/risk sign-off is part of the stage-gate process.
* Certification such as CSM, PSM, SAFe, or PMP (useful signal, not a substitute for hands-on experience).
* Experience introducing or maturing a delivery process in an organization that didn't previously have one.

**Axi's bag of delights**

* Competitive and attractive compensation.
* Extensive learning opportunities including professional certifications and soft-skills development.
* 18 annual leave days and 12 sick leave days per year.
* Public holidays as declared by local government.
* Maternity leave as per law.
* Health insurance coverage.

**Axi's interview journey**

* Talent Acquisition Round – 45 Minutes
* Hiring Manager Interview – 1 Hour
* Technical Interview - 1 Hour
* Final Interview – 1 Hour

Please note that our organization works with recruitment agencies on a pre-approved basis only. A recruitment agency that wishes to submit candidate profiles or resumes for consideration must obtain prior written consent from our talent acquisition team. We do not accept unsolicited resumes from recruitment agencies, and we will not be responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes. Should we receive an unsolicited resume from a recruitment agency that does not have prior written consent, we will not be responsible for the payment of any fees related to the recruitment of the candidate represented in the unsolicited resume.

At Axi, we prioritize creating a workplace that upholds fairness and respect for all. We encourage every individual within our community to contribute towards a culture where everyone feels a sense of belonging and is treated with the dignity they deserve. We make all employment-related decisions—whether in hiring, compensation, training, performance reviews, or termination—based on merit and without bias, ensuring equal opportunities for everyone. We consciously work to identify and overcome any unconscious biases, with a commitment to fostering an inclusive environment where every employee and candidate feels genuinely welcomed and valued.

d0d21382.description:
**Opentext - The Information Company**
OpenText is a global leader in information management, where innovation, creativity, and collaboration are the key components of our corporate culture. As a member of our team, you will have the opportunity to partner with the most highly regarded companies in the world, tackle complex issues, and contribute to projects that shape the future of digital transformation.
  
  
**AI-First. Future-Driven. Human-Centered.**
At OpenText, AI is at the heart of everything we do—powering innovation, transforming work, and empowering digital knowledge workers. We're hiring talent that AI can't replace to help us shape the future of information management. Join us.
  
  
**Your Impact**
As a Development Manager, you will provide engineering leadership and delivery ownership for the modernization of a monolithic .NET application into containerized modern .NET (.NET 8+) microservices deployed on Kubernetes (Google Cloud Platform/GKE). Partner with architecture, product, and QA to plan and execute the migration roadmap, manage staffing and delivery for the Backend/Platform team, and ensure on-time, high-quality delivery using Agile/Scrum practices.
  
  
**What The Role Offers**

* Own end-to-end delivery of the monolith-to-microservices modernization program for the Backend/Platform team
* Plan sprints, manage backlogs, and coordinate cross-team dependencies with the UI/Frontend team and QA
* Recruit, staff, mentor, and manage performance of Principal Architects, Lead/Senior/Engineers, and QA engineers
* Report progress, risks, and budget status to senior leadership; escalate and resolve blockers
* Drive adoption of engineering best practices: code review standards, GitLab CI/CD, test automation, and DevSecOps
* Champion the .NET Framework to modern .NET (.NET 8+) migration strategy and containerization/Kubernetes rollout plans
* Facilitate architecture and design reviews together with the Principal Architect

Build and maintain strong relationships with stakeholders across Product, Architecture, and Operations
  
  
**What You Need To Succeed**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related discipline
* 10+ years overall engineering experience with 3+ years in an engineering management/leadership role
* Hands-on background in modern .NET (.NET 8+) application development and enterprise product delivery
* Proven track record managing complex modernization/migration programs (monolith-to-microservices a strong plus)
* Working knowledge of Docker, Kubernetes, GitLab CI/CD, Artifactory, and Google Cloud Platform (GCP)/Linux environments
* Strong Agile/Scrum delivery experience; excellent organization, communication, and planning skills
* Excellent interpersonal and stakeholder management skills Experience leading WPF-to-web migration initiatives
* Exposure to AI-assisted development tools like GitHub Copilot
* Content management & Capture (IDP) domain experience would be a plus
* Experience with Kubernetes on Linux in production environments (GCP/GKE)
* Exposure to GitLab CI/CD and Artifactory for build/artifact management
* Content management/enterprise information management & Capture (IDP) domain experience would be a plus

Experience with OpenText products would be a plus
  
  
OpenText's efforts to build an inclusive work environment go beyond simply complying with applicable laws. Our Employment Equity and Diversity Policy provides direction on maintaining a working environment that is inclusive of everyone, regardless of culture, national origin, race, color, gender, gender identification, sexual orientation, family status, age, veteran status, disability, religion, or other basis protected by applicable laws.

f909ba2f.title: Presales Manager
f909ba2f.description:
PFA the JD for the role of Presales Manager with Intellect Design Arena  

**Position**

**Pre-Sales Manager**

**Experience**

**5-12 Years**

**Grade**

**T3XX - Senior Manager / AVP**

**Location**

**Mumbai/ Chennai**

**About FuEL**

**FuEL**is **Intellect's Flagship program** designed to develop the next generation of transformation leaders for the global Fintech/Insuretech industry.

Created for high-potential professionals, the program equips participants to move beyond operational excellence and become trusted advisors who help financial institutions reimagine business models, accelerate digital & AI transformation and deliver exceptional customer experiences.

Your journey begins with an immersive four-week learning experience covering Digital Transformation, Product Immersion, Design Thinking and AI-led Banking Innovation. You'll gain deep exposure to Intellect's award-winning banking platforms across Consumer Banking, Corporate Banking, Transaction Banking, Capital Markets, Wealth and Insurance, while working alongside some of the industry's foremost banking, product and technology experts.

Explore more at: www.intellectdesign.com

**The Opportunity**

The best presales leaders don't just respond to RFPs—they shape how clients think about their business challenges before a competitive process even begins. This role is for that kind of leader.

As **Presales Manager**, you will own the solutioning agenda across complex, high-value deal pursuits—bringing together deep banking domain expertise, strategic thinking, consultative selling, and genuine individual and integrated product mastery to drive measurable customer value and win business that matters. You will be leading efforts to drive new sales, cross sell, and upsell at Intellect’s Key relationships engaging at the CXO level and solution with authority, and build the presales capability that turns market opportunities into signed engagements.

You will engage with business leaders across Retail Banking, Wholesale Banking, Transaction Banking, Payments, Lending, Treasury, and Wealth Management to understand strategic objectives, diagnose business challenges, and translate them into differentiated transformation opportunities.  
  
The role requires the ability to ask the right questions, challenge conventional thinking, bring external market perspectives, and guide customers from problem identification to solution vision.

You should be comfortable in working in a networked org design and in taking ownership of the outcome therefore to pool the best resources and solution that OneIntellect has to offer to its customers. This is a role for someone who is as comfortable in a boardroom solutioning session as they are shaping product strategy conversations with internal roadmap teams.

**Role Definition**

The Pre-Sales Manager primarily drives the early-stage sales cycle by actively shaping and qualifying pipeline opportunities through discovery and validation. They are responsible for translating customer requirements into compelling value propositions and demonstrating product value, while providing critical support in later pipeline stages to convert opportunities into successful deals.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Prospect Understanding**  
Engage with banking executives, business heads, product owners, and operations leaders to understand strategic priorities. Analyse banking business models, revenue drivers, operational challenges, and competitive pressures. Translate market trends into actionable transformation opportunities. Actively validate critical deal qualifiers—including Need/Problem, Decision Makers, Customer’s Timeline, Customer’s Budget runway, and Proposal intent to successfully graduate opportunities.

**2. Consultative Value Selling**Create Business Value to shape opportunities, influence decisions and improve win probability. Ability to articulate measurable business outcomes, ROI, and value propositions aligned to customer objectives. Help banks rethink customer journeys, operating models, and product strategies.

**3. Product Demonstrations and Client Workshops**  
Conduct high-quality product demonstrations, discovery workshops, proof-of-concept sessions, technical presentations, and solution walkthroughs for prospective clients aligned to their business needs. Ensure demo is aligned to use cases to prospect’s requirements and perform Demo Diagnostic

**4. RFP/RFI and Bid Support**Lead responses to RFPs, RFIs, questionnaires, and proposal documents. Ensure that responses are accurate, complete, compelling, and aligned with the customer’s stated requirements.

**5. Solutioning and Proposal Development**  
Design tailored high quality solution propositions using the company’s product capabilities, platform strengths, implementation approach, and domain expertise. Support the creation of scope documents, solution architecture inputs, effort estimates, implementation plans, timelines, assumptions, exclusions, and commercial inputs. Ensure that the proposed solution is practical, differentiated, and aligned to the customer’s needs.

**6. Coordination with Product, Engineering and Delivery Teams**  
Work closely with Product, Engineering, Architecture, Delivery, Implementation, and Support teams to validate solution feasibility, effort assumptions, customisation needs, integration approach, dependencies, and delivery risks.

**7. Sales Enablement**Equip the Sales team with product collateral, demo scripts, solution notes, competitive insights, objection-handling points, customer-specific messaging, and proof points to support effective selling.

**8. Market and Customer Feedback Loop**  
Capture feedback from prospects, clients, partners, competitive situations, demonstrations, and RFPs, and share structured insights with Product teams for roadmap, positioning, and solution improvement.

**9. Deal Conversion Support**Actively drive the early-stage sales cycle by shaping and graduating qualified opportunities. Act as a bridge between Sales, Product, and Delivery to ensure that the proposed solution is credible, client-specific, implementable, and capable of supporting successful deal closure.

**10. Knowledge Management**  
Maintain updated value proposition product decks, reusable proposal content, case studies, standard responses, FAQs, and solution artefacts to improve pre-sales productivity and consistency.

**11. Transition to Delivery**  
Support the handover from Sales to Delivery after deal closure by ensuring that the agreed scope, solution commitments, assumptions, risks, and client expectations are clearly documented and communicated.

**Experience & Qualifications**

 Extensive experience in the BFSI industry, with a strong track record in Presales, Solution Consulting, Product Consulting, or other customer-facing roles within banking, financial services, or fintech organizations.

 Deep domain expertise in one or more banking business areas, with the ability to understand customer needs, analyse business challenges, and design differentiated, practical, and commercially viable solution propositions.

 Proven experience leading complex sales pursuits, including customer discovery, executive workshops, product demonstrations and proof-of-concept engagements.

 Demonstrated ability to articulate product value, competitive differentiation, implementation strategy, and business outcomes, translating product capabilities into compelling customer-specific solutions.

 Strong commercial acumen with experience preparing solution proposals, scope documents, effort estimates, implementation plans, commercial inputs, and customer-facing collateral to support strategic business opportunities.

 Exceptional stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to engage and influence CXOs, business leaders, technical teams, partners, and cross-functional stakeholders across the sales lifecycle.

 Demonstrated ability to capture customer feedback, competitive intelligence, market trends, and emerging industry insights, leveraging them to strengthen product positioning, solution offerings, and continuous improvement.

 Proven success in enabling high-performing sales organizations through reusable solution assets, demo environments, knowledge repositories, and best practices, while ensuring a seamless transition from Sales to Delivery and consistently driving successful customer outcomes.

**Why This Role**

You will be operating at the forefront of banking transformation—where market strategy meets client needs, and where the quality of solutioning directly influences business success. You will have the opportunity, authority, and mandate to build a high-performing presales function that not only nurtures opportunities but also helps create them. If you're looking for a senior leadership role where your expertise, customer relationships, and strategic judgment can shape outcomes and drive meaningful business impact, this is the opportunity.

c6d8f148.description:

At Fujitsu, our purpose is to make the world more sustainable by building trust in society through innovation. Founded in Japan in 1935, Fujitsu has been a pioneer in technology and innovation for decades. Today, as a world-leading digital transformation partner, we are committed to transforming business and society in the digital age.
  
  
With approximately 130,000 employees across over 50 countries, Fujitsu offers a broad range of products, services, and solutions. We collaborate with our customers to co-create solutions that drive enterprise-wide digitalization while actively working to address social issues and contribute to the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs).
  
  
**ServiceNow Presales Architect / Senior Consultant**
**Level:**
FJ11 |
**Experience:**
10+ years |
**Location:**
Flexible, with travel as required
  
  
Suggested level
  
  
Senior Consultant / Presales Architect
  
  
**Experience**
10+ years in IT, including strong ServiceNow consulting, process design, solutioning, and presales experience
  
  
Primary focus
  
  
Platform architecture, integration, security, data, automation, technical estimation, and end-to-end presales, service design, and value realization
  
  
Key domains
  
  
ITSM, ITOM, SPM/ITBM, CSM, HRSD, SecOps, GRC, Asset Management, and Enterprise Service Management as relevant
  
  
**Job Summary**
Lead the end-to-end solutioning of ServiceNow opportunities—from client discovery and solution design through estimation, proposal, bid defence, and transition to delivery. The role converts business and service-management needs into a practical platform roadmap, implementation approach, managed-services model, and measurable value case.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Lead qualification, discovery workshops, solution design, estimation, proposal development, demonstrations, bid defence, and delivery handover.
* Assess client processes, platform maturity, pain points, governance, data readiness, user experience, and transformation priorities.
* Design fit-for-purpose solutions across ITSM, ITOM, SPM, CSM, HRSD, SecOps, GRC, Asset Management, and Enterprise Service Management.
* Translate requirements into process designs, user journeys, platform capabilities, integrations, scope, roadmap, and operating model.
* Define assumptions, dependencies, risks, responsibilities, effort, team structure, commercials, and delivery approach.
* Create RFP responses, statements of work, solution narratives, estimates, benefit cases, and executive presentations.
* Work with technical, delivery, commercial, partner, and client teams to ensure the solution is scalable, secure, commercially sound, and delivery-ready.
* Develop reusable propositions, estimation models, workshop assets, and industry-specific ServiceNow solutions.

Presales & Solution Expertise
  
  

* Strong IT service management process design experience and practical knowledge of ITIL-aligned operating models.
* Deep functional knowledge of ITSM, ITOM, and Strategic Portfolio Management / ITBM, with broader awareness of adjacent ServiceNow workflows.
* Strong experience with ServiceNow implementation, development, upgrades, maintenance, platform administration, and technical architecture.
* Hands-on knowledge of ServiceNow scripting and configuration, including JavaScript, Glide APIs, client and server-side components, security rules, flows, notifications, import sets, and custom applications.
* Deep integration knowledge covering REST, SOAP/WSDL, JSON, MID Server, Integration Hub, authentication patterns, error handling, monitoring, and integration support.
* Experience defining service catalogs, request models, CMDB governance, service mapping outcomes, asset processes, metrics, SLAs, dashboards, reporting, and Performance Analytics requirements.
* Understanding platform implementation lifecycle, upgrades, release governance, testing, training, organizational change, adoption, and managed-service operations.
* Proven experience estimating functional scope and identifying cost drivers, risks, dependencies, exclusions, and conditions required for a credible commercial model.

**Qualifications / Certifications**

* Bachelor's degree in business, Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related discipline; equivalent relevant experience may be considered.
* 10+ years of IT experience with significant ServiceNow consulting, process transformation, solutioning, or presales responsibility.
* 5+ years of IT service management process design experience and strong exposure to ServiceNow implementations or transformations.
* ServiceNow Certified System Administrator preferred; one or more relevant Certified Implementation Specialist credentials strongly preferred.
* ITIL certification is strongly preferred; process, architecture, agile, project, change-management, or business-analysis certification is advantageous.
* Experience in at least 2-3 end-to-end ServiceNow implementation or major transformation and multiple complex presales pursuits is preferred.

**Soft Skills & Success Measures**

* Excellent written, oral, presentation, facilitation, and executive stakeholder-management skills.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, estimation, decision-making, and structured problem-solving capability.
* Quality-oriented mindset with disciplined production of proposals, architectures, estimates, assumptions, and delivery-ready artifacts.
* Collaborative team players who can mobilize matrix teams, manage competing priorities, and work effectively across cultures and time zones.

Relocation Supported: Yes
  
  
Visa Sponsorship Approved: No
  
  
At Fujitsu, we are committed to an inclusive recruitment process that values the diverse backgrounds and experiences of all applicants. We believe that hiring people from a wide variety of backgrounds makes us stronger, not because it's the right thing to do, but because it allows us to draw on a wider range of perspectives and life experiences.

4c6fdcd4.title: Associate Solution Specialist - FinOps
4c6fdcd4.description:
Are you passionate about helping customers optimize cloud costs and maximize the value of their technology investments?

Do you enjoy combining consultative selling, financial optimization, and cloud expertise to drive measurable business outcomes?

Would you like to work with customers, sales teams, and cloud specialists to shape FinOps strategies and accelerate cloud transformation?

At SoftwareOne, we help organizations gain greater visibility, governance, and value from their cloud investments through FinOps, Cloud Cost Optimization, and Technology Asset Management solutions. We are looking for a FinOps Sales Consultant who is passionate about helping customers control cloud spend, improve financial accountability, and realize greater business value from their cloud environments.

As a FinOps Sales Consultant, you will work closely with Sales, customers, and technical specialists to identify cloud cost optimization opportunities, develop business cases, and position FinOps solutions that deliver measurable financial and operational outcomes. You will play a key role in driving pipeline growth, shaping customer strategies, and supporting opportunities from discovery through closure and transition to delivery.

**Key responsibilities:**

* Identifying, qualifying, and developing FinOps and Cloud Cost Optimization opportunities across customer environments.
* Conducting customer discovery sessions, assessments, workshops, and value discussions focused on cloud financial management and optimization.
* Developing solution proposals, Statements of Work, effort estimates, business cases, and commercial recommendations.
* Demonstrating FinOps and cloud management platforms including ServiceNow, Apptio, Flexera, CloudHealth, and related solutions.
* Supporting Sales teams through opportunity qualification, customer presentations, solution positioning, and FinOps sales plays.

We’re different from other organisations because we approach everything we do using our value of ‘play as a team'. We support each other, celebrate our wins together and share knowledge. This role may also be eligible for benefits, bonuses, commissions, and equity.

1597fd37.title: Cloud Native BNG Solution Testing,Scale & Performance, Python Engineer
1597fd37.description:
**Meet the Team**  

The Cisco cnBNG Solution Testing team validates carrier-grade broadband solutions running on IOS-XR routing platforms, including Cisco 8000, ASR 9000, and NCS 5500/5700. Our focus is ensuring that cnBNG solutions meet demanding service-provider requirements for functionality, scale, performance, resiliency, interoperability, and operational readiness. We validate the cnBNG solution end-to-end across Control Plane and User Plane functions, subscriber protocols, forwarding, high availability, and platform infrastructure. We operate at the intersection of software, hardware, networking, and customer deployments, with an automation-first approach and responsible adoption of AI-assisted engineering practices.

  
  
**Your Impact**  

As a Software Engineer in the cnBNG Solution Testing team, you will own end-to-end solution, scale, performance, and resiliency validation of cnBNG deployments.

You will design sophisticated service-provider network topologies, develop comprehensive test strategies, automate large-scale subscriber and traffic scenarios, and validate the system under realistic customer workloads. You will work extensively with traffic-generation platforms such as Keysight IXIA and Spirent, analyze system and forwarding performance, identify bottlenecks, and collaborate with development teams to drive defects to resolution.

* You will play a critical role in assessing product quality and providing evidence-based recommendations for release readiness.
* Design and implement end-to-end cnBNG solution testing across Control Plane, User Plane,subscriber management, forwarding, platform infrastructure, and external network elements.
* Own scale and performance qualification, including subscriber scale, session setup/teardown rates, throughput, latency, packet loss, convergence, CPU/memory utilization, and system behavior under sustained load.
* Develop realistic service-provider test topologies covering PPPoE, IPoE, DHCPv4/v6, PPP, RADIUS/CoA, L2TP, subscriber policies, accounting, QoS, and subscriber lifecycle scenarios.
* Build and validate large-scale cnBNG deployments with multiple Control Plane and User Plane nodes. Develop strong proficiency with Keysight IXIA and Spirent traffic generators, including subscriber emulation, protocol emulation, traffic generation, traffic analysis, performance benchmarking, and large-scale test execution.
* Create traffic profiles that model real-world broadband deployments, including mixed IPv4/IPv6 traffic, multiple packet sizes, bidirectional traffic, QoS classes, and subscriber service profiles.
* Validate CUPS / CP-UP separation, including session programming, state synchronization, state replay, reconciliation, Control Plane and User Plane failures, and recovery scenarios.
* Perform comprehensive high-availability and resiliency testing, including SRG geo/warm standby, process restart, node failures, link failures, ISSU, NSR/NSF, control-plane failures, and subscriber session continuity.
* Validate IOS-XR forwarding functionality including L2/L3 forwarding, FIB/adjacency, MPLS/L3VPN, H-QoS/policing, ACLs, mirroring, OAM/BFD, slowpath, and NPU forwarding behavior.
* Develop and maintain scalable Python-based test automation using pyATS/Genie or equivalent frameworks, integrating tests into CI/CD pipelines and regression suites.
* Build reusable automation libraries for topology setup, subscriber provisioning, traffic generation, fault injection, statistics collection, verification, and automated result analysis.
* Analyze performance trends and identify bottlenecks across software, forwarding hardware, NPU resources, CPU, memory, and control-plane interactions.
* Perform soak, longevity, stress, negative, boundary, and capacity testing to uncover issues that may only appear under sustained or extreme workloads.

c8daaf52.title: Sr. Application Architect
c8daaf52.description:
**Description**
The AWS Professional Services organization is a global team of experts that help customers realize their desired business outcomes when using the AWS Cloud. We work together with customer teams and the AWS Partner Network (APN) to execute enterprise cloud computing initiatives. Our team provides assistance through a collection of offerings which help customers achieve specific outcomes related to enterprise cloud adoption. We also deliver focused guidance through our global specialty practices, which cover a variety of solutions, technologies, and industries.
  
  
We are looking for a Senior Application Architect to design and deliver modern, cloud-native applications for AWS Professional Services (ProServe) India customers. In this role, you will own the technical architecture of complex customer engagements, from application assessment and modernization strategy through design, build, and production go-live. You will advise senior customer engineering leaders on how to re-architect, migrate, and modernize their application portfolios on AWS.
  
  
The ideal candidate is a hands-on architect with deep software engineering and IT consulting experience and a proven track record of delivering large-scale distributed applications for enterprise customers. You can work through ambiguous problems with limited guidance and make sound architectural trade-offs across cost, performance, security, and resilience. You thrive in a fast-paced, growth environment, insist on the highest standards, and enjoy mentoring engineers and turning proven patterns into reusable assets for the wider team.
  
  
You will lead technical workstreams made up of AWS consultants, partners, and customer developers, and set the architecture direction across microservices, containers, serverless, APIs, data integration, and DevOps practices. You are expected to write and review code, produce architecture artifacts, run design reviews, and resolve technical risks before they affect delivery. You will also support pre-sales by shaping solution designs and estimates, earn customer trust through technical credibility, and use AI/GenAI (including AI-assisted development tools) to speed up how applications are designed and built.
  
  
In this capacity you will be based in India and are expected to travel occasionally (30-40%). You will report into the India ProServe Application Architecture Delivery Practice Manager.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
We are looking for hands-on architects/developers who are passionate about:
  
  

* Help internal customers make decisions on their cloud and AI journey, define scalable architecture, highly available solutions that leverage AWS services and AI capabilities
* Assisting internal customers to architect and develop applications that are cloud-optimized and AI-integrated, including Generative AI and Agentic AI solutions
* Working as a technical leader alongside customer business, development, and infrastructure teams
* Guiding customers through the AI Development Life Cycle (AI-DLC)/ AI-assisted software engineering, from problem framing, data readiness, and model selection to deployment, evaluation, and continuous improvement.
* Sharing deep software development knowledge with respect to cloud architecture, AI design patterns, and programming
* Advising and implementing AWS best practices for both cloud-native and AI-powered workloads
* Assisting internal customers in infrastructure, application development, and AI solution integration
* Assisting internal customers in agile software development and Implementation of DevOps practices
* Independently leading a team that delivers applications including AI-enabled features spanning the full software lifecycle: design, implementation, testing, deployment, and maintenance strategy
* Scoping development efforts, identifying risks, and prioritizing deliverables to meet organizational goals; providing guidance so your team designs solutions making the right trade-offs between innovation, speed, and operational excellence

**About The Team**
Diverse Experiences
  
  
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  
  
Why AWS
  
  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
  
  
Work/Life Balance
  
  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.
  
  
Inclusive Team Culture
  
  
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.
  
  
Mentorship and Career Growth
  
  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 10+ years of technical specialist, design and architecture experience
* 10+ years of consulting, design and implementation of serverless distributed solutions experience
* 10+ years of software development with object oriented language experience
* 10+ years of external or internal customer facing, complex and large scale project management experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics or equivalent
* Travel up to 30% of the time

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 6+ years of leading development of applications backed by AWS services or using other cloud based technologies and services experience
* Experience with designing and building application using AWS services such as Lambda, AWS Elastic Beanstalk, Kubernetes
* Experience in one of the following programming languages: Java, Python, Ruby, Node.js, C#, or C
* Experience in professional, non-internship software development, or experience in machine learning, data mining, information retrieval, statistics or natural language processing
* Experience with CloudFormation, Chef, Puppet, Salt, or Ansible in production environments
* Familiarity with AI-DLC / AI-assisted software engineering, data preparation, prompt engineering, model evaluation, and deploying Generative/Agentic AI solutions

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

* Ensure technical readiness at key delivery gates.

* Drive technology modernization and engineering excellence.

* Define AI-enabled solution capabilities where appropriate.
* Drive AI-assisted development, testing, documentation, operations, and engineering workflows.
* Define AI architecture and integration patterns where AI is part of the solution.
* Ensure AI usage follows security, privacy, responsible AI, human-in-loop, and organizational governance requirements.

* Conduct discovery and requirement analysis.
* Develop solution options and architecture proposals.
* Define technical approach, technology stack, integration, NFRs, risks, dependencies, and delivery approach.

* Drive solutions involving multiple systems, teams, platforms, or business units.

As an Application Consultant for AWS Cloud, you will lead the implementation of architecture for omnichannel systems of engagement and utilize your strong understanding of software architecture fundamentals to drive project success. You will collaborate with clients to deliver successful projects, leveraging your proficiency in cloud implementation methodologies like the garage method.
