* Implement Cloud Architecture: Lead the implementation of architecture for omnichannel systems of engagement, utilizing your knowledge of software architecture fundamentals and cloud native development principles to ensure successful project delivery.

Master's Degree

834602b6.title: Oracle Cloud Supply Chain Senior Consultant
834602b6.description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Oracle Cloud Supply Chain – Senior Consultant, Functional Transformation**
**Enterprise Performance**
Our Enterprise Performance team helps organizations unlock value from enterprise technologies across supply chain, finance, manufacturing, and IT operations. As part of this team, you will work with clients to support large-scale digital transformation by bringing together strategy, process design, and technology enablement. Deloitte’s practitioners combine industry knowledge with functional and technical experience to help organizations improve operations, enhance business performance, and navigate complex transformation journeys. Joining this team means collaborating with strategic advisors, solution architects, and delivery specialists focused on solving critical business challenges through Oracle Cloud-enabled transformation.
  
  
**Level**
: Senior Consultant or equivalent
  
  
As a Senior Consultant at Deloitte Consulting Services, you will design, develop, and deploy enterprise-scale software solutions, lead the creation of robust pipelines and manage code deployment across environments. You will collaborate with cross-functional, global teams to translate functional requirements into effective deliverables, independently guiding and mentoring junior team members. Your role spans the full project lifecycle, including estimation, planning, execution, and tracking key metrics for analysis, ensuring high-quality and timely delivery of solutions.
  
  
**Work you'll do**
As a Senior Consultant, Functional Transformation on the Enterprise Performance team, you will be responsible for:
  
  

* Supporting and optimizing Oracle Supply Chain Management modules, including Manufacturing, Procurement, Order Management, Inventory, Bill of Materials, and Costing
* Participating in Oracle Supply Chain Management full-cycle implementations, including requirements gathering, fit-gap analysis, functional design, configuration, and testing
* Collaborating with client stakeholders to identify business process improvement opportunities and translate requirements into solution designs
* Supporting end-to-end business processes, including Order to Cash and Procure to Pay, to help drive operational efficiency
* Working across delivery teams to support execution, issue resolution, and quality delivery in onsite-offshore environments

**The team**
Our Enterprise Performance team is at the forefront of enterprise package insights and platform technology, working across finance, supply chain, manufacturing, and IT operations to support delivery of holistic performance improvement and package led large scale digital transformation. Join our team of strategic advisors and architects, differentiated by our industry depth to help collaborate and leverage your experience in strategy, process design, technology enablement, and operational services to enable the heart of business insights and collaborate with the businesses as they navigate their enterprise growth and transformation journeys.
  
  
The Enterprise Operations Portfolio is a suite of offerings designed to help clients maximize value from their Finance, Supply Chain, and IT operations. By taking a holistic approach—from strategy development to process design and technology enablement—we support clients in overcoming operational challenges and managing key business functions. As organizations pursue digital transformation, these areas become vital in shaping interactions with customers, suppliers, and stakeholders. By integrating strategy, operational improvement, implementation, and managed services, we creatively deploy resources and drive innovation, ensuring clients achieve impactful, sustainable results at the speed demanded by today’s dynamic market.
  
  
**Location:**
Bengaluru/Hyderabad/Pune/Chennai
  
  
**Shift Timings:**
24x7 rotational shifts including night shifts as per business requirements
  
  
**Qualifications**
Required:
  
  

* 6-10 years of experience supporting Oracle Supply Chain Management modules, including Manufacturing, Procurement, Order Management, Inventory, Bill of Materials, Work in Process, Advanced Pricing, Services, Advanced Supply Chain Planning, Demantra, and Costing
* 4+ years of experience in Oracle Supply Chain Management full-cycle implementations as a team member or lead
* Experience in requirements gathering, fit-gap analysis, business process design, configuration, and testing
* Experience collaborating with clients on business process enhancements
* Experience supporting end-to-end Order to Cash and Procure to Pay cycles
* Bachelor of Engineering, Bachelor of Technology, Master of Computer Applications, Master of Science in Computer Science, or equivalent degree from an accredited university

Preferred:
  
  

* Experience leading an Oracle applications workstream
* Experience working in onsite-offshore delivery models

**Our purpose**
Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.
  
  
**Our people and culture**
Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.
  
  
**Professional development**
At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state-of-the-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India .
  
  
**Benefits To Help You Thrive**
At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially—and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you.
  
  
**Recruiting tips**
From developing a stand out resume to putting your best foot forward in the interview, we want you to feel prepared and confident as you explore opportunities at Deloitte. Check out recruiting tips from Deloitte recruiters.

b30212dd.title: Cloud  Architect
b30212dd.description:
**Job Summary**

Cloud architect role focused on designing and implementing secure scalable and resilient solutions on the AWS platform using services such as container registries managed databases messaging content delivery and automation tools while aligning with best practices hybrid work policies and business goals to deliver reliable cloud applications and data platforms for global stakeholders.

  

**Responsibilities**

- Design and implement robust cloud architectures on the AWS platform that align with business goals and deliver highly available application and data solutions for global stakeholders.
- Configure and manage container based workloads using cloud native orchestration services and enterprise container registries to ensure efficient deployment scaling and lifecycle management of microservices.
- Architect and optimize managed relational and document database solutions that support transactional applications and analytical workloads while ensuring data integrity performance tuning and capacity planning.
- Develop and maintain data pipelines and transformation workflows using scalable extract transform and load tooling to enable reliable data ingestion cleansing and aggregation from diverse enterprise sources.
- Implement secure and resilient content delivery solutions using advanced edge optimization capabilities that provide low latency access and strong protection for web and application assets across regions.
- Configure and manage cloud security controls and protective services to safeguard applications and data from common threats while enforcing encryption standards and secure access policies.
- Build and operate event driven architectures using messaging and notification services to decouple components support asynchronous communication and improve system reliability and fault tolerance.
- Design and manage resilient application programming interfaces using managed gateway services to provide consistent routing authentication and throttling that support internal and external consumers.
- Apply well architected principles across reliability performance cost optimization operational excellence and security to continuously review and improve existing workloads and new designs.
- Automate infrastructure provisioning configuration and operations using command line tools software development kits and systems management capabilities to reduce manual effort and operational risk.
- Collaborate with product owners application engineers and data teams in a hybrid work setting to translate requirements into scalable cloud solutions and provide technical guidance throughout project delivery.
- Monitor cloud workloads using centralized operations tooling to analyze performance metrics identify bottlenecks optimize resource usage and ensure adherence to day shift availability expectations.
- Document architecture patterns configuration standards and operational procedures so that teams can consistently deploy maintain and enhance cloud solutions without requiring travel or on site presence.
  

**Qualifications**

- Demonstrate eight to nine years of progressive experience in cloud solution design and implementation with a strong focus on architecting workloads on the AWS platform for enterprise environments.
- Bring hands on expertise with container orchestration and registry platforms combined with practical experience in managed relational and document database services for production workloads.
- Show advanced proficiency in designing and operating secure content delivery and edge protection solutions that integrate with certificate management and shield style security capabilities.
- Possess deep experience building scalable data pipelines and transformation jobs using modern extract transform and load tooling while integrating with analytics or reporting platforms.
- Use command line interfaces software development kits and systems management tools to automate infrastructure deployment configuration patching and environment consistency in hybrid work models.
- Apply structured knowledge of cloud architecture best practices including well architected frameworks to review workloads identify design gaps and propose actionable improvements that enhance business value.
  

**Certifications Required**

AWS Certified Solutions Architect Professional or AWS Certified Data Engineer Associate recommended for this cloud architect role.

089f5d05.title: Cross Technology Managed Services Engineer (L2)
089f5d05.description:
**Make an impact with NTT DATA**
Join a company that is pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We are renowned for our technical excellence and leading innovations, and for making a difference to our clients and society. Our workplace embraces diversity and inclusion – it’s a place where you can grow, belong and thrive.
  
  
**Your day at NTT DATA**
The Managed Services Cross Technology Engineer (L2) is a developing engineering role, responsible for providing a managed service to clients to ensure that their IT infrastructure and systems remain operational.
  
  
Through the proactive monitoring, identifying, investigating, and resolving of technical incidents and problems, the Managed Services Cross Technology Engineer (L2) is able to restore service to clients.
  
  
The primary objective of this role is to proactively review client requests or tickets and apply technical/process knowledge to resolve them without breaching service level agreement (SLA).
  
  
The Managed Services Cross Technology Engineer (L2) focuses on second-line support for incidents and requests with a medium level of complexity and focusses across two or more technology domains - Cloud, Security, Networking, Applications and / or Collaboration etc.
  
  
This role may also contribute to / support on project work as and when required.
  
  
**What You'll Be Doing**
**Key Responsibilities:**

* Proactively monitors the work queues.
* Performs operational tasks to resolve all incidents/requests in a timely manner and within the agreed SLA.
* Updates tickets with resolution tasks performed.
* Identifies, investigates, analyses issues and errors prior to or when they occur, and logs all such incidents in a timely manner.
* Captures all required and relevant information for immediate resolution.
* Provides second level support to all incidents, requests and identifies the root cause of incidents and problems.
* Communicates with other teams and clients for extending support.
* Executes changes with clear identification of risks and mitigation plans to be captured into the change record.
* Follows the shift handover process highlighting any key tickets to be focussed on along with a handover of upcoming critical tasks to be carried out in the next shift.
* Escalates all tickets to seek the right focus from CoE and other teams, if needed continue the escalations to management.
* Works with automation teams for effort optimization and automating routine tasks.
* Ability to work across various other resolver group (internal and external) like Service Provider, TAC, etc.
* Identifies problems and errors before they impact a client’s service.
* Provides Assistance to L1 Security Engineers for better initial triage or troubleshooting.
* Leads and manages all initial client escalation for operational issues.
* Contributes to the change management process by logging all change requests with complete details for standard and non-standard including patching and any other changes to Configuration Items.
* Ensures all changes are carried out with proper change approvals.
* Plans and executes approved maintenance activities.
* Audits and analyses incident and request tickets for quality and recommends improvements with updates to knowledge articles.
* Produces trend analysis reports for identifying tasks for automation, leading to a reduction in tickets and optimization of effort.
* May also contribute to / support on project work as and when required.
* May work on implementing and delivering Disaster Recovery functions and tests.
* Performs any other related task as required.

**Knowledge and Attributes:**

* Ability to communicate and work across different cultures and social groups.
* Ability to plan activities and projects well in advance, and takes into account possible changing circumstances.
* Ability to maintain a positive outlook at work.
* Ability to work well in a pressurized environment.
* Ability to work hard and put in longer hours when it is necessary.
* Ability to apply active listening techniques such as paraphrasing the message to confirm understanding, probing for further relevant information, and refraining from interrupting.
* Ability to adapt to changing circumstances.
* Ability to place clients at the forefront of all interactions, understanding their requirements, and creating a positive client experience throughout the total client journey.

**Academic Qualifications and Certifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent qualification in IT/Computing (or demonstrated equivalent work experience).
* Certifications relevant to the services provided (certifications carry additional weightage on a candidate’s qualification for the role).
* Relevant certifications include (but not limited to) -

+ CCNP or equivalent certification
+ CCNA certification in must, CCNP in Security or PCNSE certification is good to have
+ Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator Associate
+ AWS Certified: Solutions Architect Associate
+ Veeam Certified Engineer
+ VMware certified Professional: Data Centre Virtualization
+ Zerto, pure, vxrail
+ Google Cloud Platform (gcp)
+ Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (oci)

+ SAP Technology Consultant
+ SAP Certified Technology Associate - SAP HANA 2.0
+ Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Architect Professional
+ IBM Certified System Administrator - WebSphere Application Server Network

**Required Experience:**

* Moderate level years of relevant managed services experience handling cross technology infrastructure.
* Moderate level knowledge in ticketing tools preferably Service Now.
* Moderate level working knowledge of ITIL processes.
* Moderate level experience working with vendors and/or 3rd parties.

**Workplace type:**
On-site Working

NTT DATA is a $30+ billion trusted global innovator of business and technology services. We serve 75% of the Fortune Global 100 and are committed to helping clients innovate, optimize and transform for long-term success. We invest over $3.6 billion each year in R&D to help organizations and society move confidently and sustainably into the digital future. 78ac9ed0.title: Delivery Manager
78ac9ed0.description:
**Technical Delivery Manager**
Who We Are
  
  
Bidgely (which means "electricity" in Hindi) is an AI-powered SaaS company accelerating a clean energy future by enabling energy companies and consumers to make data-driven energy-related decisions. Ranked #7 in Applied AI on Fast Company’s list of Most Innovative Companies in the World, Bidgely is putting customers at the center of the clean energy future.
  
  
What We Do
  
  
Powered by our unique patented technology, Bidgely's UtilityAI™ Platform transforms multiple dimensions of customer data—such as energy consumption, demographics, and interactions—into deeply accurate and actionable consumer energy insights. We leverage these insights to empower each customer with personalized recommendations tailored to their individual personality and lifestyle, usage attributes, behavioral patterns, purchase propensity, and beyond.
  
  
How We Do It
  
  
From a distributed energy resources (DER) and grid edge perspective, Bidgely advances smart meter innovation with data-driven solutions for solar PVs, electric vehicle (EV) detection, EV behavioral load shifting and managed charging, energy theft, short-term load forecasting, grid analytics, and time-of-use (TOU) rate designs. Bidgely’s UtilityAI™ platform provides deep visibility into generation and consumption for better peak load shaping and grid planning and delivers targeted recommendations for new value-added products and services.
  
  
For more information, please visit:
  
  

* Website: www.bidgely.com
* Blog: bidgely.com/blog

**About The Role**
We are looking for a Delivery Manager to head a cross-functional team in implementing and configuring our product solutions for enterprise-level clients. This role demands extensive technical leadership, people management, and project ownership skills, ensuring thorough quality checks and leading innovative approaches (e.g., GenAI, automation) to streamline delivery. You’ll collaborate closely with internal engineering, R&D, QA, and support teams, receiving high-level, outcome-based requirements from our Technical Program Managers.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Strategic Leadership & Team Management
  
  

* Manage, mentor, and inspire a team of engineers and project leads, ensuring a high standard of performance, engagement, and professional growth.
* Develop and optimize team structures, resource planning, and talent development strategies to scale delivery capabilities.
* Foster a culture that values ownership, accountability, innovation, and continuous learning.

Senior-Level Project Delivery
  
  

* Translate complex, outcome-driven requirements from Technical Program Managers into comprehensive project roadmaps and execution plans.
* Oversee multiple, concurrent implementation projects—coordinating internal teams to ensure timely, budget-conscious, and high-quality releases.
* Communicate progress, risks, and mitigation strategies effectively with senior stakeholders and leadership.

Quality Assurance & Release Management
  
  

* Establish and uphold rigorous quality controls, encompassing functionality, data integrity, performance, and user acceptance criteria.
* Work with QA resources (matrixed or dedicated) to align on testing strategies, automation frameworks, and release protocols.
* Drive continuous improvement in release readiness processes and performance metrics.

Technical Innovation & Problem-Solving
  
  

* Provide deep-dive technical guidance, from code-level debugging to data-level analysis, empowering the team to solve complex challenges.
* Collaborate with R&D to integrate new product features seamlessly, ensuring reliable configurations for enterprise-scale use cases.
* Champion the introduction and application of cutting-edge tools—including GenAI—to automate, optimize, and simplify implementation workflows.

Process Optimization & Automation
  
  

* Identify and implement strategic improvements to reduce manual effort, boost delivery speed, and maintain consistent quality across projects.
* Promote documentation, best practices, and standardized procedures to drive efficiency and scalability.
* Leverage metrics, analytics, and user feedback to iterate on processes and evolve best-in-class delivery methodologies.

**Requirements**
Experience & Education
  
  

* 7+ years of experience in software delivery, implementation, or technical program/project management, with progressive leadership responsibilities.
* Proven track record of managing large-scale, cross-functional projects in fast-paced or enterprise environments.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field; an advanced degree (MBA, MS) is a plus.

Technical Expertise
  
  

* Demonstrated proficiency in software configuration, integration APIs, data pipelines, debugging, and system performance optimization.
* Hands-on experience tackling complex technical issues at both application and data levels.
* Familiarity with automation frameworks, DevOps practices, and emerging technologies (e.g., GenAI).

Leadership & Communication
  
  

* Strong background in leading and mentoring high-performing technical teams, including architects, senior developers, and QA leads.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, capable of interfacing with executive-level audiences.
* Adept at guiding cross-functional groups toward common goals and managing change in a dynamic environment.

Domain Knowledge
  
  

* Experience in the energy or utilities sector is beneficial, but not required.
* Ability to adapt rapidly to evolving industry trends and new technologies.

Equal Opportunity Statement
  
  
Bidgely is an equal-opportunity employer. We are serious about and embrace diversity and equal opportunity. We are committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills to build a better future and a better workforce.

2bfe2861.description:
******Job Description Summary******   As an ADMS Delivery Manager you will be a pivotal contributor to the successful delivery of ADMS Series 3 (DMS / OMS / SCADA) implementations and upgrades for electric utility customers across the MENAT and APAC regions. You will own the technical delivery of assigned projects across the full post-sales lifecycle - from requirements and design through configuration, network model build, testing, cutover, go-live and hypercare - working directly with customers and with cross-functional GE Vernova teams.  
This role is dedicated to the Distribution GSL Series 3 delivery portfolio and operates under the direction of the regional ADMS Lead in MENAT as well as the HTC GDC leader . It combines deep ADMS technical expertise with customer-facing delivery ownership, and contributes to building regional capability and reducing reliance on single points of expertise. Requiring a high level of operational and technical judgement, the expectation for this role is moderate autonomy. **Job Description** 

**Roles and Responsibilities**

* **Project Delivery Ownership**
  + Act as the technical delivery lead for assigned ADMS Series 3 implementations, upgrades and installed-base engagements across MENAT and APAC.
  + Own technical deliverables throughout the entire project lifecycle - requirements, functional and technical design, system configuration, distribution network model (DNAF) build and validation, integration, FAT/SAT, cutover, go-live and hypercare - ensuring projects stay on track in terms of budget, time and customer expectations.
  + Plan and track delivery activities, effort and milestones for assigned projects; report progress, risks, issues and change requests to the regional Delivery Manager and project stakeholders.
  + Help to lay out proper staffing to cover all regional ADMS S3 deliveries and coordinate GE Vernova, HTC and partner resources assigned to the project to ensure all projects are successful.
  + Manage defects, change requests and technical actions through GE Vernova project tracking tools, maintaining accurate and auditable delivery records.
* **Client Collaboration**
  + Serve as the primary technical point of contact for the customer on assigned projects, explaining difficult or sensitive information and working to build consensus.
  + Work closely with clients to understand their unique needs and develop tailored delivery strategies through site assessments and workshops.
  + Make standard recommendations on workflow, application, interface, reports, testing and data uploads to customers during the implementation process.
  + Ensure go-live readiness and provide support, including post-live checkups, to guarantee customer satisfaction.
  + Travel to customer sites in the regions as required by project phase, including extended on-site presence during testing, cutover and go-live windows.
* **Technical Expertise and Installed Base Support**
  + Provide hands-on technical support and troubleshooting across the ADMS Series 3 stack (Habitat / SCADA, DMS applications, OMS / Enterprise OMS, DNAF and system interfaces), including production issue resolution for installed-base customers.
  + Support upgrade planning and execution for the regional ADMS S3 installed base, including version assessments, configuration re-verification and migration activities.
  + Contribute to solution design, sizing and effort estimation for change orders and new opportunities, supporting the regional sales and bid teams as required.
* **Leadership and Mentorship**
  + Act as a resource for colleagues with less experience; mentor regional engineers and support structured knowledge transfer to build redundancy and reduce reliance on a small number of senior SMEs.
  + Ability to work across all GEV silos - Product, Support, Sales, HTC and delivery partners - with a OneTeam mentality.
  + Ability to grow and mentor staff, understanding that not everyone learns and grows the same way.
  + Develop persuasion skills required to influence others on topics within field.
* **Best Practice and Quality Assurance**
  + Develop specialized knowledge in your discipline and serve as a best practice / quality resource for the regional ADMS team.
  + Stay abreast of the latest technical developments in ADMS Series 3 and the GridOS platform, and contribute to delivery standards, runbooks and reusable assets.
  + Ensure delivery excellence within your area of responsibility.
* **Decision-Making and Problem Solving**
  + Use judgment to make decisions or solve moderately complex tasks or problems in areas of delivery, technology or engineering.
  + Take a new perspective on existing solutions and use technical experience and expertise for data analysis to support recommendations.
  + Utilize multiple internal and limited external sources outside of your own function to arrive at decisions.
* **Market Awareness and Integration**
  + Possess in-depth knowledge of best practices and understand how your area integrates with others.
  + Have a working knowledge of the competition and the factors that differentiate them in the market.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Power Systems, Computer Science or a related discipline from an accredited university or college.
* Minimum of 15 years of experience implementing, upgrading or supporting ADMS / DMS / OMS / SCADA solutions for electric utilities, with significant hands-on experience on GE Vernova ADMS Series 3.
* Demonstrated experience leading technical delivery on utility software projects, including direct customer-facing responsibility.
* Willingness and ability to travel internationally to customer sites across MENAT and APAC as required by project phase.
* Based in Hyderabad, India, and aligned with HTC workplace guidelines.

**Desired Characteristics**

* Masters degree in electrical engineering / Power systems
* Deep experience with distribution network model (DNAF) build, validation, migration and data quality management.
* Experience with OMS / Enterprise OMS, Habitat / SCADA, eFEP and ADMS integrations (GIS, CIS, AMI, IVR, SCADA).
* Experience with ADMS Series 3 version upgrades and installed-base support.
* Exposure to the GridOS platform is a plus.
* Strong oral and written communication skills. Strong interpersonal and leadership skills. Demonstrated ability to analyze and resolve problems. Demonstrated ability to lead programs / projects. Ability to document, plan and execute programs. Established project management skills.
* Ability to work effectively across time zones with regional customers and distributed GE Vernova teams.

  ******Additional Information******  

**Relocation Assistance Provided:** Yes

9538c538.title: Program Manager - Technology
9538c538.description:
* Full-time

**Company Description**
-----------------------

AbhiBus is a leading online bus-ticketing platform that aggregates ticket inventory from over 4,000 bus operators - including major State Road Transport Corporations (SRTCs), covering more than 3.5 lakh (350,000+) routes across India. The AbhiBus website and apps allow users to check amenities provided by bus operators, compare booking fares, check bus timings in the searched route, live tracking of the bus before arrival, cancellation protection options and other facilities. It is the official ticketing partner for several state road transport corporation bus tickets and IRCTC bus bookings.

AbhiBus is owned and operated by ixigo (Le Travenues Technology Limited), India’s leading OTA for the Next Billion Users. With over 54 crore Annual Active Users in FY25, ixigo offers AI-powered train, flight, bus, and hotel bookings through its platforms - ixigo, ConfirmTkt, and AbhiBus.

**Job Description**
-------------------

**The Role**

We are looking for a Technology Program Manager who can drive complex, cross-functional technology initiatives from problem definition to execution and delivery.  
  
This is not a traditional Scrum Master / Agile Project Manager role.  
  
You will work in an environment where requirements evolve, priorities change, teams may not be co-located, and there isn't always a well-defined process or single owner for every dependency.  
  
Your job will be to bring clarity, structure and momentum to these situations.  
  
You will work closely with Product, Engineering, Design, Data, Operations and external technology partners to ensure that complex initiatives move forward and eventually reach production.

**What You Will Do**

* Drive end-to-end technology programs — translate high-level objectives into clear plans, milestones, dependencies and execution paths.
* Navigate complex technical dependencies across multiple engineering teams, services, platforms and third-party systems.
* Work closely with engineering leads to understand architecture, APIs, data flows, system dependencies and technical constraints well enough to identify execution risks early.
* Identify the critical path for programs and continuously remove blockers that could impact delivery.
* Coordinate execution across distributed and non-co-located teams, ensuring alignment without relying purely on formal processes.
* Bring structure to ambiguous problems — figure out what needs to happen, who needs to be involved and how we get from where we are today to the desired outcome.
* Identify risks, dependencies and decisions proactively rather than waiting for issues to surface.
* Facilitate discussions between teams when there are conflicting priorities, unclear ownership or competing technical approaches.
* Partner with Product Managers and Engineering Managers to convert product/business objectives into executable technology plans.
* Maintain program visibility for leadership — what is on track, what is blocked, why it is blocked and what decisions are required.
* Manage execution across multiple parallel workstreams without becoming a task tracker.
* Work with external vendors/partners where technology integration or operational dependencies are involved.
* Establish lightweight processes where needed — but avoid adding process for the sake of process.

**Qualifications**
------------------

* 3–5 years of experience in Technical Program Management, Product Operations, Engineering Program Management, Technology Consulting or a similar role.
* Strong understanding of software development and technology systems. You don't need to be a coder, but you should be comfortable discussing APIs, databases, services, integrations, data flows, releases and system dependencies with engineers.
* Demonstrated experience driving cross-functional technology initiatives involving multiple teams.
* Strong ability to understand technical dependencies and identify risks before they become delivery problems.
* Comfortable working with ambiguity, changing priorities and incomplete information.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, particularly across teams with different priorities.
* Ability to operate effectively with distributed / geographically dispersed engineering teams.
* Strong ownership mindset — you see a problem through to resolution rather than simply escalating it.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

Ability to operate in a high-paced startup environment where processes are evolving continuously.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience working in a consumer internet, marketplace, OTA, fintech, mobility or other high-scale technology environment.
* Experience working with microservices, APIs, cloud infrastructure or data platforms.
* Engineering / Computer Science background.
* Experience working with external technology vendors or partners.
* Experience managing programs involving multiple engineering teams and complex integrations.
* Experience in an environment where Product and Engineering operate with high autonomy and lightweight processes.

**What Success Looks Like**

After 6 months, you should be the person teams rely on to answer:

* What exactly are we trying to deliver?
* Which teams and systems are involved?
* What are the critical dependencies?
* What is blocking us?
* Who needs to make a decision?
* What can derail the program?
* What needs to happen next?

**You don't need to create more meetings or more status reports.**  
  
**You need to make complex things happen.**

**Additional Information**
--------------------------

Candidates are responsible for safeguarding sensitive company data against unauthorized access, use, or disclosure, and for reporting any suspected security incidents in line with the organization's ISMS (Information Security Management System) policies and procedures.

By clicking the link above or any third-party link within this posting, you are leaving this site and going to a third-party website where the third-party website's terms and privacy policy apply

GlobalFoundries (GF) is a leading manufacturer of essential semiconductors, enabling AI at scale from the cloud to the physical world. Through deep partnerships with customers, GF delivers differentiated, power efficient and high-performance solutions for high growth markets. With global manufacturing operations across the U.S., Europe and Asia, GF is a trusted and holistic technology partner for customers around the world. GF’s talented, global team remains focused every day on security, longevity, and sustainability. For more information, visit www.gf.com.
  
  
**Your Job**
You are part of a team delivering GenAI/AI solutions for semiconductor design and enablement workflows. As Program Manager – AI Solutions Ecosystem & Operations you take identified solutions and use cases and make them real: you run weekly interlocks, hold the portfolio view, and drive each engagement through IT security, legal, procurement and AI governance to deployment and adoption. You own program mechanics, stakeholder alignment and roadblock removal so that engineering teams stay focused on delivery.
  
  
**Essential Responsibilities**

* Run weekly interlocks with partners, vendors and internal stakeholders; own agendas, decisions, actions and follow-through.
* Maintain the portfolio view of stage, owners, milestones, dependencies, and risk; report to leadership at a regular cadence.

* Manage AI governance submissions, data classification and risk documentation ahead of production use.
* Program manage the internal AI use-case portfolio: run the intake process, stage gates, pilot to production release, and sunset.
* Clear infrastructure, access, license and onboarding roadblocks.
* Develop OKRs and adoption metrics, track and deliver.

**Other Responsibilities**

* Perform all activities in a safe and responsible manner and support all Environmental, Health, Safety & Security requirements and programs.
* Collaborate with cross functional teams (Design Platforms, Central CAD and Methodology, Reference design, TD, Device, PDK, IT, Information Security, Legal, Procurement, Finance and Eco-system partners).

**Required Qualifications**

* Education – 10 years experience with a Bachelors degree, or 8 years with a Masters, in Electrical, Electronics or Computer Science Engineering.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* PMP, PgMP or Agile/Scrum certification.
* Familiarity with semiconductor design, EDA or PDK workflows.
* Working understanding of GenAI/AI concepts (LLMs, RAG, agents).
* Ability to navigate ambiguity and align without direct authority.
* Strong planning, organizational and communication skills.

GlobalFoundries is an equal opportunity employer, cultivating a diverse and inclusive workforce. We believe having a multicultural workplace enhances productivity, efficiency and innovation whilst our employees feel truly respected, valued and heard.
  
  
As an affirmative employer, all qualified applicants are considered for employment regardless of age, ethnicity, marital status, citizenship, race, religion, political affiliation, gender, sexual orientation and medical and/or physical abilities.
  
  
All offers of employment with GlobalFoundries are conditioned upon the successful completion of background checks, medical screenings as applicable and subject to the respective local laws and regulations.
  
  
**No Recruitment Fee Policy:**
GlobalFoundries is committed to ethical and transparent hiring practices. Candidates will not be charged any fees at any stage of the recruitment process. Any request for payment related to a GlobalFoundries employment opportunity is unauthorized and should be reported immediately. All legitimate recruitment communications are conducted exclusively through official GlobalFoundries channels. To report concerns or suspected recruitment fraud, please contact our Ethics & Compliance Office at global(dot)compliance(at)GlobalFoundries(dot)com or visit our official website.
  
  
**The Ethics & Compliance mailbox is not a recruitment channel. CVs/resumes submitted to this mailbox will not be reviewed, processed, or considered for employment opportunities. Please apply through the official GlobalFoundries careers site only.**
Information about our benefits you can find here: https://gf.com/about-us/careers/opportunities-asia

be54956a.title: Technical Program Manager - IoT
be54956a.description:
**Quin | About the Company**

Quin is a safety-technology company. Our technology ships inside products from leading global brands across motorcycling, cycling, sport and industrial PPE. We are becoming the primary source of real-world crash data across every protective gear category, and we build the data tools that manufacturers and testing bodies use to engineer safer products and standards. Our engineering and product centre is in Hyderabad, with helmet testing labs in Hyderabad and London, and teams across India, the UK and the US.

**Why this role exists**

Every Quin release can involve hardware, firmware, mobile, cloud and design, often for several products at once. We are looking for a technical delivery leader who sees the whole system, and coordinates cross-functionally efficiently. This Technical Program Manager must understand the technology well enough to challenge an estimate, read a firmware or API change and know what it breaks downstream, and be able to automate coordination wherever possible, so the team spends more time building with clarity.

**What youll own**

**Cross-functional delivery**

* Own the delivery plan across embedded, mobile, backend, web, QA and design, from requirement to release.
* Map dependencies, surface risks early and drive decisions to close them.

**Release management**

* Own release cadence and release readiness across multiple apps, firmware versions and cloud services.
* Work with QA on release sanity, regression coverage and go/no-go calls.
* Keep release notes, versioning and rollback plans clean and current.

**Escalations and clarity**

* Be the single named owner for delivery escalations. Bring leadership a clear recommendation, not just a problem.
* Give leadership one honest view of status, risk and dates, without anyone having to chase.

**Documentation and knowledge**

* Make documentation part of how work gets done: decision records, runbooks, release notes and handovers.
* Build a shared, searchable knowledge base so no system depends on human memory.
* Run it with access controls that protect confidential and product data.

**Lightweight, automated process**

* Set up planning, estimation and tracking that is lean and useful.
* Use automation to cut down status meetings, manual reporting and copy-paste work.
* Support team growth, and champion initiatives to ensure people and achievements are celebrated at Quin.

  
**Must-haves**

* 5+ years in software or hardware engineering delivery, with 2+ as a TPM or delivery lead for connected products.
* An engineering background, or equivalent hands-on depth. You can hold your own in an architecture review.
* Shipped products that span at least two of: firmware/embedded, mobile apps, cloud backend.
* Release management across multiple products or customers at once.
* Strong written communication skills, without AI polish. Your docs and updates are short, clear and trusted.
* You use AI tools daily to plan, track, write and automate, but can work without it.

**Strong pluses**

* IoT, BLE devices, wearables or consumer hardware launches.
* Able to excel in fast-paced, high ownership environment.
* Built documentation or knowledge-management systems that people used.
* Experience with test automation, CI/CD and release pipelines.

**How we work**

We are a small team of senior doers. We hire people who move fast and own their work, not people who manage others to do the work. You will own delivery outcomes, not just track them.

**Our hiring process & AI use**

Use AI tools freely on any exercise. The only rule:  **declare what you used and be ready to defend every decision live.**  The recruitment process will involve at least 2 interviews, and 1 assignment and live debrief.

07dc15c9.title: Technical Program Manager
07dc15c9.description:
Job Description

**Role Overview**

We are looking for an Technical Program Manager with a strong technical or product delivery background to join our newly established Implementation Management team.

In this role, you will independently lead cross-domain initiatives-ranging from high-volume platform migrations to regional product launches, remediation projects, and platform onboardings. You will sit within the Servicing organisation, but will align directly with partner product segments outside Servicing, leading cross-functional execution across Product, Engineering, Operations, and Compliance.

This role demands strong stakeholder management, hands-on systems curiosity, program management rigour, pattern recognition, and a passion for process

**What You ll Do**

* **Lead Cross-Domain Initiatives:** Take single-threaded ownership of high-impact, cross-squad projects-including core platform migrations, control rollouts, product launches, and partner integrations.
* **Consult Partners on Platform Integration:** Understand the capabilities, integration flows, and limitations of Wise s Servicing platforms. Guide partner teams through onboarding requirements and help translate business/compliance needs into clear user stories for Implementation Engineers where necessary.
* **Drive Pragmatic, Hands-On Delivery:** Work comfortably at the intersection of product delivery and technical systems. You dont need to review deep technical specifications, but you are comfortable reading architecture diagrams, asking challenging technical questions, running API requests in Postman for testing, and creating dashboards or tables in Looker to track metrics.
* **Manage Operational Transformation Launch Readiness:** Work with Business Operations to ensure product launches are fully supported with operational workflows, queue structures, and agent guidance.
* **Drive Program Management Lifecycle:** Hold the pen on end-to-end program governance-authoring clear program briefs, setting SMART objectives, managing risk logs, tracking delivery milestones, and conducting post-implementation reviews.
* **Leave the Place Better Than You Found It:** Assume every process executed today will be repeated tomorrow. Document workflows, automate manual steps, and establish telemetry to scale future execution. Qualifications

**What You ll Bring**

* **8+ Years of Relevant Experience:** Proven track record of delivering cross-functional technical or operational projects as an Implementation Manager, Technical Program Manager (TPM), Technical Consultant, Product manager or Fintech Delivery Lead.
* **Systems Literacy Practical Technical Curiosity:** Ability to interpret system architecture diagrams, ask sharp and challenging questions about technical designs, run Postman calls for testing/validation, and build basic tables/dashboards in Looker or SQL.
* **Program Management Excellence:** Strong foundation in project/program delivery best practices-from scoping and brief writing to designing governance structures, stakeholder reporting, and post-implementation audits.
* **Exceptional Communication Skills:** Outstanding written and verbal communication. Ability to adjust messaging seamlessly whether facilitating alignment with product managers, clarifying requirements with engineers, or updating business leaders.
* **Pattern Recognition Structured Thinking:** Ability to absorb unstructured information across disparate domains, spot commonalities, and design standardized, repeatable frameworks.

**What You ll benefit from**

* **Payments / FinCrime / Platform Exposure:** Exposure to Fintech, Payments, Financial Crime (AML, Fraud, KYC), or platform integration projects.

5c28203f.title: Associate Program Manager
5c28203f.description:
We are looking for an experienced **APGM – Operations** to lead BPM operations, with strong expertise in **client delivery, operational metrics, cost management, people leadership, SLA governance, and continuous improvement**.

The ideal candidate should have experience managing **200+ resources** and be highly comfortable working with **numbers, operational reports, dashboards, productivity metrics, financials, and performance analytics**. Exposure to **creative, graphic design, digital content, or other creative production environments** will be an added advantage.

This is a **Work From Office (WFO)** role and requires strong on-site leadership and stakeholder engagement.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Operations & Client Delivery**

* Lead end-to-end operations for large-scale international BPO/creative programs with **200+ resources**.
* Own operational performance, service delivery, productivity, quality, turnaround time, and client satisfaction.
* Ensure achievement of agreed **SLAs, KPIs, productivity and quality targets**.
* Drive daily, weekly and monthly operational reviews with internal and external stakeholders.
* Manage client communication, governance forums, business reviews and escalations.
* Act as the primary escalation point for critical operational and client issues.

**Metrics, Reporting & Business Analytics**

* Demonstrate strong command over **numbers, MIS, dashboards, reports and operational analytics**.
* Track and analyze key metrics including:
  + Productivity
  + Utilization
  + SLA/TAT
  + Quality
  + Capacity
  + Attrition
  + Absenteeism
  + Cost per transaction
  + Revenue and margins
  + Resource deployment
  + Forecast vs. actual performance
* Translate operational data into actionable insights and business decisions.
* Prepare and present **monthly/quarterly business reviews and management reports**.
* Identify trends, performance gaps and opportunities for operational optimization.

**Cost & Commercial Management**

* Own operational cost management and drive **cost optimization and productivity improvement**.
* Monitor manpower utilization, capacity planning and resource deployment.
* Partner with finance and business teams on **budgeting, forecasting and cost analysis**.
* Identify opportunities to improve margins without impacting service quality or client experience.

**People Leadership**

* Provide strategic leadership to a large operations team of **200+ employees**.
* Lead managers/team leaders and build a strong leadership pipeline.
* Drive employee engagement, performance management, capability development and succession planning.
* Monitor attrition and implement effective retention strategies.
* Create a culture focused on **accountability, ownership, customer centricity and continuous improvement**.

**Creative / Graphic Operations**

* Manage or support operations involving **graphic design, creative production, digital content, marketing collateral, presentations, image/video content or other creative services**.
* Understand creative production workflows, capacity planning, quality parameters and delivery timelines.
* Work closely with creative teams, project managers and clients to ensure timely and high-quality delivery.
* Balance creative quality with **productivity, SLA, cost and commercial objectives**.
* Exposure to tools, workflows or environments supporting creative/graphic operations will be an advantage.

**Continuous Improvement**

* Identify operational inefficiencies and lead **process improvement, automation and productivity initiatives**.
* Drive Lean/Six Sigma or other structured improvement initiatives where applicable.
* Standardize processes, workflows and reporting mechanisms across teams.
* Establish a data-driven operating culture focused on measurable business outcomes.

**Required Experience & Skills**

* **12+ years of overall experience**, preferably in International BPO/ITES operations.
* Minimum **5+ years in senior leadership roles** involving strategic and people leadership.
* Proven experience managing **200+ resources** in a large-scale operations environment.
* Strong experience in **client delivery and international client management**.
* Excellent understanding of **SLA, KPI, productivity, quality and operational governance**.
* Strong analytical and numerical skills with hands-on experience in **MIS, dashboards, reports and performance metrics**.
* Strong exposure to **cost management, capacity planning and resource optimization**.
* Proven experience handling **client escalations and complex operational issues**.
* Strong people management, communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Strategic thinker with the ability to convert data into actionable business decisions.
* Experience in **creative/graphic/digital content operations** will be an added advantage.
* Strong presentation and business review skills.
* Proficiency in **MS Excel, PowerPoint and reporting/dashboarding tools**.
* Experience working with global clients and geographically distributed teams.

**Key Competencies**

**Operational Leadership | Client Management | People Leadership | Cost Management | SLA & KPI Governance | MIS & Reporting | Data Analytics | Capacity Planning | Productivity Management | Escalation Management | Continuous Improvement | Creative Operations | Strategic Planning | Stakeholder Management**

**Key Success Metrics**

* SLA & TAT adherence
* Productivity and utilization
* Quality performance
* Cost and margin improvement
* Client satisfaction
* Attrition and employee engagement
* Capacity utilization
* Revenue and operational efficiency
* Continuous improvement benefits

**Work Location**

**Work From Office (WFO) – Mandatory**

12aceaac.title: Sr Release and Program Manager
12aceaac.description:
Our world is transforming, and PTC is leading the way. Our software brings the physical and digital worlds together, enabling companies to improve operations, create better products, and empower people in all aspects of their business.

Our people make all the difference in our success. Today, we are a global team of nearly 7,000 and our main objective is to create opportunities for our team members to explore, learn, and grow - all while seeing their ideas come to life and celebrating the differences that make us who we are and the work we do possible.

**Your Role**

We are currently seeking a Senior Release and Program Manager to join our PLM PMO team in PTC office in Pune.

In this role, you will support engineering cross-functional teams to help manage their major release activities and special initiatives throughout the software development lifecycle. You will work directly with integrated scrum teams to coordinate and track program milestones and deliverables, effectively mitigate schedule and scope risks, within agile framework leading releases towards successful outcomes.

You will be part of a PMO team of talented and enthusiastic release and program managers who lead with a servant leader mindset.

You will interact with a multitude of roles across the organization on a day to day basis. You will be the go to person for processes associated with planning, monitoring, control, configuration and change management for your initiatives/releases.

**Your Impact**

This role is critical to ensure timely and efficient release execution per defined plan, as well as effective communication within and across the integrated scrum teams, PMs and TPMs. A big part of the role will be related to supporting the teams through facilitation of the meetings, following up on the actions, providing the data to enable data driven decision making.

**Your Team**

This role reports into the PLM PMO organization and will be working closely with the R&D and PM leaders both within the PLM organization, as well as other segments.

**Your Day-to-Day**

Work with PM, Engineering & QA teams on delivering projects and releases to meet R&D strategic goals

Plan, schedule, and control the build, test, and deployment of releases

Enable efficient release process / governance

Identify, communicate and manage risks

Identify and manage dependencies; coordinate delivery across scrum teams

Measure release cadence and effectiveness using common metrics; own release dashboards; establish status reporting for the cross-functional teams

Plan and lead release status review meetings with senior management; establish efficient governance to communicate status updates, risks and escalations

Lead all change management activities and ensure timely decisions on change requests

Collaborate with other program and release managers to define and improve organizational standards for release

**Qualification, Preferred Experience and Must-Have skills**

Bachelor s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems Management, Mathematics, other related fields, or equivalent experience.

7-10 years of experience in software development organizations, with minimum of 5 years in a program or project management role.

Excellent written and verbal communication and interpersonal skills

Good understanding and working knowledge of Agile Scrum software product development methodology, good knowledge of Scrum Master responsibilities.

Comfort in managing multiple projects with multiple business partners in a fast-paced and dynamic team environment

Comfort with utilization of AI

Self-starter who can earn trust and can influence and motivate without authority

Ability to work independently

Proactive in identifying and solving problems, looks beyond the obvious and can find the root of the problem

Ability to build and cultivate strong cross-functional relationships

Excellent facilitator, able to drive collaboration across the teams

High level of organization and attention to detail

Data savvy; Able to interpret data and use the knowledge for introducing optimization at different levels

Fluent with MS PowerPoint, Excel, Word, Project management tools (Jira/Confluence, Qlik, Smartsheet, MS Project)

Experience driving positive change via process improvement

We respect the privacy rights of individuals and are committed to handling Personal Information responsibly and in accordance with all applicable privacy and data protection laws. Review our Privacy Policy here ."
